1.description: Darin, a young man on Talking Island, carries a torch for Gatekeeper Roxxy, who doesn't return his affections. Darin is not so easily dissuaded, however.

steps.title: Delivery of Love Letters
steps.description: Darin of Talking Island Village has fallen in love with Gatekeeper Roxxy. He is too shy to express his feelings and asks you to deliver his love letter to her.\n

steps.title: Roxxy's Kerchief
steps.description: Roxxy reads Darin's letter and tells you that she admires him as well. She asks you to deliver her kerchief to him. Take Roxxy's kerchief to Darin in the village square.\n

steps.title: Baulro's Magic Potion
steps.description: Darin is overjoyed to learn that Roxxy returns his admiration, and says he wants to ask her for a date. He asks you to go and get a love potion promised to him by Magister Baulro at the temple.\n

steps.title: Water that Brings Out Courage
steps.description: Magister Baulro admits that he deceived Darin about the potion in order to bolster his courage. He gives you a medicine bottle filled with tap water. Take it to Darin in the village square.\n

2.description: Arujian, a young man in the Elven Village, adores Magister Greenis with all his heart, but no one knows if Greenis returns his affections.

steps.title: Arujien's Letter
steps.description: Arujien confesses to you that he has pined for Magister Greenis for a long time. He asks you to find out if Greenis returns his affection. Meet with her younger sister, Gatekeeper Mirabel, and show her Arujien's letter.\n

steps.title: Uncle Herbiel
steps.description: Gatekeeper Mirabel says that she doesn't get involved in her sister's affairs. She suggests that you ask Trader Herbiel. You will find him in a magic shop. Show him Arujien's Letter.\n

steps.title: Uncle's Advice
steps.description: Trader Herbiel thinks that Magister Greenis likes Arujien. Go back to Arujien and give him the good news.\n

steps.title: Feelings that Have Turned into a Poem
steps.description: Arujien says that he's written a book of poetry for Greenis. Take Arujien's poetry book to Magister Greenis.\n

steps.title: Letter of Refusal
steps.description: Magister Greenis informs you that she loves another. Take Greenis' letter of refusal to Arujian.\n

3.description: The Human has betrayed the secret that's kept Hierarch Mitraell sealed for centuries! Help Tettrarch Talloth break the seal that binds Mitraell!

steps.title: Preparation for a Ritual
steps.description: Dark Elven Tetrarch Talloth is continuing in the studies of the dark arts in order to break the seal that binds Mitraell, the leader of the Dark Elves. He asks that you to go to the school of the Dark Arts and bring him an Omen Beast's eye, a Taint Stone and Succubus Blood which are all needed to break the Seal.  This being the first stage among three stages that binds the great leader.\n\monsters to be hunted - Omen Beast, Tainted Zombies, Stink Zombies, Lesser Succubi, Lesser Succubus Turen and Lesser Succubus Tilfos\n

steps.title: Return to Tetrarch Talloth
steps.description: You have collected all the ingredients required for a spell. Return to Hierarch Talloth.\n

4.description: Pa'agrio Lord Kakai, the leader of all the Orcs, is sick! The elders have decided that each tribe will need to deliver a present to him to ensure he has a speedy recovery.

steps.title: Gifts from the Six Tribes
steps.description:
Pa'agrio Lord Kakai, the ruler of all the Orcs, has fallen ill. The Centurions have decreed that each tribe shall offer him gifts to improve his health. Centurion Nakusin asks you to collect the offerings from the six tribes. You must meet with the following tribal representatives:

Tataru Zu Hestui of the dignified Hestui tribe
Chief Varkees of the cold-blooded Atuba tribe
Warehouse Keeper Grookin of the formidable Neruga tribe
Gantaki Zu Urutu of the strong-willed Urutu tribe
Trader Kunai of the tactical Dudamara tribe
Trader Uska of the ruthless Gandi tribe.

steps.title: Return to Nakusin
steps.description: You have collected all of the tributes for Pa'agrio Lord Kakai. Take them to Centurion Nakusin.\n

5.description: The guildsmen of the Gray Pillar Guild are hard at work in the Strip Mine. Miner Bolter is concerned that no one is available to gather the supplies the village needs.

steps.title: Errand to the Village
steps.description: Miner Bolter, a member of the Gray Pillar Guild, lives at the Strip Mine. He asks you to bring him some things from the village. Visit Trader Shari's weapons shop, Trader Garita's store, Warehouse Chief Reed and Blacksmith Brunon and bring back the items that Miner Bolter is seeking.\n

steps.title: Return to Miner Bolter
steps.description: You have all of the items Bolter requested. Take them to him.\n

6.description: Gatekeeper Roxxy speaks of the wonders of the world beyond Talking Island. She fills your heart with hope for adventure!

steps.title: Helping Hand
steps.description: You've decided to experience all the adventure this world has to offer, but you can't afford it. Visit Magister Baulro and ask for help.\n

steps.title: Permission of Archon
steps.description: Magister Baulro says that he'll help you! He gives you a letter to take to Sir Collin Windawood in the Obelisk of Victory. He says Sir Collin may do you a favor if you ask him nicely.\n

steps.title: On to Giran!
steps.description: Recognizing your youthful vigor and ambition, Sir Collin Windawood agrees to sponsor your trip to Giran. Visit Gatekeeper Roxxy and tell her what Sir Windawood said.\n

7.description: One road is open to all who wish to see the world!

steps.title: A Predecessor's Advice
steps.description: At one time, Trader Ariel was an Adventurer who traveled many places and had many exciting experiences before coming back to Elven Forest. Ask for her advice.\n

steps.title: Help From the Hierarch
steps.description: It's said that Hierarch Asterios sponsors travelers because he wants young Elves to have all the experiences the outside world can offer. Visit Hierarch Asterios.\n

steps.title: Prepare for a Trip
steps.description: After securing a promise to return, Hierarch Asterios tells you to visit Gatekeeper Mirabel when you've finished preparing for the trip.\n

8.description: One road is open to all who wish to see the world!

steps.title: Secret Revenge
steps.description: Gatekeeper Jasmine ignores your request and says that you're as reckless as Roselyn was when she was young. Visit Sentry Roselyn to find a solution.\n

steps.title: Roselyn's Revenge
steps.description: Roselyn is angered by Jasmine's indelicate remark. She asks you to deliver a note containing an important story about Jasmine to Magister Harne.\n

steps.title: Jasmine's Judgment
steps.description: Magister Harne has seen the two sisters, Roselyn and Jasmine, fighting for a long time. She asks you to return to Jasmine and deliver her message.\n

9.description: Centurion Petukai seeks the true meaning of power. The place to go to learn about the history of your defeats is...

steps.title: Centurion's Inquisition
steps.description: Centurion Petukai, in service to Flame Lord Kakai, questions the meaning of strength. He asks you to visit Seer Tanapi and get the answer.\n

steps.title: To the City of Humans
steps.description: Seer Tanapi tells you to go to the city of Humans, Giran, to find answers to the questions asked by Orcs. Visit Gatekeeper Tamil.\n

10.description: One road is open to all who wish to see the world!

steps.title: Balanki's Test
steps.description: Silver Scale's Balanki permits a trip if the traveler passes his test. Go see Warehouse Chief Reed.\n

steps.title: Mining Rights at the Mithril Mines
steps.description: Warehouse Chief Reed asks you to take a necklace he made to Priest of the Earth Gerald. While you are meeting with the priest, find out to whom the mining rights will be granted.\n

steps.title: Failure to Obtain the Information
steps.description: Although you gave him the gift, Gerald did not offer you any information in detail.  Return to Warehouse Chief Reed and tell him what you found out.

steps.title: Bon Voyage!
steps.description: You've got the permission from Warehouse Chief Reed. Return to Silver Scale's Balanki and start your trip.\n

11.description: The hostile Ketra Orcs possess a very great influence in Goddard Territory. Guard Cadmon tells you that he will give you an opportunity to approach the Ketra tribe and proposes a mission to you...

steps.title: Meet Trader Leon
steps.description: Go to the weapons and armor shop in the Town of Goddard and meet with Trader Leon. Receive a war supplies box that needs to be delivered to the Ketra Orc tribe from him. \n

steps.title: Meet Ketra Orc's Messenger
steps.description: You got the war supplies box from Trader Leon in the Town of Goddard. Now, deliver it to Ketra's Messenger Wahkan in the Ketra Orc Outpost. \n

12.description: The hostile Ketra Orcs possess a very great influence in Goddard Territory. Guard Cadmon tells you that he will give you an opportunity to approach the Ketra tribe and proposes a mission to you...

steps.title: Meet Trader Helmut
steps.description: Go to the weapons and armor shop in the Town of Goddard and meet with Trader Helmut. He will give you a box of war supplies. Deliver it to the Varka Silenos. \n

steps.title: Meet Varka's Herald
steps.description: Pick up a box of war supplies from Trader Helmut and deliver it to Naran Ashanuk in the Varka Silenos stronghold. \n

13.description: Mineral Trader Fundin in the Town of Goddard asks you to make an immediate delivery to Vulcan in the lower region of Forge of the Gods.

steps.title: Deliver a Package
steps.description: Mineral Trader Fundin in the Town of Goddard asks you to deliver a package to Blacksmith Vulcan in the lower region of the Forge of the Gods. Get going!\n

14.description: Liesel asks you to deliver a letter to her Archaeologist friend who left the town a few years ago.

steps.title: Deliver a Letter
steps.description: Trader Liesel of the Town of Goddard asks you to deliver a letter to her Archaeologist friend who left several years ago. She tells you to go to the fork in the road and travel north to find the Shrine of Loyalty and east to go to the Imperial Tomb.\n

15.description: Vladimir is looking for assistants to help the mysterious organization to which he belongs. It's a request you can't refuse.

steps.title: Meet the Mysterious Necromancer
steps.description: Trader Vladimir asks you to visit the Mysterious Necromancer at the entrance of the Valley of Saints.\n

steps.title: Meet the Hierarch
steps.description: The Mysterious Necromancer asks you to visit the Hierarch in charge of the Evil Altar.\n

16.description: The Hierarch says that you must pass a trial to be recognized as a member of his group.

steps.title: Breaking the Seal
steps.description: Go to the Evil Altar and break the hidden seal.\n

steps.title: Breaking the Seal
steps.description: Go to the Evil Altar and break the hidden seal.\n

steps.title: Breaking the Seal
steps.description: Go to the Evil Altar and break the hidden seal.\n

steps.title: Breaking the Seal
steps.description: Go to the Evil Altar and break the hidden seal.\n

steps.title: Breaking the Seal
steps.description: Go to the Evil Altar and break the hidden seal.\n

steps.title: Breaking the Seal
steps.description: You've broken all the seals. Speak with Tetrarch who can be found near you.\n

17.description: The Hierarch is attempting to make it possible to perform his ritual on the Altar of Saints.

steps.title: Breaking the Seal
steps.description: Go to the Altar of Saints and spread the Blood of Saint.\n

steps.title: Breaking the Seal
steps.description: Go to the Altar of Saints and spread the Blood of Saint.\n

steps.title: Breaking the Seal
steps.description: Go to the Altar of Saints and spread the Blood of Saint.\n

steps.title: Breaking the Seal
steps.description: Go to the Altar of Saints and spread the Blood of Saint.\n

steps.title: Breaking the Seal
steps.description: You've finished your task. Speak with the Hierarch.\n

18.description: Warehouse Chief Donald asks you to deliver war supplies to the Golden Ram Mercenary Force that was dispatched to the Swamp of Screams. He asks you to first go meet Warehouse Freightman Daisy, his niece...

steps.title: Receive the delivered cargo!
steps.description: Meet with Warehouse Freightman Daisy at the Rune Township warehouse, and pick up the supplies for the Golden Ram Mercenary Force. \n

steps.title: Go to the Swamp of Screams!
steps.description: Deliver the box of supplies you received from Daisy to Mercenary Supplier Abercrombie in the Swamp of Screams. \n

19.description: Vladimir says that his recent order of meat from the Pastureland was mushy. He asks you to return it for him.

steps.title: Mushy Meat
steps.description: Vladimir says the meat delivered from the  Pastureland is not what he ordered and asks you to return it for him.\n

20.description: A kindhearted beast may possess a Jewel of Innocence. Where can you find one?

steps.title: Jewel of Innocence
steps.description: Beast Herder Tunatun asks you to bring him a Jewel of Innocence that is produced when a young beast with a kind heart is raised.\n

steps.title: Return to Tunatun
steps.description: You've obtained the Jewel of Innocence! Take it to Beast Herder Tunatun in the Pastureland.\n

21.description: The Forest of the Dead. A sleepless ghost lives in the deep darkness. The conspiracy is born.

steps.title: Dark Mage Depression
steps.description: The Dark Mage is troubled by a ghost's moaning. Perhaps the sound is coming from a nearby tombstone.\n

steps.title: Ghost of Tombstone
steps.description: As you read the epitaph, the ghost appears. Ask why he's wandering about.\n

steps.title: Follow the Ghostly Page
steps.description: The Ghost of von Hellmann says he'll send you a page to guide you. Follow the page.\n

steps.title: A Place of Sleeping Rage
steps.description: The Ghost of von Hellmann gives directions in a rage.\n

steps.title: Something's Hidden in the Bookshelf
steps.description: The book was about the Forest of the Dead. Anything else? Flip through some more pages.\n

steps.title: To the Rune Township Temple
steps.description: When you touched the crucifix, you thought you heard someone telling you to visit a Priest of Einhasad located in the Rune Township temple. Go there quickly.\n

steps.title: Find Innocentin
steps.description: Innocentin was not at the Rune Castle Temple. Could he be around the library?\n

22.description: The Priest requested necromancy. What is the tragedy of Hellmann Forest? Some die and some are made quite wealthy.

steps.title: Necromancy
steps.description: When you ask about necromancy, Tifaren rebuffs you. Continue to try and persuade her.\n

steps.title: The Crucifix Vanishes
steps.description: You need Einhasad's crucifix to perform necromancy. Where did he drop it? Ask High Priest Innocentin.\n

steps.title: Find Tifaren
steps.description: Innocentin gives you the crucifix and tells you to speak with Grand Magister Tifaren and perform the necromancy.\n

steps.title: Catalyst of Necromancy
steps.description:
You need an Elven skull as a catalyst for necromancy. Hunt zombies or ghosts in the Forest of the Dead.

Monster to Hunt -  Slaughter Executioner, Trampled Man, Sacrificed Man

steps.title: Return to Tifaren
steps.description: You've got the catalyst for necromancy. Return to Grand Magister Tifaren in the Rune Township library.\n

steps.title: Busy Magister
steps.description: Tifaren is too busy. Ask later when she has some time.\n

steps.title: Necromancy
steps.description: The necromancy worked. It lasts for only 2 minutes, so finish your business with the ghost before it disappears.\n

steps.title: What the Ghost Said
steps.description: The ghost says Innocentin used to investigate Mystics. Return to High Priest Innocentin.\n

steps.title: Ghost of Adventurer
steps.description: The Adventurer was called a devil worshiper and his ghost still shows up at the well. Go there and get the results of his investigation.\n

steps.title: Drag Time
steps.description: He asks you to buy him some time at the well. Face the soul of the well until the gem color changes!\n

steps.title: Color-changing Gem
steps.description: The color of the gem has changed! Talk to the ghost after defeating or escaping the soul.\n

steps.title: Report in the Well
steps.description: It says the report is near the entrance of the well. Get it.\n

steps.title: Return to Ghost of Adventurer
steps.description: You've got the report. Talk to the ghost.\n

steps.title: Report of Ghost
steps.description: The first seal of the report has been broken. Take it to High Priest Innocentin in the Rune Township.\n

steps.title: Checking the Report
steps.description: Innocentin says he wants to check the contents. Return later.\n

steps.title: Consultation of High Priest
steps.description: The ghost left records of the war in the Forest of the Dead. Innocentin has the story.\n

23.description: A girl knows the truth. The night she became a vampire, a tragedy befell the von Hellmann family.

steps.title: Treasure Hunter Investigation
steps.description: Innocentin gives you the map and key left by the Treasure Hunter he hired and asks you to find out what he wanted.\n

steps.title: Key with the Silver Spear
steps.description: You remember seeing a silver spear engraved on a lock somewhere.  This might be where the key fits.\n

steps.title: What the Treasure Hunter Left Behind
steps.description: You've found the lock that matches the silver key. Open it and figure out what he was investigating.\n

steps.title: Lidia's Diary
steps.description: Lidia left behind two things. Check her diary for their meaning and return to High Priest Innocentin.\n

steps.title: Reading the Diary
steps.description: Innocentin tells you to talk to him again after reading Lidia's diary.\n

steps.title: Sleep of the Dead
steps.description: You let Innocentin know about the past. Return to let the ghost rest.\n

steps.title: What's Under the Tombstone?
steps.description: The ghost thanks you for Lidia's diary and tells you to take what you find under the tombstone to a town at the center of the forest.\n

steps.title: Towards the Cursed Town
steps.description: You found the key with a silver spear engraved on it under the tombstone. Take it to the hidden town at the center of the forest.\n

steps.title: What's in the Box?
steps.description: Violet asks you to open the box at the center of the forest with the key and bring back the contents.\n

steps.title: Silver Key
steps.description: The box had a silver spear. Take it to Violet in the Cursed Village.\n

24.description: Something horrible happened in what is now known as the Cursed Village. Was the Lady Lidia responsible for these tragic events? What or who was behind the tragedy of the Hellmann Forest if not her?

steps.title: Flowers for the tombstone
steps.description: Dorian greets you and asks you to lay the flowers at the tombstone.\n

steps.title: Return to Dorian
steps.description: You put down the flowers at the tombstone. Return to Dorian.\n

steps.title: Things That Go Bump in the Night
steps.description: Dorian asks you to find out what happens in this town at night.\n

steps.title: Things That Go Bump in the Night
steps.description: The villagers become vampires at night! Return to Dorian at daylight and tell him.\n

steps.title: Maid of Lords
steps.description: Dorian is shocked, then tells you to meet the Lord's maid. She shows up only at night.\n

steps.title: Letter of Lords
steps.description: Lidia's maid asks you to come back after reading the letter from her master.\n

steps.title: Lost Hairpin
steps.description: Where is that hairpin? Go town and ask around.\n

steps.title: Recovered Hairpin
steps.description: You've found the hairpin. Wait until it's dark and meet Lidia's maid.\n

steps.title: Suspicious Doll
steps.description:
Lidia's maid tells you to hunt the Magus of the Dark Arts, take away their suspicious doll and ask the master of the Magus of Dark Arts about it.

Monsters to Hunt - Bone Snatchers, Bone Shapers, Bone Collectors, Bone Animators, Bone Slayers, Skull Collectors, Skull Animators

steps.title: Mystic of Riddles
steps.description: You've obtained a suspicious doll. Speak with the Mysterious Wizard who controls the Dark Mages.\n

steps.title: Gathering Thoughts
steps.description: The Mystic tells you to come back again when you're sure. Gather your thoughts and try talking to him again.\n

25.description: The conspiracy has been exposed. What would have been a complete tragedy was only saved by the fact that she survived because of the experiment.

steps.title: Put On a Poker Face
steps.description: The Priest of Rune Castle has nothing to say.\n

steps.title: Lost Doll
steps.description: You lost the suspicious doll? Could you have lost it in Forest of the Dead?!\n

steps.title: To the Rune Township Temple
steps.description: You received the totem from the Mysterious Wizard again. Return to Priest Benedict and tell him what's on your mind!\n

steps.title: Take Me to the Leader
steps.description: Benedict says that the highest-ranking person in the temple is High Priest Agripel. He tells you to talk to him.\n

steps.title: To the Dark Mage
steps.description: High Priest Agripel has nothing else to say and orders you to return to the man who sent you here before he gives you the key.\n

steps.title: Key to the Gem
steps.description: One of the bookshelves discarded in this forest has a lock that matches the key. Find it.\n

steps.title: The Suspicious Enemy Attacks
steps.description: Suddenly, a strange enemy shows up and attacks you. Fight it.\n

steps.title: Investigation of the Bookshelf
steps.description: You've defeated the mysterious devil. Search the bookshelves again.\n

steps.title: A Scrap of Truth
steps.description: A sheet of paper was inside the jewelry box. Go to the girl who recorded everything and ask her about it. If it remains unclear, seek help from the Mysterious Wizard.\n

steps.title: The Omniscient One
steps.description: The girl who recorded everything is the one who knows Nidrah's true name! What could it be?\n

steps.title: Lost Red Dress
steps.description: Lidia's maid said that she must find the dress that Rose was wearing before she fainted! Where could it be? Where is Rose buried?\n

steps.title: What's in the Coffin?
steps.description: When you dig under the tombstone, you find a coffin. Open it!\n

steps.title: To My Dear, Injured Lady
steps.description: You've got the red dress. Return to Lidia's maid.\n

steps.title: Lost in Memories
steps.description: Lidia's maid asks you to leave her alone for a while. Return to her later.\n

steps.title: A Shocking Confession
steps.description: Lidia's maid revealed a shocking fact and told you to speak with Hardin if you wanted the details.\n

steps.title: Triol's Conspiracy
steps.description: Hardin tells you what happened to Lidia, and says you should speak with High Priest Agripel in the temple if you're still angry.\n

steps.title: The Benandanti Cartel
steps.description: The conspiracy of the Benandanti cartel is just beginning. Say goodbye to Lidia.\n

steps.title: The Benandanti Cartel
steps.description: The conspiracy of the Benandanti cartel is just beginning. Meet Hardin and ask him what to do about them.\n

27.description: Lanosco asks you to look for a lost treasure chest. He thinks it was probably dropped into the water. You should try fishing for it. When you find it, open it up to see what it contains and then return it to its original owner. One time quest.

steps.title: A Strange Box
steps.description: Lanosco asks you to look for a large blue treasure chest. You should use the special bait he gave you to find it. You can also ask around to see if anyone has already found the chest.

steps.title: An Unusual Golem Blueprint
steps.description: When you open the large blue treasure chest, you find an unusual Golem Blueprint. Take it to Shaling at the Blacksmith Shop in the Town of Dion. \n

28.description: You've gotten a strange piece of bait from O'Fulle, a Giran Fishing Guild Member. I wonder what's in the box he wants you to recover?

steps.title: Searching For a Strange Box
steps.description: O'Fulle asks you to find a yellow treasure chest. Its owner lost it in the water. If your fishing skill is at least level 12, try using a special bait to find it, or, you could ask around to see if anyone has already found it.

steps.title: Delivering Kiki's Letter
steps.description: You find a letter when you open the yellow chest. Take it to Mineral Trader Kiki at the Blacksmith Shop in the village. \n

29.description: You got a strange bait from Willie. What's inside the box?

steps.title: A Small Purple Box
steps.description: Fishing Guild Member Willie asks you to find a small purple box. Its owner dropped it in the water. You could try to fish it out with special bait ergonomically designed to attract "purple boxes", or you could ask around to see if anyone's already found it.\n

steps.title: A Small Glass Box
steps.description: When you open the small purple treasure chest, you find a small glass box. Take it to Anabel in Heine Village. \n

30.description: You've got a strange bait from Linnaeus. What's inside the box?

steps.title: Red treasure chest
steps.description: Fishing Guild Member Linnaeus asks you to find a Red Treasure Chest. Its owner dropped it in the water. You could try to fish it out with special bait ergonomically designed to attract a "Red Treasure Chest", or you could ask around to see if anyone's already found it.\n

steps.title: Rukal's Musical Score
steps.description: Using the Flaming Fishing Lure that Linnaeus gave you, you managed to snag a box. It contains a single musical note. Who has time for music in this war-stricken world other than a few aristocrats? Take it to Rukal in the Town of Dion. \n

31.description: Mercenary Supplier Abercrombie of the Golden Ram Mercenary Force asks you to find a researcher who went missing while he was exploring for relics of an ancient empire that lay hidden in the Swamp of Screams...

steps.title: Search for Researcher Krorin!
steps.description: Find the whereabouts of Researcher Krorin, who disappeared while investigating the Swamp of Screams. Also recover Krorin's research journal containing information about the monument of the ancients that Krorin uncovered through his investigation. \n
steps.completionNpcName: The place where Researcher Krorin disappeared.

steps.title: Take the journal to Abercrombie!
steps.description: Take the research journal you recovered from Researcher Krorin and take it to Abercrombie who is in the Barracks of the Golden Ram Mercenary Force. \n

steps.title: Find the forgotten monument!
steps.description: Continue Krorin's investigation of the ancient stone tablet. From his journal, you've found the first monument. Now, find the second one. \n

steps.title: Find the second monument!
steps.description: Go to the location indicated by the diagram engraved on the surface of the stone tablet to find the second monument. \n

steps.title: Find the third monument!
steps.description: Go to the location indicated by the geometrical figures engraved on the surface of the stone tablet to find the third monument. \n

steps.title: Find the fourth monument!
steps.description: By analyzing the map engraved on the surface of the stone tablet, you know where the next monument is located. Go there and find it. \n

steps.title: Return to Abercrombie!
steps.description: Return to Mercenary Supplier Abercrombie in the barracks of the Golden Ram Mercenary Force and let him know about the four monuments. \n

32.description: High Priest Maximilian asked Gentler to make him some medicine, but the process was interrupted and has been delayed. He asks you to help Gentler.

steps.title: Meet Gentler
steps.description: High Priest Maximilian says that Trader Gentler of Giran Castle Town needs help. Go meet Gentler.\n

steps.title: Find Miki the Cat
steps.description: Trader Gentler says that he's lost contact with Miki the Cat on Devil's Isle and asks you to deliver the map to him and get some herbs in return.\n

steps.title: Find Herbs
steps.description:
Miki the Cat says that he found the herbs, but lost them when the pouch containing the herbs got torn while he was wandering around lost. He asks you to obtain 20 herbs. Get  them by hunting alligators on Alligator Beach.

Monster to Hunt - Alligators

steps.title: Deliver the Herbs
steps.description: You've got all the herbs that Trader Gentler of Giran Castle Town asked for. Take them to him immediately!\n

steps.title: Collect Spirit Ore
steps.description: Gentler needs 500 more Spirit Ores to make the medicine and asks you to get them.\n

steps.title: Get Your Reward
steps.description: You ask Trader Gentler to pay you and he says that Miki the Cat has already been paid for the runestones. He tells you to get the money from him.\n

steps.title: A Lie Exposed
steps.description: Miki the Cat says he never signed any contract and sends you back to Trader Gentler in Giran Castle Town.\n

steps.title: The Final Ingredient
steps.description: Gentler apologizes and promises to make you an exquisite accessory if you'll bring him some more ingredients.  He asks you to collect 1,000 thread and 500 suede.

33.description: While making formal wear, Leikar asks you to go to Trader Woodley get some dress shoes. Woodley doesn't make them, however.

steps.title: Meet Leikar
steps.description: Woodley asks you to meet Leikar and get the materials for the formal wear she's making. Find Leikar and get some fabric.\n

steps.title: Meet Woodley
steps.description: Leikar doesn't have any more of the formal wear fabric, but she's willing to make some for Woodley if you tell him it's the one that she made long ago.\n

steps.title: Gather Ingredients
steps.description: Woodley needs materials to make the dress shoes and asks you to bring him 200 leather, 600 thread and 500,000 adena.\n

steps.title: Woodley's Errands
steps.description: Woodley asks you to deliver 300,000 adena to Ian to pay off the balance on his account while he's making the dress shoes.\n

steps.title: Meet Woodley
steps.description: Ian accepts the payment and asks you to tell Woodley that he will charge interest next time.\n

34.description: Radia says that the ingredients she needs haven't arrived yet. She asks you to go to the Town of Gludio and check on her delivery.

steps.title: Go to Varan
steps.description: Radia hasn't begun work because the ingredients that she ordered haven't been delivered yet. Visit Trader Varan and check on her delivery.\n

steps.title: Return to Radia
steps.description: Varan says it is difficult to get the supply and he cannot deliver the order on the due date and asks for understanding.\n

steps.title: Go to Ralford
steps.description: Radia says she'll contact Ralford in the Ivory Tower in advance and asks you to get the materials from her.\n

steps.title: Squash the Spiders
steps.description:
Ralford doesn't have the items that Radia ordered, but she could get the spidersilk if she had some spinnerets. Go to the Sea of Spores and get 10 spinnerets.

Monsters to Hunt - Trisalims, Trisalim Tarantulas

steps.title: Go to Ralford
steps.description: You've hunted Trisalims and Trisalim Tarantulas and obtained 10 spinnerets. Return to Ralford and ask her to spin out the spidersilk.\n

steps.title: Return to Radia
steps.description: Ralford makes you the spidersilk and asks you to bring him 3,000 units of suede and 5,000 thread.\n

35.description: Leikar asks you to go to Ellie and get the gem from her, but Ellie says that she didn't finish because her delivery didn't arrive.

steps.title: Go to Felton
steps.description: Ellie says the ore that she ordered haven't arrived and asks you to visit Felton and find out when her order will arrive.\n

steps.title: Sail for Alligator Beach
steps.description: Felton suggests you go to Alligator Beach to get the ore by hunting Alligators. Bring back 10 ore.\n

steps.title: Return to Ellie
steps.description: You've got 10 ore. Return to Ellie and ask her to make them into gems.\n

steps.title: Ingredients to Cut Gems
steps.description: Ellie says she needs more materials and asks you to bring her 5 oriharukon, 500 units of silver and 150 thons.\n

36.description: Leikar asks you to visit Ferris in Aden Castle Town and make a sewing kit. You'll need an extraordinary ingredient to make it.

steps.title: Get Reinforced Steel
steps.description:
Ferris needs enchanted iron and asks you to catch an Enchanted Iron Golem in the Ivory Tower and bring him 5 fragments of the golem.

Monster to Hunt -  Enchanted Iron Golem

steps.title: Return to Ferris
steps.description: You've attained 5 fragments from the Enchanted Iron Golem. Return to Ferris.\n

steps.title: Gather Ingredients
steps.description: Ferris asks for 10 artisan's molds and 10 oriharukon to make a sewing kit.\n

37.description: You visited Alexis to have some formal wear made, but learned that her maid, Leikar, makes it better than she does. Go and see Leikar.

steps.title: Finding Leikar
steps.description: Trader Alexis says Leikar makes great formal wear and tells you to visit her.\n

steps.title: Leikar's Request
steps.description: Leikar asks you to run errands for her while she's making the formal wear. Visit Jeremy and get some cookies.\n

steps.title: Jeremy's Errands
steps.description: Jeremy asks you to deliver wine to Mist while he's baking cookies.\n

steps.title: Return to Jeremy
steps.description: You've delivered the wine to Mist. Return to Jeremy and get the cookies.\n

steps.title: Leikar's Errands
steps.description: Jeremy made you the cookies that Leikar asked for. Carefully deliver them.\n

steps.title: Leikar's Request
steps.description: Leikar says she ordered the materials for the formal wear, but they've not yet been delivered and she asks you to check on them. Ask Blacksmith Ferris in Aden Castle Town about the sewing kit, Radia in Giran Castle Town about the fabrics, Ellie in Giran Castle Town about the gems.\n

steps.title: Making Shoes
steps.description: Leikar asks you to go to Trader Woodley in Aden Castle Town and have the dress shoes made while she's making the formal wear.\n

38.description: The primitive tribe of Langk Lizardmen in the southern part of Gludio Territory have been using a spell unknown to even the Mystics of the Ivory Tower.

steps.title: Wipe out the Raiders!
steps.description:
Lately, Langk Lizardmen's attacks have sharply increased on the south coast road to Giran. The guards have asked you to destroy the lizardmen that are disturbing the peace.

Monsters to Hunt - Langk lizardman Sentinels, Langk lizardman Lieutenants

steps.title: Return to Guard Luis
steps.description: You've defeated the Langk Lizardmen that have been threatening the southern coast road. Return to Guard Luis of Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Mysterious Tooth
steps.description: You discover a strange tooth among the warriors' effects. Ask Magister Iris about it.\n

steps.title: Towards Magister Rohmer
steps.description: Magister Iris was able to identify the tooth as coming from a dragon, but is unable to control it. She suggests that you ask Magister Rohmer in the Town of Gludio.\n

steps.title: Exposed Secret
steps.description: An expert in the sorcery of lizardmen, Magister Rohmer has important reference data and asks you to deliver it to Magister Iris at once.\n

steps.title: Find the Tooth
steps.description:
Magister Iris has discovered the secret of the dragon's tooth. To destroy the savage sorcery, she must have many more of the teeth. She asks you to steal 50 teeth from the lizardmen.

Monsters to Hunt - Langk lizardman Shamans, Langk lizardman Leaders

steps.title: Duty Fulfilled
steps.description: You've collected the 50 dragon's teeth that Magister Iris asked for. Take them to her.\n

39.description: The red eyes of the Maille Lizardmen behold the dark shadows cast by war-ravaged Gludio Castle.

steps.title: Invaders of Gludio
steps.description: Guard Babenco of the Town of Gludio has  recently noticed increased movements of Lizardmen on the west side of town and he's seeking recruits to help defeat them. All volunteers should report to Captain Bathis.\n

steps.title: Destroy the Maille Lizardmen's Vanguard
steps.description:
Taking advantage of confusion after the war, a savage tribe, Maille Lizardman, that came into the center of Gludio is gaining its power. Captain Bathis orders you to destroy the Maille Lizardmen's vanguard and bring 100 Red Bone Necklaces and 100 Black Bone Necklaces as the evidence.

Monsters to Hunt - Maille Lizardman, Maille Lizardman Scout, Maille Lizardman Guard

steps.title: Drumbeats of Victory
steps.description: You've destroyed the Maille Lizardmen. Take your trophies to Captain Bathis.\n

steps.title: Search for Clues
steps.description:
When Captain Bathis received the report that Arachnids showed up during the previous battle, he suspected that there might be a conspiracy between the Maille Lizardmen and the Arachnids. He has asked you to investigate the possibility of a relationship between them.  Investigate both sides and look for evidence of a conspiracy. 

Monsters to Hunt - Maille Lizardman Guards, Maille Lizardman Scouts and Giant Arachnids

steps.title: Conspiracy Revealed
steps.description: After much searching, you've discovered the clues to the conspiracy! Return to Captain Bathis.\n

42.description: One day his uncle left to start a ranch in the north, and Waters recently got a letter from him! He wants to help his uncle start a new life...

steps.title: A Trident is Needed
steps.description: Pet Manager Waters asks you to find him a trident.\n

steps.title: Hunting Monster Eyes
steps.description:
Waters cannot send the trident because of the monster eyes lurking near the village. Hunt the monster eyes for him.
 Monsters to Hunt - 
Plains of Dion: Monster Eye Destroyers 
Dion Hills: Monster Eye Gazers

steps.title: Return to Waters
steps.description: You've defeated 30 monster eyes. Return to Pet Manager Waters.\n

steps.title: The Plan of Attack
steps.description: The monster eyes had a map containing their attack plans! Show it to Sophya.\n

steps.title: Return to Waters
steps.description: Sophya thanks you for the information and asks you to thank Waters for her, too. Return to Pet Manager Waters.\n

43.description: Planning to move to a quiet place, Cooper gets a letter from his younger sister one day. The letter says she wants to become an Adventurer and help her brother! Cooper wants to get a dagger for her!

steps.title: A Crafted Dagger
steps.description: Pet Manager Cooper asks you to get him a crafted dagger.\n

steps.title: Hunting in the Execution Grounds
steps.description:
Worried about his younger sister's trip, Cooper asks you to hunt specters and sorrow maidens on the Execution Grounds. Kill 30 of them!

Monsters to Hunt - Specters, Sorrow Maidens

steps.title: Return to Cooper
steps.description: You've hunted monsters on the Execution Grounds and obtained a piece of a strange map. Return to Pet Manager Cooper.\n

steps.title: Map for Galladucci
steps.description: The thing that monsters in the Execution Grounds had looks like the map that should have been delivered to Galladucci. Visit Galladucci at his shop.\n

steps.title: Return to Cooper
steps.description: Trader Galladucci asks you to tell Cooper that he will buy him a big dinner around the Period of Tera. Return to Pet Manager Cooper.\n

44.description: Pet Manager Lundy has a son who is about to become an Adventurer. He says that he'll give you a marvelous gift if you get him a work hammer.

steps.title: Find a Work Hammer
steps.description: Pet Manager Lundy asks you to find him a work hammer.\n

steps.title: Hunt Maille Lizardman
steps.description:
After getting the work hammer, Lundy asks you to hunt 30 more Maille Lizardmen in this area.

Monsters to Hunt - Maille Lizardmen, Maille Lizardman Guards, Maille Lizardman Scouts

steps.title: Return to Lundy
steps.description: When you defeated the 30 Maille Lizardmen they dropped some strange things. Take them to Pet Manager Lundy.\n

steps.title: Bead of Riddles
steps.description: The bead that came from the monsters looks like the object that High Prefect Drikus ordered you to bring to him. Go visit him.\n

steps.title: Return to Lundy
steps.description: Drikus says we must determine exactly who owns the bead and asks you to talk to Pet Manager Lundy to determine the owner. Return to Lundy.\n

45.description: Leave the hustle and bustle of Giran far behind and return to peaceful Talking Island!

steps.title: First Scroll
steps.description: You came to get help with the Traveler's Mark, but Galladucci will only help you if you work for him. Take the scroll and visit Magic Trader Gentler.\n

steps.title: To the Luxury Shop
steps.description: Take the sword of magic that Galladucci ordered and return to the Luxury Shop.\n

steps.title: Second Scroll
steps.description: Get a new scroll and visit Jeweler Sandra at the Jewelry Shop.\n

steps.title: Return to the Boutique
steps.description: You've received gemstone powder from Sandra.  Take it to Galladucci at his boutique.

steps.title: Third Order Document
steps.description: This is the last errand for Galladucci. Visit Priest Dustin at the Einhasad Temple and deliver the scroll.\n

steps.title: Last Delivery
steps.description: You've got the purified necklace that was once cursed. Deliver it to Galladucci at his boutique.\n

50.description: Lanosco asks you to obtain special materials that he needs to make a special bait that will be used to recover a lost box. According to Lanosco, this bait doesn't catch fish, but it can be used to catch a special treasure chest!

steps.title: Power of Wind
steps.description:
Lanosco asks you to bring him 100 essences of wind, the special ingredient he needs to make a fishing lure containing the power of wind.

Monsters to Hunt -Singing Winds

steps.title: Obtaining the Essence of Wind
steps.description: You've collected 100 essences of wind requested by Lanosco. Return to him. \n

51.description: Lanosco asks you to obtain special materials that he needs to make a special bait that will be used to recover a lost box. According to Lanosco, this bait doesn't catch fish, but it can be used to catch a special treasure chest!

steps.title: Lost Fishing Lures
steps.description:
Fishing Guild Member O'Fulle of Giran asks you to help him recover some fishing lure ingredients that he's lost. Bring back 100 lost bait ingredients.

Monsters to Hunt -Fettered Souls

steps.title: Collection Complete
steps.description: You've collected 100 lost bait ingredients for O'Fulle. He says he's lost thousands of them! That poor O'Fulle... Return to him. \n

52.description: Fishing Guild Member Willie of Oren asks you to bring him the ingredients he needs to make his special bait. It doesn't catch fish, it doesn't make you popular, but it does find treasure chests!

steps.title: Spirit of Earth
steps.description:
Fishing Guild Member Willie uses the very essence of the earth to create a lure that is unimaginable, impractical and that will draw just about anything out of the water. Obtain 100 Eyes of a Tarlk basilisk for him.

Monsters to Hunt -Tarlk Basilisk

steps.title: Collecting ingredients
steps.description: You've collected 100 Eyes from Tarlk Basilisks as Willie requested. How can you make a fishing lure out of this stuff? What will those Humans think of next?\n

53.description: Fishing Guild Member Linnaeus of Oren asks you to bring him the ingredients he needs to make his special bait. It doesn't catch fish, it doesn't make you popular, but it does find treasure chests!

steps.title: Crimson Drake Heart
steps.description:
Linnaeus makes a very special bait that catches a very special kind of fish. Don't you want to catch something special? 

 Monsters to Hunt -Crimson Drakes

steps.title: Return to Linnaeus
steps.description: You have collected the Crimson Drake Hearts Linnaeus told you about. How can you possibly catch fish with this stuff? What will those Humans think of next?\n

70.description: You've lost as many people as you've tried to save. Learn your limits and then go beyond them!

steps.title: The Pilgrimage Begins
steps.description: Those who face the knight's dilemma are known to walk the path of pilgrimage. Speak with Master Felix in the Town of Goddard. He gave up his knighthood to follow the path.\n

steps.title: Find the Legendary Dish
steps.description: To save Master Felix's daughter, you need a dish called ice cold flower. Master Chef Donath in the Hot Springs area of Goddard knows how to prepare it. Ask him to make it for you.\n

steps.title: Searching for Ingredients
steps.description: Master Chef Donath needs Ice Crystals and a fat, white fish.\nYou can get some Ice Crystals if you do what Chef Jeremy asks and get the fat, white fish from a fisherman with a skill level of 23 - 25.\n

steps.title: Completed Dish
steps.description: Master Chef Donath used the materials and cooked the ice cold flower for you, adding that it cures a fever if you put it next to your head. Hurry up and deliver it to Master Felix in Goddard Castle.\n

steps.title: The First Communion
steps.description: You've got the Resonance Amulet. Commune with the Tablet of Vision that is just south of the Tower of Insolence.\n

steps.title: Guardians of the Resonance Amulet
steps.description:
The Guardians of Forbidden Knowledge near the Tablet of Vision have the second Resonance Amulet. Destroy them and take their Resonance Amulet.

Monsters to Hunt - Guardian of Forbidden Knowledge

steps.title: The Second Communion
steps.description: You've got the Resonance Amulet from the Guardians of Forbidden Knowledge. Commune with the Tablet of Vision.\n

steps.title: The Meaning of Knighthood
steps.description:
After communing with the second tablet, you feel Fallen Knight Adil waiting for you at the third tablet. Read all you can about him and get ready for a vicious battle. He awaits you near the third tablet.

Monster to Hunt -  Fallen Knight Adil

steps.title: The Third Communion
steps.description: You've defeated Fallen Knight Adil and taken the Resonance Amulet. His obsession with winning was his downfall...\nCommune with the third tablet.\n

steps.title: A Time to Choose
steps.description: Grand Master Cedric of Aden Castle Town has the fourth Resonance Amulet. Find him and get the fourth Resonance Amulet.\n

steps.title: Joining the Ketras
steps.description: To get the Divine Stone of Wisdom, you must gain the trust of the Ketra Orcs. Speak with Wahkan, their messenger.\n

steps.title: Joining the Varka Silenos
steps.description: To get the Divine Stone of Wisdom, you decided to help the Varka Silenos. Prove yourself to their messenger, Ashanuk, and gain the trust of the Varka Silenos.\n

steps.title: The Fourth Communion
steps.description: You've got the fourth Resonance Amulet. Go to the fourth tablet and commune with it.\n

steps.title: Meet Felix
steps.description: Master Felix of the Town of Goddard, whom you helped once, has the fifth Resonance Amulet. Visit him and get the Resonance Amulet.\n

steps.title: Halisha's Minions
steps.description:
The Archon of Halisha has the fifth Resonance Amulet. Lure the archon out by attacking his minions in the Shrine of Loyalty, or attack him directly inside the Imperial Tomb.

Monsters to Hunt -
Shrine of Loyalty: Grave Scarabs, Scavenger Scarabs, Grave Ants, Scavenger Ants, Shrine Knights, Shrine Guards, Archon of Halisha
Imperial Tomb: Archon of Halisha
steps.completionNpcName: Fork: The east road leads you to the Imperial Tomb and the north road to the  Shrine of Loyalty.

steps.title: The Fifth Communion
steps.description: You've got the fifth Resonance Amulet. Now head to the fifth tablet. It is in the northwestern corner of the Wall of Argos.\n

steps.title: The Devil's Hand
steps.description:
During the fifth communion, you see a devil waiting beside the sixth Tablet of Vision. Can you really fight against his power?

Monster to Hunt -  Shadow of Beleth

steps.title: The Sixth Communion
steps.description: After killing the shadow of Beleth, Eric disappeared, leaving behind the Resonance Amulet. Use it to perform the sixth communion.\n

steps.title: Path to the Knight
steps.description: Keep the things you've learned on your pilgrimage close to your heart. Meet Grand Master Cedric in Aden Castle Town and tell him what you've gained and lost.\n

steps.title: Preparation for Occupation Change
steps.description: You aren't skilled enough to actually do the things you've learned on your pilgrimage. Don't return to Grand Master Cedric until you reach level 76.\n

71.description: Oh, Mother Tree Guardian! Why are you restrained? Break free of your bonds and become a true Knight of the goddess!

steps.title: The Pilgrimage Begins
steps.description: Master Sinden thinks that Elves may one day need to leave their beloved Mother Tree behind. He tells you to meditate upon the position of Elves throughout your pilgrimage.\nFirst, you should visit Master Bronwyn.\n

steps.title: Find the Legendary Dish
steps.description: You must have a stone of blessing before you can embark upon a pilgrimage. You must have the pure ice to get it. Master Chef Donath in the Hot Springs area of Goddard may know how to make it.\n

steps.title: Searching for Ingredients
steps.description: Master Chef Donath needs Ice Crystals and a fat, white fish.\nYou can get some Ice Crystals if you do what Chef Jeremy asks and get the fat, white fish from a fisherman with a skill level of 23 - 25.\n

steps.title: Completed Dish
steps.description: Master Chef Donath used the materials to make you the Pure Ice. He says that Master Bronwyn taught him the recipe long ago. Take this ice to Master Bronwyn.\n

steps.title: The First Communion
steps.description: You've got the Resonance Amulet. Commune with the Tablet of Vision that is just south of the Tower of Insolence.\n

steps.title: Guardians of the Resonance Amulet
steps.description:
The Guardians of Forbidden Knowledge near the Tablet of Vision have the second Resonance Amulet. Destroy them and take their Resonance Amulet.

Monsters to Hunt - Guardian of Forbidden Knowledge

steps.title: The Second Communion
steps.description: You've got the Resonance Amulet from the Guardians of Forbidden Knowledge. Commune with the Tablet of Vision.\n

steps.title: The Meaning of Knighthood
steps.description:
After communing with the second tablet, you feel the presence of an Elven Warrior, a former guardian of Mother Tree who betrayed his own people, waiting for you at the third tablet. Read all you can about him and prepare for a vicious fight.

Monsters to Hunt - Elf Panacea

steps.title: The Third Communion
steps.description: You killed Panacea and got his Resonance Amulet. How could he have gone so wrong? Commune with the third tablet.\n

steps.title: A Time to Choose
steps.description: Master Sinden of Aden Castle Town has the fourth Resonance Amulet. Visit him and get it.\n

steps.title: Joining the Ketras
steps.description: To get the Divine Stone of Wisdom, you must gain the trust of the Ketra Orcs. Speak with Wahkan, their messenger.\n

steps.title: Joining the Varka Silenos
steps.description: To get the Divine Stone of Wisdom, you decided to help the Varka Silenos. Prove yourself to their messenger, Ashanuk, and gain the trust of the Varka Silenos.\n

steps.title: The Fourth Communion
steps.description: You've got the fourth Resonance Amulet. Go to the fourth tablet and commune with it.\n

steps.title: Meet Cerenas
steps.description: Through the communion with the tablet, you've discovered an Elven Priest in the Town of Goddard. Go meet Priest Cerenas.\n

steps.title: Halisha's Minions
steps.description:
The Archon of Halisha has the fifth Resonance Amulet. Lure the archon out by attacking his minions in the Shrine of Loyalty or attack him inside the Imperial Tomb.

Monsters to Hunt -
Shrine of Loyalty: Grave Scarab, Scavenger Scarab, Grave Ant, Scavenger Ant, Shrine Knights, Shrine Guards, Archon of Halisha
Imperial Tomb: Archon of Halisha
steps.completionNpcName: Fork: The east road leads you to the Imperial Tomb and the north road to the  Shrine of Loyalty.

steps.title: The Fifth Communion
steps.description: You've got the fifth Resonance Amulet. Now head to the fifth tablet. It is in the northwestern corner of the Wall of Argos.\n

steps.title: The Devil's Hand
steps.description:
During the fifth communion, you saw the devil born out of obsession which is the curse of Elves. It was waiting at the sixth Tablet of Vision. Can you really fight against his power?

Monster to Hunt -  Cursed Kesadein

steps.title: The Sixth Communion
steps.description: After killing Kesadein, Kastien disappeared, leaving behind a Resonance Amulet. Use it to perform the sixth communion.\n

steps.title: Proud Knight
steps.description: You've learned much about the limits and weaknesses of your own tribe. Return to Master Sinden and talk about what Elves must do in the future.\n

steps.title: Preparation for Occupation Change
steps.description: You aren't skilled enough to actually do the things you've learned on your pilgrimage. Train until you reach level 76 and then return to Master Sinden.\n

72.description: Oh, singer of the sword... Who taught you and who are you singing for?

steps.description: The goddess Eva only teaches the power of song to Elves. A tablet exists somewhere with Eva's first lesson, but the one who knows where it is probably won't tell you...\n

steps.title: Find the Legendary Dish
steps.description: Blacksmith Feynn asks you to bring him some bitter cold beer. The only person who can make it is Master Chef Donath in the Hot Springs area of Goddard. Visit him.\n

steps.title: Meaning of the Song

Monster to Hunt - Sword Player Biel

steps.title: The Third Communion
steps.description: You defeated Biel and took the Resonance Amulet. Her love of acclaim was her downfall... She lost touch with the true beauty of music! Commune with the third tablet now.\n

steps.description: The hermit says you must prove yourself before he'll give you the Resonance Amulet, and orders you to get the Divine Stone of Wisdom from the Ketra Orcs.\nYou must gain their trust and prove your wisdom. Speak with Wahkan, their messenger.\n

steps.title: The Hermit's Test
steps.description: The hermit says you must prove yourself before he'll give you the Resonance Amulet, and orders you to get the Divine Stone of Wisdom from the Varka Silenos.\nYou must gain their trust and prove your wisdom. Speak with Naran Ashanuk, their messenger.\n

steps.title: A Mysterious Hermit - 2
steps.description: The tablet shows a Human form much like the last and shows you where to go next. It beckons you to the road from the Town of Goddard to the Wall of Argos.\n

steps.title: Archon of Halisha
steps.description:
The hermit requires somthing more before he'll tell you where the next Tablet of Vision is. He orders you to draw out the Archon of Halisha by attacking his minions in the northeastern part of the Wall of Argos - or attack him directly in the Imperial Tomb. Kill him and take the Tablet of Vision from his dead fingers.

Monsters to Hunt -
 Shrine of Loyalty: Grave Scarabs, Scavenger Scarabs, Grave Ants, Scavenger Ants, Shrine Knights, Shrine Guards and the Archon of Halisha
Imperial Tomb: Archon of Halisha

steps.description: When your communion with the fifth tablet was near completion, the location of the sixth tablet was revealed. Go to it.\n

steps.title: Commune With the Tablet of Vision - 6
steps.description: Erica Ken Weber gave you the Resonance Amulet when Monument Guardian Azrael ran away. Now, commune with the last tablet.\n

steps.title: An Adventurer?
steps.description: You've finished communing with all the Tablets of Vision. Return to the Black Cat and tell her of your accomplishments.\n

steps.title: Towards the Adventurer
steps.description: Black Cat says that you need to work harder to properly use the power although you've obtained all the power of the Tablets of Vision.\nTrain more and then return to Black Cat.\n

82.description: Third Occupation Change - Quest for a Hawkeye become a Sagittarius

steps.title: Information Broker Grimst
steps.description: Bernard, the president and senior member of the guild, orders you to recover the Bow of Sagittarius, the stolen symbol of the guild. He suggests that you speak with Grimst in Hunters Village to find out more about the thief.\n

steps.title: Information Broker Mist
steps.description: Grimst wants something to please Mist's granddaughter, Lily, in exchange for information about the thief. He says Mist and Lily are in the Hot Springs area on vacation.\n

steps.title: Searching for Ice Crystals
steps.description: Mist says that Lily loves Shaved Ice, but he can't find any Ice Crystals to make it with. He suggests that you try to get some from Chef Jeremy in the Hot Springs area.\n

steps.title: Delivering Ice Crystals
steps.description: Mist made more than enough Shaved Ice and gives you some to take to Grimst.\n

steps.title: Seeking the Tablet of Vision - 1
steps.description: Information Broker Grimst says that the thief who stole the Bow of Sagittarius came to him and said that he was headed to the Tablet of Vision south of the Tower of Insolence.\n

steps.title: Seeking the Tablet of Vision - 2
steps.description: The tablet actually tells you where the thief went! He murdered the guards and approached the tablet with the Resonance Amulet.\n

steps.title: Commune With the Tablet of Vision - 2
steps.description: You've obtained the Resonance Amulet from a Guardian of Forbidden Knowledge. Start communing with the second tablet.\n

steps.title: Seeking the Tablet of Vision - 3
steps.description: The tablet once again shows where the thief is headed. Follow the thief to the next tablet.\n

steps.title: Commune With the Tablet of Vision - 3
steps.description: Using the Resonance Amulet you took from Ezekiel, commune with the third tablet.\n

steps.title: Mysterious Pilgrim of Darkness - 1
steps.description: The third Tablet of Vision shows the thief talking with a Human. It appears that they were on the road from Goddard to the Wall of Argos. Go there at once!\n

steps.title: Test of Pilgrim of Darkness
steps.description: The Pilgrim of Darkness says that you must get the Divine Stone of Wisdom from the Ketra Orcs to find out where the thief went.\nTo do so, you must gain their trust and prove your wisdom. Speak with Wahkan, their messenger.\n

steps.title: Test of Pilgrim of Darkness
steps.description: The Pilgrim of Darkness says that you must get the Divine Stone of Wisdom from the Varka Silenos to find out where the thief went.\nTo do so, you must gain their trust and prove your wisdom. Speak with Naran Ashanuk, their messenger.\n

steps.title: Seeking the Tablet of Vision - 4
steps.description: The Pilgrim of Darkness gives you the Resonance Amulet and says that you must find the fourth Tablet of Vision and commune with it to know where the thief went.\n

steps.title: Mysterious Pilgrim of Darkness - 2
steps.description: The Tablet of Vision shows a Human similar to the previous Pilgrim of Darkness talking to the thief and shows you a place on the road from the Town of Goddard to the Ketra Orc Outpost.\n

steps.title: Archon of Halisha
steps.description: The Pilgrim of Darkness says that you must commune with the fifth Tablet of Vision to know where the thief went. He insists that you must first get the fifth Resonance Amulet. He suggests that you draw the Archon of Halisha out by attacking his minions north of the Wall of Argos, or confront him directly in the Imperial Tomb. Kill him and take his Resonance Amulet.\n

steps.title: Hero vs. Archangel
steps.description: During your communion with the fifth Tablet of Vision, it showed the thief standing next to the sixth Tablet of Vision, holding something. Go there!\n

steps.title: Commune With the Tablet of Vision - 6
steps.description: Kadyth gave you the Resonance Amulet when Azrael ran away. Now commune with the last tablet.\n

steps.title: Sagittarius
steps.description: You've finished communing with all the Tablets of Vision. Return to Hunters Guild President Bernard and tell him what you've learned.\n

steps.description: Hunters Guild President Bernard tells you to train more to prepare yourself to use the power you've gained properly.\nGet some training and return to Bernard.\n

85.description: Hollint asks you to verify whether or not the one claiming to be the Saint of Light in the Town of Goddard is authentic.

steps.title: Meet the Saint of Light
steps.description: Hollint says that the Saint of Light has appeared in the Town of Goddard and asks you to meet with her and verify that she's actually the legendary saint.\n

steps.title: Searching for Duncan
steps.description: Agnes asks you to visit Chef Duncan in the Hot Springs area and bring her some food.\n

steps.title: Return with the Ice Crystals
steps.description: Chef Duncan needs Ice Crystals to keep the food fresh.\n

steps.title: Return to Agnes
steps.description: When you deliver the Ice Crystals, Chef Duncan hands you a well-packed jar containing the food. Take it to Agnes.\n

steps.title: Go to the Tablet of Vision
steps.description: Saint of Light Agnes gives you the Resonance Amulet and tells you to go to the Tablet of Vision.\n

steps.title: In Search of the Second Resonance Amulet
steps.description: According to the first Tablet of Vision, you'll meet someone who has the Resonance Amulet near the next tablet.\n

steps.title: Towards the Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've got the second Resonance Amulet. Go to the Tablet of Vision and try communing with it.\n

steps.title: In Search of the Third Resonance Amulet
steps.description: At the second tablet, you saw who has the Resonance Amulet near the third tablet. To find him, commune with the third tablet.\n

steps.title: Towards the Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've got the third Resonance Amulet. Go to the Tablet of Vision and try communing with it.\n

steps.title: Meet Bastian
steps.description: At the third tablet, you learned that Priest Bastian in the Town of Goddard has a Resonance Amulet. Visit him and get the Resonance Amulet.\n

steps.title: In Search of Ketra Orcs
steps.description: Priest Bastian tells you to gain the trust of Ketra's Messenger Wahkan and get the Divine Stone of Wisdom.\n

steps.title: In Search of Varka Silenos
steps.description: Priest Bastian tells you to gain the trust of Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk and get the Divine Stone of Wisdom.\n

steps.title: Towards the Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've got the Divine Stone of Wisdom and made a new Resonance Amulet. Now, go to the Tablet of Vision and try communing with it.\n

steps.title: Meet Bastian
steps.description: The location of the next Resonance Amulet is not revealed, but Priest Bastian of the Town of Goddard is briefly seen motioning goodbye. He may know something. Speak with him again.\n

steps.title: Searching for the Resonance Amulet
steps.description: Priest Bastian tells you to go to the fork in the road and travel north to find the Shrine of Loyalty and east to go to the Imperial Tomb.\n

steps.title: Towards the Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've got the fifth Resonance Amulet. Go to the Tablet of Vision and try communing with it.\n

steps.title: In Search of the Last Resonance Amulet
steps.description: You feel that the last Resonance Amulet is near the tablet. First, go to the tablet.\n

steps.title: Towards the Last Tablet of Vision

steps.description: Summoner Keats disappeared while trying to become an Arcana Lord. Sparky the Cat, Keats' servitor, is supposedly in the Town of Goddard. Meet him and ask him where Keats is.\n

steps.title: Meet with Keats
steps.description: Summoner Keats was cursed and turned into a frog. Searching for a way to be released from the curse, he left for the Hot Springs area. Go there, meet him and help free him from the curse. \n

steps.title: Gathering Ice Crystals
steps.description: In order to break the curse Keats is under, you must first find an Ice Crystal that is produced in the Hot Springs area. Chef Jeremy can tell you how to get one. \n

steps.title: Return to Sparky the Cat
steps.description: You've failed to break the spell that was cast upon Keats. However, he still agrees to give you the results of his research so far. Take the letter he gives you to Sparky the Cat in the Town of Goddard. \n

steps.title: Find the Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've found the Tablet of Vision that will allow you to become an Arcana Lord. Take the Resonance Amulet you received from Sparky the Cat, go to that Tablet of Vision and commune with it. \n

steps.description: You've communed with the first Tablet of Vision and also found the second Resonance Amulet! Slay the Guardians of Forbidden Knowledge and obtain the Resonance Amulet! \n

steps.description: You've obtained the second Resonance Amulet!  Now, try communing with the Tablet of Vision.

steps.title: The Third Resonance Amulet

steps.description: You've obtained the third Resonance Amulet. Now, try to commune with the Tablet of Vision. \n

steps.title: The Fourth Resonance Amulet

steps.description: In order to obtain the fourth Resonance Amulet, you must first obtain the Divine Stone of Wisdom which is currently possessed by the Ketra Orcs' Chief Shaman. First, meet with their messenger and form an alliance. Once you earn the trust of Ketra Orcs, you'll be able to obtain their Divine Stone of Wisdom.\n

steps.title: The Divine Stone of Wisdom
steps.description: In order to obtain the fourth Resonance Amulet, you must first obtain the Divine Stone of Wisdom which is currently possessed by the Varka Silenos' Chief Shaman. Once you earn the trust of the Varka Silenos, they'll give you their Divine Stone of Wisdom. \n

In order to find that evil creature, you must either enter the Four Sepulchers in the deepest part of the Imperial Tomb or go to the Shrine of Loyalty in the northeastern part of the Wall of Argos and start killing his minions there. steps.description: You feel that the last Resonance Amulet is near the tablet. First, go to the tablet.\n

steps.title: Towards the Last Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've defeated the fallen angel Tanakia and taken his Resonance Amulet. Now, try the last communion.\n

steps.title: Finishing the Journey
steps.description: The long journey has ended. Report your accomplishments to Magister Anastia.\n

steps.title: Finishing the Journey
steps.description: Train some more before you return to Magister Anastia at Hardin's Academy.\n(Only characters of level 76 or above may change their occupation to Shillien Saint. Don't abandon the quest until occupation change is complete.)\n

99.description: The legendary grail of splendor symbolizes the knowledge of the gods. It's part of the absolute geometry that Dwarven Centurions have long sought. This knowledge allows one to become a Fortune Seeker, controlling wealth and destiny!

steps.title: Meet the Dark Elf Agent
steps.description: You've heard that Pamela Aprodia, an agent for the Silver Scale Guild, is currently researching the Tablet of Vision. Go to the Town of Goddard and meet with her. \n

steps.title: Meet Information Broker Bavarin
steps.description: Bavarin, a Dwarven information broker, supposedly has detailed information regarding the Tablet of Vision. Meet him in the Hot Springs area. \n

steps.title: Searching for an Ice Crystal!
steps.description: Bavarin will tell you more about the Tablet of Vision if you bring him an Ice Crystal. Chef Jeremy can tell you how to get one.\n

steps.title: Return to the Town of Goddard
steps.description: Take the documents you received from Bavarin to Pamela Aprodia in the Town of Goddard.

steps.title: Find the Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've discovered the location of the first Tablet of Vision that contains the sacred knowledge needed to become a Fortune Seeker. Take the Resonance Amulet to the Tablet of Vision and obtain the knowledge! \n

steps.title: The Second Resonance Amulet
steps.description: You've communed with the first Tablet of Vision and also found the second Resonance Amulet! Slay the Guardians of Forbidden Knowledge and obtain the Resonance Amulet! \n

steps.title: The Second Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've obtained the second Resonance Amulet!  Now, try communing with the Tablet of Vision.\n

steps.title: The Third Resonance Amulet
steps.description: You've communed with the second Tablet of Vision! The next Resonance Amulet seems to be located very close to the third Tablet of Vision. Go there and obtain the Resonance Amulet. \n

steps.title: Third Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've obtained the third Resonance Amulet. Now, try to commune with the Tablet of Vision. \n

steps.title: The Fourth Resonance Amulet
steps.description: You've communed with the third Tablet of Vision! Now you must know where the fourth Resonance Amulet is located. Go there. \n

steps.title: Divine Stone of Wisdom
steps.description: In order to obtain the fourth Resonance Amulet, you must first obtain the Divine Stone of Wisdom which is currently possessed by the Ketra Orcs' Chief Shaman. First, meet with their messenger and form an alliance. Once you earn the trust of Ketra Orcs, you'll be able to obtain their Divine Stone of Wisdom.\n

steps.title: Divine Stone of Wisdom
steps.description: In order to obtain the fourth Resonance Amulet, you must first obtain the Divine Stone of Wisdom which is currently possessed by the Varka Silenos' Chief Shaman. First, meet with the Varka Silenos' Messenger and form an alliance with them. Once you earn the trust of the Varka Silenos, you'll be able to obtain their Divine Stone of Wisdom.\n

steps.title: The Fourth Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've obtained the Resonance Amulet! Now, go to the fourth Tablet of Vision and attempt to commune with it.\n

steps.title: The Fifth Resonance Amulet
steps.description: It seems like Pamela Aprodia has the fifth Resonance Amulet. Go meet with her. \n

steps.title: The Fifth Resonance Amulet
steps.description:
The fifth Resonance Amulet is currently owned by the Archon of Halisha. In order to find that evil creature, you must either enter the Four Sepulchers in the deepest part of the Imperial Tomb or go to the Shrine of Loyalty in the northeastern part of the Wall of Argos and start killing his minions there. Either way, you must kill the Archon of Halisha and obtain the Resonance Amulet.

Monsters to Hunt -
 Shrine of Loyalty: Grave Scarabs, Scavenger Scarabs, Grave Ants, Scavenger Ants, Shrine Knights, Shrine Guards and the Archon of Halisha 
Imperial Tomb: the Archon of Halisha
steps.completionNpcName: Entrance to the Imperial Tomb, Shrine of Loyalty

steps.title: The Fifth Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've obtained the fifth Resonance Amulet! Now, go to the Tablet of Vision and try communing with it. \n

steps.title: The Sixth Resonance Amulet
steps.description: The sixth Resonance Amulet seems to be located near the last Tablet of Vision. However, someone seems to have already gotten a hold of it. Hurry to the last Tablet of Vision! \n

steps.title: Last Tablet of Vision
steps.description: Finally, you've obtained the sixth Resonance Amulet! Now try communing with the last Tablet of Vision. \n

steps.title: Become a Fortune Seeker
steps.description: You've completed communing with the last Tablet of Vision. With this, you've acquired all the sacred knowledge required to become a Fortune Seeker. Return to Chief Inspector Mond in the Rune Township. \n

steps.title: Become a Fortune Seeker
steps.description: By communing with the last Tablet of Vision, you've acquired all the sacred knowledge you need to possess to become a Fortune Seeker. However, since your level is lower than 76, you can't transfer to that class yet. After you raise your level, go meet with Chief Inspector Mond in the Rune Township. \n

100.description: These ancient stone tablets are engraved with the very language of the gods! The knowledge contained on these Tablets of Vision could make a mortal into a Maestro with the power to make metals pour like honey!

steps.title: Meet Master Tobald
steps.description: There is a Dwarf who left before you to take the test to become a Maestro. Meet Master Tobald in the Town of Goddard to get more information about the test.

steps.title: Meet Borodin
steps.description: Wilma #3, the time machine developed and built by Master Toma, has broken down. Tobald asked his disciple, blueprint seller Borodin, to repair the time machine's cooling system. Go meet Borodin and ask him about the cooling system.

steps.title: Searching for an Ice Crystal!
steps.description: Borodin says that in order to fix the cooling system of Wilma #3, you must obtain an Ice Crystal from the Hot Springs area. Meet with Chef Jeremy to find out how to make the Ice Crystal.

steps.title: Go to Master Tobald
steps.description: Borodin has repaired the cooling system of Wilma #3!  Take the repaired machine to Master Tobald.

steps.title: Find the Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've discovered the location of the first Tablet of Vision that contains the sacred knowledge needed to become a Maestro. Take the Resonance Amulet to the Tablet of Vision and obtain the knowledge! \n

steps.title: The Second Resonance Amulet
steps.description: You've communed with the first Tablet of Vision and know where the second Resonance Amulet is! Slay the Guardians of Forbidden Knowledge and obtain the next Resonance Amulet! \n

steps.title: The Second Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've obtained the second Resonance Amulet!  Try communing with the Tablet of Vision.\n

steps.title: The Third Resonance Amulet
steps.description: You've communed with the second Tablet of Vision! The next Resonance Amulet seems to be located very close to the third Tablet of Vision. Go there and obtain the Resonance Amulet. \n

steps.title: Third Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've obtained the third Resonance Amulet. Now, try to commune with the Tablet of Vision. \n

steps.title: The Fourth Resonance Amulet
steps.description: You've communed with the third Tablet of Vision! Now you must know where the fourth Resonance Amulet is located. Go there. \n

steps.title: Divine Stone of Wisdom
steps.description: In order to obtain the fourth Resonance Amulet, you must first obtain the Divine Stone of Wisdom which is currently possessed by the Ketra Orcs' Chief Shaman. First, meet with Ketra Orcs' Messenger and form an alliance with them. Once you earn the trust of Ketra Orcs, you'll be able to obtain their Divine Stone of Wisdom.\n

steps.title: Divine Stone of Wisdom
steps.description: In order to obtain the fourth Resonance Amulet, you must first obtain the Divine Stone of Wisdom which is currently possessed by the Varka Silenos' Chief Shaman. First, meet with the Varka Silenos' Messenger and form an alliance with them. Once you earn the trust of the Varka Silenos, you'll be able to obtain their Divine Stone of Wisdom.\n

steps.title: The Fourth Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've obtained the Resonance Amulet! Now, go to the fourth Tablet of Vision and attempt to commune with it.\n

steps.title: The Fifth Resonance Amulet
steps.description: It seems like Master Tobald has the fifth Resonance Amulet. Go meet with him. \n

steps.title: The Fifth Resonance Amulet
steps.description:
The fifth Resonance Amulet is currently owned by the Archon of Halisha. In order to find that evil creature, you must either enter the Four Sepulchers in the deepest part of the Imperial Tomb or go to the Shrine of Loyalty in the northeastern part of the Wall of Argos and start killing his minions there. Either way, you must kill the Archon of Halisha and obtain the Resonance Amulet.

Monsters to Hunt -
 Shrine of Loyalty: Grave Scarabs, Scavenger Scarabs, Grave Ants, Scavenger Ants, Shrine Knights, Shrine Guards and the Archon of Halisha 
Imperial Tomb: the Archon of Halisha
steps.completionNpcName: Entrance to the Imperial Tomb, Shrine of Loyalty

steps.title: The Fifth Tablet of Vision
steps.description: You've obtained the fifth Resonance Amulet! Now, go to the Tablet of Vision and try communing with it. \n

steps.title: The Sixth Resonance Amulet
steps.description: The sixth Resonance Amulet seems to be located near the last Tablet of Vision. However, someone seems to have already gotten a hold of it. Hurry to the last Tablet of Vision! \n

steps.title: Last Tablet of Vision
steps.description: Finally, you've obtained the sixth Resonance Amulet! Now try communing with the last Tablet of Vision. \n

steps.title: Become a Maestro
steps.description: You've completed communing with the last Tablet of Vision. With this, you've acquired all the sacred knowledge you are required to possess to become a Maestro. Return to Chief Golem Craftsman Telson in the Blacksmith Shop in the Rune Township. \n

steps.title: Become a Maestro
steps.description: By communing with the last Tablet of Vision, you've acquired all the sacred knowledge you need to possess to become a Maestro. However, since your level is lower than 76, you can't transfer to that class yet. After you raise your level, go meet with Chief Golem Craftsman Telson  in the Blacksmith Shop in the Rune Township. \n

101.description: The Sword of Solidarity has long symbolized the friendship between Elves and Humans. The disappearance of the sword has coincided with the deterioration of that friendship. Grand Master Roien is seeking a warrior to restore the sword to its place of honor.

steps.title: Broken Sword
steps.description: Grand Master Roien of Cedric's Training Hall wants to restore the sword of solidarity. He explains that the sword was made long ago to symbolize the friendship between Elves and Humans. He mentions that Blacksmith Altran is also very interested in restoring this relic. He asks you to take the letter containing the results of his investigation of the relic to Altran in the Blacksmith Shop.\n

steps.title: Broken Sword Blade Piece
steps.description: Blacksmith Altran explains that if he is to restore the Sword of Solidarity to its original condition, he must have the two pieces of the blade. He asks you to go the Elven Ruins and obtain the broken sword blade pieces from the Orcs there. Hunt Tunath Orc Warriors and Tunath Orc Marksmen.\n

steps.title: Return to Blacksmith Altran
steps.description: Take the broken sword blade pieces to Blacksmith Altran.\n

steps.title: Last Parts
steps.description: While Blacksmith Altran joins the sword blade pieces together, go to Cedric's Training Hall and obtain the broken sword handle from Grand Master Roien.\n

steps.title: Sword of Solidarity
steps.description: Take the broken sword handle to Blacksmith Altran so he can restore the sword of solidarity to its original condition.\n

102.description: Sentinels who were conducting experiments in the Sea of Spores have all come down with a bad fever. Sentinel Knight Alberius is seeking someone to visit Master Cobendell to obtain the cure.

steps.title: Cure for Fever
steps.description: Sentinel Knight Alberius tells you that the Elven researchers who have recently gone to the Sea of Spores have come down with a fever.
