He is concerned about the guards he has dispatched there and asks for your help. He tells you that Master Cobendell has the cure for the fever but needs the ingredients to make the antidote. Go to Master Cobendell and help him to collect the ingredients he needs.\n

steps.title: Dryad's Tears
steps.description: You must collect dryad's tears to make the cure for the fever. Collect 10 dryad's tears in the Elven Forest and take them to Master Cobendell. Hunt dryads and dryad elders.\n

steps.title: Return to Cobendell
steps.description: You have collected all the necessary Dryad tears. Take them to Master Cobendell in the Elven Village.\n

steps.title: Medicine Created
steps.description: The medicine for the fever has been created! Take it to Sentinel Knight Alberius.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Medicine
steps.description: Sentinel Knight Alberius asks you to deliver the fever medicine to four sentinels who have gone to the Sea of Spores. Take the medicine to Sentinel Berros, Sentinel Veltress, Sentinel Rayen and Sentinel Gartrandell.\n

steps.title: Return to Sentinel Knight Alberius
steps.description: You have distributed the fever medicine. Report back to Sentinel Knight Alberius.\n

103.description: Karrod from the Dark Elf Village is the best of all Elven blacksmiths. In spite of his awesome skill, he still cannot refine oriharukon ore. Summon a Dwarf Warsmith to discover the secret!

steps.title: Method of Refining Oriharukon Ore
steps.description: The Dark Elven Blacksmith, Karrod, wishes to conjure the spirit of Warsmith Roberto Steelbender in order to learn how to refine oriharukon ore. He asks for help in summoning the dead man's spirit. Visit Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon of the Temple of Shilen.\n

steps.title: Net for Tying Up Dead Spirits
steps.description: Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon tells you that in order to summon Steelbender from the Well of Dead Souls he will need a soul catcher. Visit Magister Harne and ask her how to get a soul catcher.\n

steps.title: Ingredients for Soul Catcher
steps.description: Ten old bones are needed to make a soul catcher. Go to the School of Dark Arts, kill skeletons and bring back their bone fragments. Kill Skeleton Hunters, Archers and Doom Soldiers.\n

steps.title: Return to Harne
steps.description: You have collected all 10 bone fragments. Return to Magister Harne in Dark Elf Village and have the soul catcher made.\n

steps.title: Container to Hold Souls
steps.description: A soul catcher has been created! Take it to Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon.\n

steps.title: Zombie's Head
steps.description: The preparations for summoning Steelbender have almost all been completed. All that remains is to obtain a zombie head to temporarily hold the spirit. Go to the Swampland, kill a zombie and bring back its head. Hunt Marsh Zombies.\n

steps.title: Return to Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon
steps.description: You have applied the preserving oil to the zombie head. Take it to Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon before it begins to rot.\n

steps.title: Steelbender Head
steps.description: Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon has conjured the soul of Steelbender by using the soul catcher. He then channels the spirit into the zombie head. Take it to Blacksmith Karrod before it starts to rot.\n

104.description: Three Spirits of Mirror have escaped from Magister Gallint's laboratory on Talking Island! Capture and seal these spirits!

steps.title: Escaped Spirits
steps.description:
The spirits of mirrors that Grand Magister Gallint was studying have escaped! Hit each one of them with Gallint's oak wand to seal them. Seal all three and return to Gallint. The guards in the village can tell you where to find the spirits.

Monsters that need to be sealed by Gallint's Oak Wand - 3 spirits of mirrors.

steps.title: Location of the Spirits
steps.description:
The spirits of mirrors that Grand Magister Gallint was studying have escaped! Hit each one of them with Gallint's oak wand to seal them. Seal all three and return to Gallint. You will find one of them on the western shore of the island, another near the bridge west of Einhovant's School of Wizardry and the third can be found near the Obelisk of Victory.

Monsters that need to be sealed by Gallint's Oak Wand - 3 spirits of mirrors.

steps.title: Return to Grand Magister Gallint
steps.description: You have sealed all three of the spirits of mirrors with Gallint's oak wand! Return to Grand Magister Gallint.\n

105.description: Kaboo Orcs from the Misty Mountains have invaded the Elven Forest again. Help Sentinel Kendell and the Elven Fighters defeat the invaders and take the head of the Orc Captain!

steps.title: Guardian of the Forest
steps.description: Orcs have recently made several attacks upon the Elven Forest. The Elves have decided to take their revenge upon the Kaboo Orcs in the Misty Mountains. Read the order from Sentinel Kendell and hunt the Orcs!\n

steps.title: Return to Sentinel Kendell
steps.description: You have destroyed the Kaboo Orcs! Report to Sentinel Kendell.\n

steps.title: The Second Order
steps.description: The war has not yet been won. Kaboo Orcs are massing around Iris Lake in the southern part of the village and are preparing to launch an invasion! You must follow Sentinel Kendell's orders! Slay the Kaboo Orcs!\n

steps.title: Return to Sentinel Kendell Again
steps.description: You've successfully accomplished Kendell's second order! Return to Sentinel Kendell in the Elven Village and make your report to him.\n

106.description: The infamous Orc Brigand has stolen Kaysha's Revelations! Retrieve this vital document to secure the future of all Dark Elves!

steps.title: "Kaysha's Revelations"
steps.description: Dark Elven Tetrarch Thifiell asked Abyssal Celebrant Kartia to translate an ancient manuscript. He now asks you to retrieve the translated copy of "Kaysha's Revelations". You must be very discreet.\n

steps.title: In Search of the Stolen Revelations
steps.description: You hear that "Kaysha's Revelations" was stolen by Tumran Orcs! Kill the Tumran Orc brigands that were last seen camping near the Altar of Rites, and recover the original copy of "Kaysha's Revelations" and a clay tablet.\n

steps.title: Return to Abyssal Celebrant Kartia
steps.description: You have recovered the ancient scroll and clay tablet. Abyssal Celebrant Kartia is waiting for you.\n

steps.title: Translation of the Completed Revelations
steps.description: The translation of "Kaysha's Revelations" is complete. Tetrarch Thifiell is waiting for you.\n

107.description: The exiled traitor Baranka schemes to overthrow the kingdom of the Orcs! Reveal his wicked plot and destroy him! Dejakar Oroka!

steps.title: Stop Baranka's Conspiracy!
steps.description: Baranka, Shaman of Darkness, is scheming to destroy the kingdom of the Orcs. Urutu Chief Hatos has learned of his plot, and has ordered the elimination of all of Baranka's followers. Kill them all! Centurion Parugon will tell you where to find them.\n

steps.title: Catch Baranka's Messenger!
steps.description: Baranka's messengers and escorts are advancing from the far eastern Immortal Plateau to the Frozen Waterfalls! Kill them all!\n

steps.title: Discovery of the secret letter!
steps.description: You have recovered a secret letter from Baranka's messenger. Take it to Urutu Chief Hatos.\n

steps.title: Are there more secret letters?
steps.description:
Baranka must have sent more than one secret letter! Find Baranka's messengers and try to find other secret letters!

 Monsters to Hunt - Baranka's messengers.

steps.title: A second secret letter discovered!
steps.description: You've found another secret letter! Take it to Urutu Chief Hatos.\n

steps.title: Further intrigues!
steps.description:
This can't be the end! Search harder!

 Monsters to Hunt - Baranka's messengers.

steps.title: Discovery of the third secret letter!
steps.description: You've found another secret letter! Take it to Urutu Chief Hatos.\n

108.description: The Star Diamond is one of only 12 on the entire continent! The Dwarves are planning a Jumble, Tumble, Diamond Fuss!

steps.title: In Search of a Star Diamond!
steps.description: Collector Gouph of the Bronze Key Guild has purchased a rare star diamond from Trader Reep of the Silver Scales Guild. It is one of only twelve on the continent! Three days have past since the agreed-upon delivery date and Gouph is becoming impatient. He asks you to go to Trader Reep, retrieve the star diamond and bring it to him.\n

steps.title: Carrier Torocco
steps.description: Trader Reep informs you that he gave the star diamond to Carrier Torocco to deliver to Gouph. Find Torocco and ask him about the diamond.\n

steps.title: Booze can make you lose!
steps.description: Torocco got drunk with Miner Maron last night and passed out. When he awoke, his weapons, armor, money and even the star diamond had been stolen! Find Maron and ask him what happened.\n

steps.title: Gambling can make you a loser, too!
steps.description: Carrier Torocco is usually quite trustworthy, but.when he starts drinking he inevitably starts gambling. He got drunk last night and lost everything he had in a dice game with Blacksmith Brunon. Could this mean that Blacksmith Brunon has the star diamond?\n

steps.title: Brunon's Request
steps.description: Indeed, Blacksmith Brunon won the star diamond in a dice game! He tells you that he will give it to you if you recover the aquamarine and chrysoberyl that were stolen by a goblin brigand lieutenant.\n

steps.title: Return to Blacksmith Brunon
steps.description: You have recovered the aquamarines and chrysoberyls that Blacksmith Brunon lost. Take them to him.\n

steps.title: Gem Box
steps.description: Brunon gives you the gem box he says he won in a dice game. Take it to Gouph.\n

steps.title: Useless Coal
steps.description: The gem box doesn't contain the star diamond, only a strange looking piece of coal! Return to Blacksmith Brunon and demand an explanation!\n

steps.title: A Chest of Mistaken Identity
steps.description: The piece of coal once belonged to Warehouse Freightman Murdoc. Take the letter from Brunon to Murdoc and exchange it for the gem box that contains the star diamond.\n

steps.title: The Diamond Is Gone!
steps.description: The star diamond was eaten by a bat that Warehouse Keeper Airy keeps as a pet! The bat escaped out of an open window! Go quickly and speak with Airy!\n

steps.title: Who keeps a bat as a pet, anyway?
steps.description: Warehouse Keeper Airy asks you to find her pet, a blade bat. Kill the bat and get the diamond.\n

steps.title: Small Sacrifice, Great Reward
steps.description: You finally recover the star diamond. Pray for the soul of the poor bat then take the star diamond to Collector Gouph.\n

109.description: According to the information gathered by the Golden Ram Mercenary Army, the Stakatos have a vile nest where they live and breed. Pierce is trying to find the entrance of the nest.

steps.title: Find the Scout
steps.description: Mercenary Captain Pierce asks you to discover the fate of the scout he sent out. Follow the scout's path to see what happened. \n

steps.title: Return to Pierce
steps.description: You discovered a letter on the scout's corpse. Deliver it to Mercenary Captain Pierce. \n

steps.title: Go to Kahman
steps.description: Mercenary Captain Pierce thanks you and tells you to see Kahman for your reward. \n

110.description: Anton of the Rune Township library gives you an ancient book and asks you to deliver it to Marquez on the Primeval Isle Wharf.

steps.title: Ancient Creatures and How I Long To Be With Them
steps.description: Anton of the Rune Township library gives you an ancient book and asks you to deliver it to Marquez on the Primeval Isle Wharf. \n

111.description: On Primeval Isle, where primitive creatures abound, the natives are said to have a special skill for hunting dinosaurs. To learn it, you must first win the trust of these natives...

steps.title: Find the Elrokian Chief Mushika
steps.description: They say the Elroki tribe, native to the Primeval Isle, possesses a mysterious skill which allows its people to effortlessly hunt dinosaurs. Find the Elrokian chief and ask him about that skill. \n

steps.title: Find the Chief's Son
steps.description: The Elrokian chief Mushika is gravely ill, and it is difficult to speak with him. Speak with his son instead. \n

steps.title: Return to Marquez
steps.description: You speak with Asamah, the chief's son, but he turns you away because you are an outsider. Return to Marquez and find a way to win the friendship of the Elroki tribe. \n

steps.title: Retrieve the Diary Fragments from the Velociraptors
steps.description:
To become a friend of the Elroki tribe, you must know their traditional song. To learn it, defeat the Velociraptors that killed the expedition member who was searching for clues about the song and retrieve the fragments of his diary. The Velociraptors are said to roam the Primeval Isle's "Lost Nest." 

 Monster to Hunt: Velociraptor.

steps.title: Take the Diary Fragments to Marquez
steps.description: You have collected all the diary fragments. Return to Marquez. \n

steps.title: Find Hunter Kirikachin
steps.description: According to the diary, an old Elrokian hunter named Kirikachin may be willing to teach the song to an outsider. Find him, deliver the letter and learn the song. \n

steps.title: Kirikachin's Sorrow
steps.description: After reading the letter, Kirikachin seems very sad. Comfort him and learn the song. \n

steps.title: Song of the Warrior
steps.description: You have learned the sad but proud Elrokian tune, the "Warrior's Song." Go to Asamah, the chief's son, and sing it to him. \n

steps.title: Friend of the Elroki Tribe
steps.description: You sing before Asamah, and all the Elrokians nearby join in the Warrior's Song. The act wins you the friendship of the Elroki tribe, and Asamah is now willing to speak with you. \n

steps.title: Practice Trap Parts
steps.description:
As a friend of the Elroki tribe, you can now learn their mysterious skill. To prepare to learn it, hunt the following dinosaurs and bring back the parts and ingredients needed to craft the perfect trap. 

 Monsters to Hunt: Ornithomimus, Deinonychus, Pachycephalosaurus.

steps.title: Deliver Trap Parts to Asamah
steps.description: You have collected all the parts necessary to create the perfect trap. Return to Asamah. \n

steps.title: Learn Trapping Skills from Kirikachin
steps.description: You have received a trap from Asamah. Go to Kirikachin to learn how to use it. \n

112.description: Livina feels negative energy from the direction of the Crypts of Disgrace.

steps.title: Meet With Karuda
steps.description: The Seer Livina asks you to meet with Karuda and ensure that there are no problems. \n

113.description: Moira wants the box containing the flame of the holy spirit taken to the Beacon Tower because the power of Pa'agrio is growing weaker there.

steps.title: Go to the Beacon Tower
steps.description: The Seer Moira feels that the energy of Pa'agrio is diminishing from the Beacon Tower and asks you to deliver the box, containing the energy of fire, to the Tower so that it may light during an emergency. \n

114.description: Riddles are hidden within the Pavel Ruins.  What great mystery lies there?

steps.title: In Search of Yumi
steps.description: Collector Yumi is looking for a person willing to work in the Pavel Laboratory. Meet with her.\n

steps.title: In Search of a Wise Man
steps.description: Collector Yumi asks you to gather information about the strange building in the south and whoever is living there. Visit an adviser who can tell you more about the building.\n

steps.title: Return to Yumi
steps.description: The building in the south belongs to Dr. Chaos, and the Golem, Wendy, lives there by herself. The conversation with her wasn't bad. Return to Yumi.\n

steps.title: Return to Yumi
steps.description: The building in the south belongs to Dr. Chaos, and the Golem, Wendy, lives there by herself. Wendy suspects a great deal. Return to Yumi.\n

steps.title: Return to Yumi
steps.description: The building in the south belongs to Dr. Chaos, and the Golem, Wendy, lives there by herself. Wendy's attitude is matter-of-fact. Return to Yumi.\n

steps.title: Things to Know
steps.description: Yumi thinks Wendy has the information necessary to solve the riddles. She asks you to talk to Wendy.\n

steps.title: Angry Wendy
steps.description: Wendy is ill-tempered and gives you the cold shoulder. Try talking to her again.\n

steps.title: Wendy's Friend
steps.description: Wendy mentioned her "gigantic" friend. Could this be a clue? Ask her for more details!\n

steps.title: Wendy's Gigantic Friend
steps.description: Wendy's "gigantic" friend was a Golem Commander! Return to Collector Yumi to discuss this with her.\n

steps.title: Wendy's Guardian
steps.description: Wendy says she cannot give you any information, and if you try to force her to answer she will fight! Defeat Wendy's Guardian and show her who's boss!\n

steps.title: Talk to Wendy
steps.description: You've defeated Wendy's Guardian. Now, Wendy will talk.\n

steps.title: Golem Controller
steps.description: Wendy says there is a device that transmits radio signals to control the Golems. What can it be? Return to Collector Yumi.\n

steps.title: Find Starstone
steps.description: Wendy needs the Starstone to recover her memory. She says it's in a box nearby.\n

steps.title: Energy to Recover Memory
steps.description: You have the Starstone in your hands. Return to Wendy and give it to her.\n

steps.title: Energy Supply
steps.description: Wendy is receiving energy from the Starstone. Talk to her in a little while.\n

steps.title: Former Controller
steps.description: Wendy's recovered memories reveal that she was in charge of the transportation and management of goods. Her friend, Atlanta, was in charge of controlling various Golems. Return to Yumi.\n

steps.title: Radio Signal Transmitter
steps.description: The information you've learned reveals there is a hidden transmitter sending out radio signals.  Search for the transmitter with the signal detector that Yumi gave you!\n

steps.title: Radio Signal Detector's Response
steps.description: The signal detector responded to something nearby. Look for it.\n

steps.title: Identity of the Transmitter
steps.description: The detector responded to the strange stack of stones engraved with the symbol of the Giants. Return to Collector Yumi and report what you've learned.\n

steps.title: Get Starstone
steps.description: Give the stack of stones to Wendy to get the Starstone. Find Wendy.\n

steps.title: Go to the Village
steps.description: Bring the stack of stones to the Dwarf Guild to get the Starstone. Find the Head Blacksmith Newyear of the Town of Schuttgart!\n

steps.title: Return to Yumi
steps.description: You have received the Starstone from Newyear. Return to Yumi.\n

steps.title: The Starstone in the Box
steps.description: The Starstone is in a wooden box in the back. The box is unlocked, so retrieve the Starstone.\n

steps.title: Starstone Acquired
steps.description: You have the Starstone! Return to Wendy.\n

steps.title: Return to Yumi
steps.description: You can use the Starstone after you return to Yumi.\n

steps.title: Return to Yumi
steps.description: You paid money for the Starstone. Return to Yumi.\n

steps.title: Go to the Stack of Stones
steps.description: Yumi says that if you place the Starstone near the stack of stones that triggered the signal detector, something interesting will happen. Go to the stack of stones!\n

115.description: Rafforty is recruiting adventurers to help the Zinnia Guild.

steps.title: Meet With Misa
steps.description: Rafferty asks you to speak with a woman named Misa at Frost Lake. Your meeting is scheduled for after nightfall, so you must travel in the dark. \n

steps.title: Letter for Rafforty
steps.description: Misa tells you to give her letter to Rafforty. \n

steps.title: Under Suspicion?
steps.description: Rafforty is sorry that he doubted you.\n

steps.title: Sudden Offer
steps.description: Rafforty says that he belongs to the Zinnia Guild and asks for your help. \n

steps.title: Momentary Wait
steps.description: Rafforty says he has heard a different story, and asks you to come back later.\n

steps.title: Go Back to Misa
steps.description: Rafferty tells you that he has received new information from Misa. He asks you to meet with her after nightfall, so you'll have to travel in the dark. \n

steps.title: In Search of the Ice Sculpture
steps.description: Misa says the missing informants have already been turned into ice sculptures. Go and find them. \n

steps.title: Whereabouts of Kierre
steps.description: You have obtained the information about Kierre's whereabouts. Go to Kierre.\n

steps.title: Go to Rafforty
steps.description: You have obtained a report from Kierre, who now is an ice sculpture. Take the report to Rafforty.\n

steps.title: Decypher the Cryptogram
steps.description: Rafforty asks you to wait while he decodes the cryptogram.  \n

steps.title: In Search of Tablet Fragment
steps.description: Rafforty needs the Tablet Fragments for his decryption spell. You remember seeing the fragments. Go to the place where the ice sculptures are located. \n

steps.title: Go to Rafforty
steps.description: You've found the Tablet Fragments. Return to Rafforty.\n

116.description: The Dwarven Village is frozen. If you travel along the route of the southbound railroad and over the icy hill, you will come to the Plunderous Plains.

steps.title: Goods Purchased for Filaur
steps.description: Gray Pillar's Filaur says he needs you to bring him the following items:\n20 Bandages, 5 Energy Stones, 10 Keys of the Thief.  When you get them all, return to Gray Pillar's Filaur.\n

steps.title: Delivery for the Railroad Worker
steps.description: Gray Pillar's Filaur has asked you to deliver supplies to Railroad Worker Obi in the Plunderous Plains just beyond the passage to the mining areas.\n

117.description: The railroad worker is haunted by a ghost who appears every night. What is the reason for the ghost's appearances? What is the Dwarf's dream?

steps.title: Abey's Deep Sleep
steps.description: Railroad Worker Abey cannot sleep because of the strange sounds she hears. Wait here until nightfall and tell Abey if something strange happens.\n\n

steps.title: Ghost's Request
steps.description: Railroad Worker

steps.title: Go to Railroad Worker Abey
steps.description: Railroad Worker Obi says he doesn't know anything about the ghost. He tells you to talk to Abey when she wakes up in the afternoon.\n

steps.title: Search the Box
steps.description: She thinks the hammer the ghost mentioned is probably in a box in the back of the station. \n

steps.title: Go to Abey
steps.description: You've found the ancient hammer in the box. Take it to Railroad Worker Abey.\n

steps.title: Hammer of Riddles
steps.description: Railroad Worker Obi

steps.title: Find the Lost Book
steps.description:
The book written about the Sky Wagon was stolen! Defeat the Bandits and recover the book.

Monsters to Hunt: Bandit Inspector, Bandit Warrior

steps.title: Return to Obi
steps.description: You have rescued the book from the Bandits' clutches. Return to Railroad Worker Obi.\n

steps.title: The Original Hammer Owner
steps.description: The hammer was used when the Sky Wagon was developed in the past. It seems like the ghost was one of the construction workers at that time. Take the hammer to the ghost. The ghost appears only at night.\n
steps.completionNpcName: Ghost of an Ancient Railroad Engineer

steps.title: Go to the Sky Wagon Relic
steps.description: Having lost all hope, the Ghost of an Ancient Railroad Engineer asks you to meet his friend at the Sky Wagon Relic.\n

118.description: Blacksmith Pinter of the Town of Gludio makes armor that only members of the Clan Academy can wear.

steps.title: Slay the Maille Lizardman
steps.description:
Blacksmith Pinter of the Town of Gludio tells you to bring him the materials necessary to make Clan Academy armor.
Get 10 botttles of Maille Lizardman Blood.

Monsters to Hunt - Maille Lizardman, Maille Lizardman Scout, Maille Lizardman Guard

steps.title: Go to Pinter
steps.description: You have collected all the Lizardmen's blood needed. Return to Blacksmith Pinter.\n

steps.title: Get Help from Sponsor
steps.description: Blacksmith Pinter tells you he needs 922 D-Grade crystals to make heavy armor. Your Sponsor must acquire the necessary crystals and take them to Pinter.\n

steps.title: Get Help from Sponsor
steps.description: Blacksmith Pinter tells you he needs 771 D-Grade crystals to make light armor. Your Sponsor must acquire the necessary crystals and take them to Pinter.\n

steps.title: Get Help from Sponsor
steps.description: Blacksmith Pinter tells you he needs 771 D-Grade crystals to make the robe. Your Sponsor must acquire the necessary crystals and take them to Pinter.\n

steps.title: Go to Pinter
steps.description: Your Sponsor gave Blacksmith Pinter the crystals necessary for making the armor. Blacksmith Pinter has a message for you. Go to Pinter.\n

steps.title: Defeat the King of the Araneid
steps.description:
Blacksmith Pinter finally tells you to defeat the King of the Araneid in the Maille Lizardmen Barracks and collect 8 legs. You must defeat the King of the Araneid while your Sponsor is watching.

Monster to Hunt - The King of the Araneid

steps.title: Go to Pinter
steps.description: You've collected all the King of the Araneid's legs. Return to Blacksmith Pinter.\n

119.description: The Nameless Spirit at the entrance to the 4th Sepulcher needs mortal help to pass through the magic force field created by his double.

steps.title: Go to Nurse Devorin
steps.description: The Nameless Spirit asks you to meet Nurse Devorin in the Rune Township and learn the lyrics of the lullaby he listened to when he was young.\nGo to Devorin in the Rune Township.

steps.title: Return to the Nameless Spirit
steps.description: You listened to the lyrics of the lullaby sung by Nurse Devorin. Return to the Nameless Spirit.\n

120.description: The old relics have been awakened by mistake. Enormous energy is flowing in. Stop the approaching danger!

steps.title: Atlanta
steps.description: The stack of stones says its name is Atlanta. Why did it awaken Atlanta?\n

steps.title: The Child who was With Atlanta
steps.description: The stack of stones that identified itself as Atlanta asks you to look for a child who was with it. Where is the child?\n

steps.title: Go To Wendy
steps.description: Yumi thinks that the child is a Golem and tells you to speak to Wendy first.\n

steps.title: Wendy
steps.description: There is something suspicious about Wendy. Go to Wendy!\n

steps.title: Object to Recover Memory
steps.description: Wendy says she cannot recover her lost memories about Atlanta without help. You think you know who can help her. Go see him.\n

steps.title: One Flower Stem
steps.description: Atlanta gave you a flower saying that it was a fragment of the child. Will it restore Wendy's memory?\n

steps.title: Time to Think
steps.description: Wendy says something may be coming back to her, but she needs more time to think. Go back to Yumi and report.\n

steps.title: Doctor Chaos's Past
steps.description: Yumi told you about the history of the ruins. If the Guardian Golem that Dr. Chaos awoke is revived, it will be disastrous! Go to Wendy and ask her about Dr. Chaos's activities.\n

steps.title: Arrival of Eternal Spring
steps.description: Wendy knows that Dr. Chaos has created some sort of device. In order to find out what it is, go to Atlanta and ask about "N.45 Arrival of Eternal Spring."\n

steps.title: Core of the North Wing
steps.description: Atlanta's password will allow you to enter the North Wing, which is the primary area of the experiment. Memorize the password and go to the Weathermaster in the North Wing.\nLearn about the lab's security devices before progressing further.\n

steps.title: Password Approved
steps.description: The password has been approved! Now you must stop the prototype of the Arrival of Eternal Spring.\n

steps.title: Terminated Prototype
steps.description: You've terminated the core of the North Wing operation. Go back to Atlanta and report the situation.\n

steps.title: Incidents in the East Wing
steps.description: Atlanta, stuttering, says that you must find out what is occuring in the East Wing, the management building. Wendy knows what happened there. Go to Wendy!\n

steps.title: Locked Up Book
steps.description: Wendy woke up in the East Wing, but her memory is not intact. Go to the shelf and find the locked book. Be careful, the shelf might be trapped!\n

steps.title: Closed Book
steps.description: You bypassed all the traps and retrieved the book!\nBut how do you use it? Perhaps Yumi or Wendy knows.\n

steps.title: The Key Yumi Found
steps.description: Yumi gave you the key she found while investigating the laboratory. Double click the key to read the report, then talk to Yumi.\n

steps.title: Core of the East Wing
steps.description: The East Wing's password is probably Wendy's code number! Memorize the code and go to the East Wing.\nBe sure to remember where the entrance is.\n

steps.title: Controlling Core of the East Wing
steps.description: The password has been accepted! Study the energy currents in the laboratory and eliminate any dangers!\n

steps.title: Return to Atlanta
steps.description: You've stopped the dangers in the East Wing and discovered the password for the West Wing. Doing anything further is impossible without Pavel. Return now to Atlanta.\n

steps.title: Stop the Last Study
steps.description: Atlanta asks you to stop the last experiment, "N. 45 Arrival of Eternal Spring," which is being conducted in the West Wing. Go to the West Wing!\n

steps.title: Is the Eternal Spring Coming?
steps.description: The password has been approved. Stop the final project!\n

steps.title: Speak of the Never Coming Spring
steps.description: You have terminated the project, "N. 45 Arrival of Eternal Spring." You've been injured, but you should return to Atlanta to report the results of your mission!\n

steps.title: The Successor of Stone Balance
steps.description: Atlanta doesn't show any reaction. Just as you expected.\n

steps.title: A Final Message
steps.description: Atlanta left a message with Wendy. Ask Wendy for the message.\n

steps.title: The End of the Story
steps.description: Wendy told you everything about Dr. Chaos and the terrifying Golem Army. Return to Yumi and tell her the story.\n

121.description: The Pavel Ruins are near Schuttgart Village. What's going on there?

steps.title: Find the Collector Yumi
steps.description: Collector Yumi will be waiting for you in the Dwarven barracks located at Pavel Ruins. Meet with her and make haste.\n

122.description: Moira received a revelation from Pa'agrio that a journey to the Crypts of Disgrace is destined.

steps.title: Go to Karuda
steps.description: Moira says that if you travel west along the path leading out of town, you will meet Karuda, who will end your wandering. Walk along the path.\n

123.description: Head Blacksmith Newyear of the Town of Schuttgart makes armor that only members of the Clan Academy can wear.

steps.title: Slay the Bruin Lizardman
steps.description:
Head Blacksmith Newyear of the Town of Schuttgart tells you to bring him the materials necessary to make Clan Academy armor.
Go south of the Town of Schuttgart and get 10 bottles of Bruin Lizardman Blood.

Monster to Hunt - Bruin Lizardman
steps.completionNpcName: South of the Town of Schuttgart

steps.title: Go to Newyear
steps.description: You've collected all the lizardmen's blood needed. Return to Head Blacksmith Newyear.\n

steps.title: Get Help from Sponsor
steps.description: Head Blacksmith Newyear says he needs 922 D-Grade crystals to make heavy armor. Your Sponsor must acquire the necessary crystals and take them to Newyear.\n

steps.title: Get Help from Sponsor
steps.description: Head Blacksmith Newyear says he needs 771 D-Grade crystals to make light armor. Your Sponsor has to get the necessary crystals and then go to Newyear.\n

steps.title: Get Help from Sponsor
steps.description: Head Blacksmith Newyear says he needs 771 D-Grade crystals to make the robe. Your Sponsor has to get the necessary crystals and then go to Newyear.\n

steps.title: Go to Newyear
steps.description: Your Sponsor gave Newyear the crystals necessary for making the armor. Head Blacksmith Newyear has a message for you. Go to Newyear.\n

steps.title: Repulse the Picot Araneid
steps.description:
Head Blacksmith Newyear finally tells you to defeat Picot Araneid and bring back his 8 legs. He can be found southwest of the Town of Schuttgart. You must defeat Picot Araneid while your Sponsor is watching.

Monster to Hunt - Picot Araneid
steps.completionNpcName: Southwest of the Town of Schuttgart

steps.title: Go to Newyear
steps.description: You've collected all of Picot Araneid's legs. Return to the Head Blacksmith Newyear.\n

124.description: The old Primeval Isle explorer Marquez has received a letter from his friend, the Elroki chief Mushika. The chief asks Marquez to send him a brave young adventurer who can search the island for a cure for his mysterious illness.

steps.title: Marquez's Request
steps.description: The Humans and the Elrokians are currently hostile towards each other. Nevertheless, at the Primeval Isle's wharf, the old explorer Marquez asks you to help the Elroki tribe.

steps.title: Mushika's Letter
steps.description: Marquez is an old friend of Elroki Chief Mushika, who lives on the Primeval Plains. Marquez tells you that Mushika is deathly ill and needs the help of an adventurer to find the cure. Travel inland to meet with Asamah, the chief's son, in order to learn the details. \n

steps.title: Mushika: Near Death
steps.description: Mushika is too ill to speak coherently. Speak with his son Asamah instead. \n

steps.title: The Location of the Mysterious Medicine
steps.description: Asamah has learned of the existence of a miraculous medicine that can cure his father Mushika's illness. To find the medicine, you must first meet with the powerful Elroki shaman Karakawei. \n

steps.title: Mantarasa Egg
steps.description: The Elroki shaman Karakawei says that in order to cure Mushika's illness, you must find the Mantarasa Egg, which is located somewhere on the Primeval Isle.

steps.title: Acquiring the Mysterious Medicine
steps.description: You have obtained the Mantarasa Egg, which can restore Mushika to health. Take it to Asamah, who is anxiously awaiting the cure. \n

125.description: Thanks to the miraculous medicine, Mushika recovers from his illness. But he is more worried about the strange events occurring on the island than about his own health. He asks for your help in obtaining the epitaph he needs to discover the cause.  It may be found at the ancient stone monument located near the Lost Nest.

steps.title: The Elroki Tribe's Dilemma
steps.description: Following his recovery, Chief Mushika claims that his illness is somehow connected with the Lost Nest. He asks for your help in investigating its cause, which he says may affect the future of the entire Elroki people. \n

steps.title: By the Power of Shamanism!
steps.description: Mushika believes that a danger to the Elroki lurks within the Lost Nest. He says that he needs the help of the Elrokian shaman Karakawei and asks you to go and meet with him. \n

steps.title: Special Ritual
steps.description: Shaman Karakawei is preparing a special ritual to call forth the souls of the ancient Elrokians.To perform the ritual, he needs you to hunt certain dinosaurs and bring back their bones and claws. \n\n Monsters to Hunt: Ornithomimus, Deinonychus

steps.title: Ritual Ingredients
steps.description: You have gathered all the Ornithomimus Claws and Deinonychus Bones needed for the ritual. Give the ingredients to Karakawei so he can begin the ceremony. \n

steps.title: Find the Stone Statue!
steps.description: Thanks to Karakawei's ritual, you have learned the location of the stone statue and the means of communicating with it. Speak to the stone about the relic that Mushika gave you. \n

steps.title: Find Balu Kaimu
steps.description: Ulu Kaimu confirmed that it is an ancient Pillar of Wisdom, but it does not possess full information about the relic. It tells you to find its kin, another Pillar named Balu Kaimu, and seek knowledge about the relic there. \n

steps.title: Hope in Chuta Kaimu
steps.description: Balu Kaimu was also unable to tell you much about the ancient relic. It does, however, tell you about Chuta Kaimu, yet another Pillar of Wisdom and suggests you show it the relic. \n

steps.title: Outsider of Fate
steps.description: Chuta Kaimu informs you that the relic is a fragment of an ancient Elrokian weapon. It asks you to take an Epitaph of Wisdom back to the Elrokian chief Mushika.

126.description: Asamah suspects that there is some link between the axe Gazkh's magical seal and the strange events occurring on the island. In order to discover the cause, he asks you to seek out the three Kaimus and to bring back their wisdom on the matter.

steps.title: An Impossible Problem
steps.description: While analyzing the Epitaph of Wisdom, Asamah has learned of a magical axe called Gazkh wielded by his ancestors. But there is something that cannot be discovered using only the Epitaph, and he asks for your help in obtaining the knowledge he needs.

steps.title: Find the Pillars of Wisdom Again
steps.description: Asamah believes that the Gazkh fragment somehow caused Mushika's illness, and he suspects that the abnormal events occurring throughout the island are also related to the magical axe. Visit Ulu Kaimu for more information. \n

steps.title: Dialogue with Ulu Kaimu
steps.description: You have obtained the power necessary to awaken and question the sleeping Ulu Kaimu. Seek it's wisdom about the relationship between the strange events occurring throughout the island and the fragment of Gazkh. \n

steps.title: The Melody
steps.description: While speaking with Ulu Kaimu, you heard the first verse of the unknown melody. You do not know its significance, but suspect that it may be an important clue. Memorize it. \n

steps.title: Find Balu Kaimu
steps.description: Ulu Kaimu was unable to completely answer the question. Instead, it tells you to find its kin, Balu Kaimu, and to seek additional knowledge there. \n

steps.title: Coming to an Understanding with Balu Kaimu
steps.description: You find Balu Kaimu and begin communication. Conduct the conversation more carefully this time in order to obtain the desired response. \n

steps.title: The Decisive Tune
steps.description: While speaking with Balu Kaimu, you hear a melody similar to the one you heard from Ulu Kaimu. It definitely seems to be important, so memorize it well. \n

steps.title: The Revealed Truth
steps.description: Balu Kaimu is able to give you a more substantial answer, and it even tells you that the unknown melody is a song once beloved by the ancient Elrokian warriors. To hear the rest of the story, though, you must find Chuta Kaimu. \n

steps.title: Gazkh and the Isle
steps.description: You finally communicate with Chuta Kaimu, the last of the Pillars of Wisdom. Listen to its tale about Gazkh and the strange events occurring throughout the island. \n

steps.title: Song of Lament
steps.description: Chuta Kaimu says that the axe Gazkh longs for its long-dead owner. It also tells you that the melody you heard from the other two Pillars of Wisdom is the song that Gazkh's owner loved to sing. Be sure to memorize this melody. \n

steps.title: Warrior's Grave
steps.description: Chuta Kaimu advises you to find the grave of Gazkh's former owner and pray for the warrior's soul. \n

steps.title: Tribute to the Unknown Warrior
steps.description: You find a single grave at the spot Chuta Kaimu told you about. Perhaps it is the final resting place of Gazkh's former owner. Try praying there. \n

steps.title: Spirit of the Elrokian Warrior
steps.description: You spoke with the soul of the Elrokian warrior who lies buried in the forgotten grave. You begin to see the connection between Gazkh and the strange events on the island. Listen to his story carefully. \n

steps.title: A Memorial Service
steps.description: The Elrokian warrior's soul says that for you to become a true warrior able to wield Gazkh, you will need his ashes. Before obtaining them, you must first perform a proper memorial service. \n

steps.title: A Memorial Service
steps.description: You correctly sang the melody of the first verse of the Warrior's Song!  Attempt the second verse. \n

steps.title: Sing the Second Verse
steps.description: You succeeded in singing the second verse! Now only the last verse remains. If you sing it correctly, you can properly perform the memorial service. \n

steps.title: The Warrior's Song Calms the Soul
steps.description: You successfully completed the third verse. Now speak with the Elroki warrior's spirit and obtain the ashes of his bones. \n

steps.title: Find the Seal Stone
steps.description: You have obtained the ancient Elrokian warrior's ashes. Take them to the Seal Stone that guards Sailren the dinosaur and you will learn how to handle the axe Gazkh. \n

steps.title: The Seal Stone's Warning
steps.description: You found the Seal Stone, which revealed itself to be Shilen's Stone Statue. After hearing about the events on the island, the statue warns you that the seal over Sailren has been broken and even worse things may soon occur. Find out how you can control Sailren. \n

steps.title: A True Elrokian Warrior
steps.description: Shilen's Stone Statue, which reveals itself as Shilen's Avatar, has bestowed on you the right to wield Gazkh in Shilen's stead. Now you must find the location of all the fragments of Gazkh. Return to Asamah and tell him these things. \n

steps.title: The Location of Gazkh
steps.description: You have told Asamah about your experience in the Lost Nest. Ask what he has learned about the Gazkh fragment while you were gone. \n

steps.title: Return to Mushika
steps.description: Asamah has not learned much about the fragment, but tells you that his father Mushika has discovered something important. Go meet with him. \n

steps.title: The Scroll's Hidden Password
steps.description: Using a secret code hidden in the ancient scroll, Mushika has finally discovered the location of the remaining Gazkh fragments! Hear what the code says and learn what you must do to retrieve the fragments. \n

127.description: Priest Dominic of the Rune Township is looking for an adventurer who will be able to successfully execute a special and secretive task. This task is in regards to the appearance of the new race called the Kamael; He says that your task is to meet with one representative from each race and find out their position and their desired terms...

steps.title: Amplified Curiosity
steps.description: Priest Dominic of Rune Township spoke to me about the strange Kamael, amplifying my curiosity. He said that if I go see Klaus Blackbird of Oren, I will be able to hear more details about the Kamael.\n

steps.title: An Opportunity for the Humans
steps.description: Klaus Blackbird of Oren Township said that the Kamael will be the ones to revive the human race and insists that the authority over the Kamael be transferred to the humans. \n

steps.title: Find the Collaborators!
steps.description: He wants me to gather the thoughts of the other races, in regards to the Kamael, and deliver them to Dominic. If I find the collaborators from the other races working to exclude the humans, listen to their stories, and bring back a voucher, then my task will be complete. The first subject is Warehouse Chief Alder in the Town of Schuttgart. \n

steps.title: Enter the Dwarves
steps.description: Warehouse Chief Alder of the Town of Schuttgart presented me with the position of the Iron Gate Guild in regards to the Kamael race and their conditions for collaboration.  Next, I should visit High Prefect Aklan of Goddard town, since he is the Orc race's collaborator.\n

steps.title: The Relationship Between the Orcs and the Kamael
steps.description: High Prefect Aklan says that amidst the discord of the other races, in regards to the Kamael, only the Orcs are aloof. Aklan insists that even in the midst of the disturbance of the other races, the fraternity between Orc and Kamael will not change. Now, I must find the Dark Elf's collaborator, Grand Master Oltlin.\n

steps.title: The Dissatisfaction of the Dark Elves
steps.description: Oltlin insists that the Elf race's caution regarding the Dark Elves is alienating them from all things relating to the Kamael.  Oltlin's request is to allow the Dark Elves and the Kamael to interact on a full scale. Next I shall seek out the Elf collaborator, Juris, at Giran Castle. \n

steps.title: Mark of the Future
steps.description: After meeting with Magister Juris, I obtained 5 Marks of the Future. Juris told me to meet with Sir Kristof Rodemai, who is on the same page as he.\n

steps.title: Reflection
steps.description: We heard detailed accounts about the Kamael from Sir Rodemai, who claims to have personally seen the Kamael and their town. I shall speak again with him after his momentary state of reflection passes. \n

151.description: The students of Einhovant's School of Magic have come down with a mysterious fever. Their teacher, Elias, is quite concerned.

steps.title: Spider's Poison Sac
steps.description: Elias, a Master at the School of Wizardry, has been gathering herbs in the northern woods with some students. The students have fallen ill, and Priest Yohanes has been asked to create a remedy. He needs the poison sacs of many spiders, and you are asked to bring them to him.\n

steps.title: Creation of the Cure for the Fever
steps.description: You have obtained the poison sacs of giant spiders. Take them immediately to Priest Yohanes and ask him to make the medicine!\n

steps.title: Treatment of the Fever
steps.description: Priest Yohanes made fever medicine with the poison sacs you collected for him. Take the medicine for the students of the School of Wizardry to Master Elias immediately!\n

152.description: The roof of Einhasad Temple has collapsed! Help Magister Harrys restore the temple!

steps.title: New Tools
steps.description: A few days ago the roof of the temple was wrecked by a storm. Magister Harrys has asked Blacksmith Altran for tools with which to repair the roof. He asks you to pick up the tools from Blacksmith Altran.\n

steps.title: Stone Hammer
steps.description: Blacksmith Altran asks you to obtain shards of golem for him so he can make a new hammer.\n

steps.title: Return to Blacksmith Altran
steps.description: You have obtained five shards of golem. Take them to Blacksmith Altran and ask him to make a hammer for you.\n

steps.title: Delivery of a Tool Box
steps.description: Blacksmith Altran asks you to deliver the hammer and a tool box containing other tools to Magister Harrys.\n

153.description: Cargo that was presumed lost in a recent shipwreck has been recovered. Help Guard Arnold deliver the cargo to its recipients.

steps.title: Deliver Goods
steps.description: Guard Arnold, who has been working on the recovery of several recent shipwrecks, asks you to deliver some salvaged goods. Deliver the wooden box to Trader Jackson in the weapons shop. Deliver the bolts of cloth to Trader Silvia at the grocery store, and deliver the clay jar to Warehouse Keeper Rant.\n

steps.title: Delivery Report
steps.description: You have delivered the salvaged goods. Report to Guard Arnold.\n

154.description: Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell plans a ritual sacrifice to calm the storms that have been battering the island. This time he intends to use a doll instead of a live virgin.

steps.title: Ritual for Shilen
steps.description: In order to calm the violent storms that have battered the island, Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell is planning a ritual sacrifice to the goddess Shilen. The original ritual calls for a live maiden, but he decides to offer a doll instead. To make the hair of the doll, he needs fox fur. Hunt keltirs around the village and take 10 units of fox fur to Cristel in the village.\n

steps.title: Doll's Hair
steps.description: You have obtained 10 units of fox fur. Take them to Cristel.\n

steps.title: Completed Doll
steps.description: The fox fur yarn for the doll's hair has been spun. Take it to Warehouse Keeper Rolfe.\n

steps.title: Offerings for a Ritual
steps.description: Warehouse Keeper Rolfe has made the doll and attached its hair. Take the finished doll to Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell.\n

155.description: An important letter has arrived for Sir Colin Windawood, the Consul of Talking Island. Sir Windawood, more likely to be found out on a stroll  than in his office, hasn't seen it. Find Sir Windawood and deliver the letter to him.

steps.title: Find Sir Windawood
steps.description: Guard Abellos tells you that an urgent message has arrived from Gludio Castle for Sir Collin Windawood, the Consul of Talking Island. He asks you to deliver the message to the Consul near the Obelisk of Victory.\n

156.description: The ramifications of the ancient battle with the devil, Beleth, still linger in this land. Lilith still grieves for her lost lover, Theon, at Einhasad Temple. His body wasn't recovered, so she's never truly accepted his death. She's waited for him for 1000 years at their agreed-upon meeting place on Talking Island...

steps.title: Whereabouts of the Lost Lover
steps.description: Lilith has pined for her lost love for over a thousand years in the temple of Talking Island. She lost her lover, Theon, in the war against Beleth. Because his body was never recovered, she has never accepted his death. She asks you to look for him on your way to Gludio.\n

steps.title: Lover's Diary
steps.description: Master Baenedes bears a  remarkable resemblance to Theon. He was one of his best students, and learned to use both the sword and bow from him. Sadly, Theon passed away to be with Eva several years ago. Baenedes asks you to deliver Theon's diary to Lilith.\n

157.description: Warehouse Keeper Wilford is breaking the trade embargo against Gracia that was imposed after the recent war. He should be careful...

steps.title: Toad Hunting
steps.description: Warehouse Keeper Wilfred has been smuggling goods in violation of the embargo enacted after the war with Gracia. Recently, a merchant ship was stranded, spilling adamantite ore all over the shore. Much of the ore was recovered, but giant toads are swallowing what remains of it. Hunt the giant toads and recover the ore.\n
steps.completionNpcName: The Lake Shore Near the School

steps.title: Return to Warehouse Keeper Wilford
steps.description: You've recovered all the adamantite ore scattered on the shore. Take it to Warehouse Keeper Wilford.\n

158.description: Evil has spawned in the long-abandoned Elven Ruins! High Priest Biotin was warned of this menace in a dream and is gathering forces to fight the evil.

steps.title: Evil Power
steps.description: High Priest Biotin had a premonition from his dreams that something wicked is growing within the Elven Ruins. He says that the evil seed looks like a gigantic bat-winged demon. He asks you to destroy it.\n

steps.title: Return to High Priest Biotin
steps.description: You have slain Nerkas, the evil seed, and obtained the clay tablet. Take it to High Priest Biotin at the temple in the village.\n

159.description: Someone has intentionally poisoned the water supply of Elven Village! Hierarch Asterios is seeking a young volunteer to find and destroy this evil-doer to save the Mother Tree!

steps.title: In Search of the Source of Pollution
steps.description: Elven Hierarch Asterios is concerned that the Mother Tree of the village is being contaminated. He asks you to visit its water source, the lake north of the village. Destroy the cause of the contamination, the plague zombies.\n

steps.title: Suspicious Corpse
steps.description: You've obtained plague dust from a suspicious looking zombie. Could this be what Hierarch Asterios was talking about? Take it to him.\n

steps.title: Ingredients for Purification Magic
steps.description: It was a plague zombie, the spirit of a person who died from the plague. The dust from the zombie's flesh has been the cause of the contamination. A large amount of the dust is needed to perform a purification ritual. Hunt the plague zombies.\n

steps.title: Return to Hierarch Asterios
steps.description: You've obtained enough plague dust for the purification ritual. Deliver it to Hierarch Asterios.\n

160.description: Nerupa, the caretaker of the Mother Tree, is seeking a volunteer to visit the village on her behalf. The Hierarch will not permit her to go there.

steps.title: Delivery of Goods
steps.description: Trader Unoren asked Nerupa to collect silvery spidersilks for him. Norupa doesn't want to enter the village and asks you to deliver the silvery spidersilks to Trader Unoren in the weapons shop and bring back a nightshade leaf.\n

steps.title: Nightshade Leaf
steps.description: Nightshade leaves are very rare. Fortunately, Trader Creamees of the magic shop has obtained a few of them. Go see him with Unoren's receipt.\n

steps.title: Go to the Warehouse
steps.description: Since nightshade leaf is so rare it has been stored in the warehouse. Take Creamees' ticket to Warehouse Keeper Julia.\n

steps.title: Goods to be Delivered to Nerupa
steps.description: You've obtained the nightshade leaf that Creamees stored in the warehouse. Deliver it to Nerupa.\n

161.description: Elves owe their long lifespans to their consumption of the fruit of the Mother Tree. The caretakers of the tree are quite concerned about the recent decline in production of fruit.

steps.title: Fruit of the Mothertree
steps.description: Andellia and her sisters care for the Mother Trees. You received a letter informing you that the Mother Tree near Iris Lake, maintained by their younger sister Thalia, has borne fruit. Since Andellia and her sisters cannot leave the Mother Trees untended, they ask you to visit Thalia and bring back the fruit of the Mother Tree.\n

steps.title: The One and Only Fruit
steps.description: Thalia gives you the fruit of the Mother Tree that was harvested some time ago. This was the only fruit she harvested this year. She asks you to carefully take it to her sister Andellia.\n

162.description: Ancient spirits have begun haunting the ruins of the Dark Elven war in the Underground Fortress. They cry out for revenge...

steps.title: The Way to Undo a Curse
steps.description: Trader Unoren explains that the undead creatures in the Underground Fortress are soldiers resurrected by a curse. He wants to quiet the vengeful spirits and free the souls of his comrades. He asks that you bring him bone fragments of undead monsters and skulls of Elves. Hunt dungeon skeleton soldiers, dungeon skeleton archers, dread soldiers, dark terrors and mist terrors.\n

steps.title: Return to Trader Unoren
steps.description: You've collected all the skulls and bone pieces needed to break the curse. Return to the Elven Village and give them to Trader Unoren.\n

163.description: Rumiel Moonshine, an amazing poet, entertains his companions with dark poetry, detailing the dread and sorrow of war. Alas, he succumbed too young to the violence he so eloquently described... But his soul lives on in his writings, hidden amongst the ruins of the Underground Fortress!

steps.title: Legacy of a Friend
steps.description: Sentinel Starden is a veteran of the battle of the Underground Fortress. Rumiel the poet, a longtime friend and fellow soldier, died in battle and his poems were lost within the fortress. Starden asks you to find his old friend's works somewhere in the Underground Fortress. Hunt Baraq Orc fighters and Baraq Orc warrior leaders.\n

steps.title: Return to Sentinel Starden
steps.description: You've recovered all four poems written by Rumiel the poet. Take them to Sentinel Starden.\n

164.description: Bloody Lord Kirunak, the leader of the dark ones, killed many brave Elven warriors at the final battle of the Underground Fortress! Legend says that he still lurks near that ruined battlefield! Arise, Elven warriors! Revenge is ours at last!

steps.title: Creamees' Revenge
steps.description: Trader Creamees' friends and family were all killed by the dark side. Kirunak, the leader of the dark side, still lurks within the Underground Fortress. Creamees asks you to seek revenge upon Kirunak.\n

steps.title: Who summoned Kirunak?
steps.description: With his dying breath, Kirunak tells you that his contract with Trader Creamees has been fulfilled. Wasn't it a Dark Elf who originally summoned Kirunak? Return to Creamees and find out what happened.\n

165.description: The Mass of Darkness in honor of Shilen is about to begin. Prepare for the Hunt of Glory! Take your bows and arrows and find offerings for the Mother of Abyss!

steps.title: Shilen's Hunt
steps.description: Shilen's Hunt will soon be held in the Dark Elf Village. Wild game will be hunted and offered as an sacrifice. The hunter who obtains 13 dark bezoars will receive a reward given by the Abyssal Celebrants. Hunt keltirs and wolves, obtain 13 dark bezoars and take them to Sentry Nelsya. Hunt young brown keltirs, brown keltirs, ashen wolves and elder brown keltirs.\n

steps.title: Best Hunter Award
steps.description: You've collected all 13 dark bezoars. Take them to Sentry Nelsya immediately and claim your prize and the honor of being this year's best hunter.\n

166.description: The Mass of Darkness is performed in honor of Shilen, the mother of all Dark Elves. Let's all work together to make this the best festival ever!

steps.title: Items Needed for the Mass of Darkness
steps.description: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias is busily preparing for the ceremony of Shilen and Gran Kain. He asks you to go to the village and obtain several items that he will need for the Mass of Darkness. He asks for the following: a ceremonial dagger from Trader Iria in the Weapons Shop, dreviant wine from Warehouse Keeper Dorankus, and Garmiel's scripture from Master Trudy of the Elder Council.\n

steps.title: Return to Abyssal Celebrant Undrias
steps.description: You've obtained the ceremonial dagger, the dreviant wine and Garmiel's scripture that are needed for the Mass. Take them to Abyssal Celebrant Undrias.\n

167.description: Warehouse Keeper Carlon hasn't seen his family since he was captured by Dark Elves ten years ago. He seeks someone to deliver a message to his brother Haprock in the Town of Gludio.

steps.title: Letter of Greetings?
steps.description: The Dwarven Warehouse Freightman Carlon misses his friends and asks you to deliver a letter to Warehouse Keeper Haprock in the Town of Gludio.\n

steps.title: Letter of Greetings? Really?
steps.description: Haprock thanks you for delivering the letter to him. He asks you to deliver a letter to Warehouse Keeper Norman in Gludin Village. The letter is supposed to be from Norman's wife, longing for him in his hometown... Do you believe him...?\n

168.description: Tetrarch Kaitar is known to see the future. He has forseen that the village will soon come under attack.

steps.title: New Weapon
steps.description: Sentry Jenna says that according to Tetrarch Kaitar's prophecy, the Dark Forest will soon be invaded by outside forces. To prepare for the attack, all Sentries are optimizing their weapons. Master Harant has promised to provide them with new weapons, and they ask you to fetch them.\n

steps.title: Three Swords
steps.description: Master Harant has given you three sentry blades onto which he has bestowed magic power. He asks you to deliver them to Sentry Jenna.\n

steps.title: Delivery of a Sword
steps.description: Sentry Jenna asks you to immediately deliver the completed swords to her sisters. Deliver the swords to Sentry Roselyn and Sentry Kristin, collect the old bronze swords that they have been using and bring them back.\n

steps.title: Worn Out Old Bronze Sword
steps.description: You have delivered all the swords. Take the bronze swords to Sentry Jenna.\n

169.description: Magister Vlasty is researching the ancient monster known as the dark horror.

steps.title: True Nature of Dark Horrors
steps.description: Magister Vlasty is researching the dark horror, an undead monster. He needs unbroken skulls for the research, and asks you to hunt dark horrors and bring the skulls back to him. Dark horrors are found in the swamps southwest of the village. Even broken skulls will fetch you some adena.\n

steps.title: Return to Magister Vlasty
steps.description: You have obtained intact skulls of dark horrors. Take them to Magister Vlasty for a reward. He also pays for broken skulls, but not as much.\n

170.description: The dreams of Tetrarch Vellior are constantly haunted by a mysterious, beautiful woman! Discover the truth of her origin in the ruins of the School of Dark Arts!

steps.title: Chasing a Dream-Catching Succubus
steps.description: Dark Elven Tetrarch Vellior cannot sleep because of the terrible nightmares caused by a succubus. You're asked to kill Merkenis at the School of Dark Arts.\n

steps.title: Nightmare Crystal
steps.description: Merkenis's dying words were about Lich King Icarus. Who is he? What was the source of Tetrarch Vellior's torment? Take the nightmare crystal to the Tetrarch and make a report.\n

171.description: Menacing evil spirits increasingly threaten the peace of Gludio! Unmask and destroy the conspiracy between the Turek Orcs and the ol mahums in the nothern part of the territory!

steps.title: Stolen Cargo
steps.description: A cargo wagon transporting goods to the Dark Forest was ambushed by Turek Orcs. Guard Alvah requests that you recover the stolen cargo. You should first speak with Trader Arodin at the weapons shop in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Recovery of the Stolen Cargo
steps.description: This quest involves recovering a cargo of sword molds stolen by Turek Orcs. Recover 20 of them and take them to the Dark Elven trader named Tyra. She can be found in the west, near the Altar of Rites. Monsters to hunt: Turek Orc Footmen, Turek Orc Suppliers, Turek Orc Skirmishers, and Turek Orc Archers.\n

steps.title: Tyra's Bill
steps.description: You have recovered the stolen cargo and delivered it to Tyra. Take the letter she gave to  Trader Arodin in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Arodin's Request Has Been Fulfilled
steps.description: You have fulfilled Trader Arodin's request. Now report back to Guard Alvah.\n

steps.title: Find the Missing Patrolman!
steps.description: A patrolman assigned to conduct surveillance on the ol mahums has gone missing. He was last seen by Guard Alvah, hiding from pursuing ol mahums in the Ruins of Agony. You are asked to investigate. Begin by confronting the tumran bugbears that are found there.\n

steps.title: Proof Regarding Suspicious Activities
steps.description: It is becoming obvious that the ol mahums and Dwarven traders have formed an alliance. Until definite proof is found of this, however, it cannot be brought before the Dwarven guild. Go and get evidence of this unholy alliance from the ol mahum generals in the Abandoned Camp.\n

steps.title: Who's Pulling the Strings?
steps.description: The document you secured from the ol mahums must be evidence of their agreement with the Dwarves. You must determine the true identity of the Dwarf who signed this paper. Neti in Gludin Village may have some information for you.\n

steps.title: Identity of the Betrayer
steps.description: Now we know that the Dwarven trader Rolento was the one who signed the weapons trade agreement with the ol mahums. Go and find him at the south entrance of the Wastelands.\n

steps.title: Information about the Invasion Plan
steps.description: Rolento explains that if you will deliver some cargo to the Turek Orcs on his behalf, you may be able to obtain their invasion plans. Take the cargo and the Dwarven guild mark to Turek Chief Burai in the Orc barracks.\n

steps.title: Punishment of Ol Mahums
steps.description: Turek Chief Burai is enraged to learn of the ol mahums' deception. He offers to cancel the invasion of Gludin Village if you will join him and his forces in the destruction of the ol mahums. Kill 30 ol mahum captains and take their heads to Turek Chief Burai.\n

steps.title: Fight between Orcs and Ol Mahums
steps.description: The Orc invasion of Gludin Village has been averted. Report to Guard Alvah.\n

211.description: Many Warriors seek the challenger's mark as proof of their valor. A conspiracy of darkness surrounds the mark.

steps.title: Cave of the Shyslassys
steps.description:
Kash says that anyone who wants to get the mark of challenger should enter the cave behind the Undine Waterfall in the northern part of the Neutral Zone, destroy Shyslassys and retrieve an old parchment.


Monster to Hunt - The Shyslassys

steps.title: Return to Kash
steps.description: You've defeated Shyslassys and retrieved the parchment. Take it to Kash.\n

steps.title: In search of Martien
steps.description: Kash tells you to get the mark of challenger from Martien in Giran Castle Town.\n

steps.title: Defeat Gorr
steps.description: Martien says that he will give you the mark of challenger if you defeat an evil spirit known as Gorr that haunts the area around Floran Village.

steps.title: Return to Martien
steps.description: You defeated Gorr and taken the mark of the watcher's eye. Now return to Martien for the mark of challenger.\n

steps.title: Defeat Baraham
steps.description:
Gorr's defeat has not made the people of Floran Village any safer. They're now threatened by another evil creature. Find and destroy Baraham in the caves near Gorr's lair.

Monster to Hunt -  Baraham

steps.title: Raldo
steps.description: You've defeated Baraham. Who is this mysterious stranger? \n

steps.title: The Final Magic Force Field
steps.description: Champion Raldo warns of an evil that will be resurrected unless a magic force field remains protected. Speak with Filaur of the Gray Pillar in the Dwarven Village and ask him where the last magic force field was known to exist.\n

steps.title: Protect the Magic Force Field
steps.description:
There's an evil energy in the deepest part of the Mithril Mines and the magic force field is threatened. Why is there earth wyrm blood everywhere? Could that Succubus Queen be their leader? 

Monster to Hunt - Succubus Queen

steps.title: Raldo's Reappearance
steps.description: At the death of the Succubus Queen, Raldo reappears. Speak with him.\n

212.description: Why do Knights fight? For personal gain or public acclaim? This question must be answered by all who are called to knighthood!

steps.title: Finding Sir Aron Tanford
steps.description: Sometimes, being a mere Knight just isn't enough. Knights who wish to advance should find Sir Aron Tanford south of the Wastelands and undergo the Trial of Duty. \n

steps.title: Spirit of Sir Herod
steps.description:
A true Knight must always seek to restore honor when possible. Sir Herod, after betraying his troops and dying in disgrace, has been resurrected as an evil spirit. Kill the undead skeletons that haunt the Wastelands and you'll meet him. You must destroy him with the old knight sword in order to restore his honor. Return to Sir Aron Tanford when you've finished off Sir Herod.

Monsters to Hunt - Skeleton Marauder, Skeleton Raider and Ghost of Sir Herod

steps.title: Return to Sir Aron Tanford
steps.description: You've obtained the tears of a Knight. Deliver them to Sir Aron Tanford.\n

steps.title: Toward the Second Trial
steps.description: Unfortunately, Sir Herod was beyond redemption. That can't be helped now. Speak with Sir Kiel Nighthawk in the Dark Elf Guild of the Town of Dion to receive your second mission.\n

steps.title: Report of Sir Talianus
steps.description:
There's been a vicious massacre in Dion! Sir Talianus's report  for the King was ripped up and his soldiers have become undead! Obtain the torn pieces of the report from the undead in the Dion Execution Grounds and restore the report of Sir Talianus.

Monsters to Hunt - Strains, Ghouls

steps.title: To Sir Kiel Nighthawk
steps.description: You've restored the report of Sir Talianus. Now take it to Sir Kiel Nighthawk in the Town of Dion.\n

steps.title: Eternal Return for Sir Talianus
steps.description:
Take this report, find the spirit of Sir Talianus and promise to submIt to the King on his behalf. This will allow his spirit to at last rest in peace. Meet the spirit of Sir Talianus by destroying the hangman tree that suppresses his soul.

Monster to Hunt -  Hangman Tree

steps.title: Meeting with Sir Talianus
steps.description: The seal that suppressed Sir Talianus has been broken. Speak with his ghost.\n

steps.title: Huge Atonement
steps.description: Sir Talianus asks you to deliver his report to the King. His spirit can't rest in peace until his sins are redeemed and justice is restored to the land of Dion. Return to Sir Kiel Nighthawk and tell him what you've learned.\n

steps.title: A Knight in Hunters Village
steps.description: Sir Kiel offers to investigate the matters regarding Sir Talianus. He tells you go to Hunters Village and meet with Sir Isael Silvershadow to receive your next orders.\n

steps.title: Militia's Articles
steps.description: Isael Silvershadow asks you to bring back the belongings of a militia who died defending the territory. Destroy the Leto Lizardmen on the Plains of the Lizardmen and collect 20 militias articles.\n

steps.title: Return to Isael
steps.description: Take the 20 militia's articles you've collected to Isael.\n

steps.title: Toward  Giran Castle Town
steps.description: At last, the families of the brave soldiers can say goodbye to their loved ones. Grand Master Hannavalt sends word to Isael asking him to send you to Priest Dustin in Giran Castle Town one more time.\n

steps.title: The Bones of  Leon Athebaldt
steps.description:
Priest Dustin tells you the story of Leon Athebaldt, the protector of the will of Einhasad. He asks that you kill the Breka Orc Overlord and retrieve Sir Athebaldt's bones from around his neck. Find the Overlord in the Breka Stronghold.

Monster to Hunt -  Breka Orc Overlord

steps.title: Return to Dustin
steps.description: You've retrieved the bones of Sir Leon Athebaldt. Now return to Priest Dustin.\n

steps.title: In Search of Sir Collin Windawood
steps.description: When you return with the bones of Leon Athebaldt, Dustin asked you to take them to Sir Collin Windawood, Leon's uncle.  He's an archon on Talking Island.\n

steps.title: Return to Priest Dustin Again
steps.description: Sir Collin Windawood asks you to deliver his letter of gratitude to Priest Dustin. \n

steps.title: Return to Hannavalt
steps.description: Priest Dustin thanks you and gives you a letter describing your efforts. Take it to Grand Master Hannavalt. \n

213.description: The peace of the kingdom is threatened by mutant evil spirits. The Seeker Guild wants to conduct secret reconnaissance to find out what they're up to. It's a tough, dangerous job. Are you certain that you're prepared to follow the Path of the Seeker?

steps.title: Formerly Known as Hawkeye
steps.description: Mutant evil spirits threaten the kingdom. The guild has decided to begin a secret investigation into their activities. Only Seekers can accomplish this task. You must find someone to help you. The letter describes that person.\n

steps.title: Mutant Evil Spirits in the Execution Grounds
steps.description:
Master Terry is concerned about the increasing number of mutants in the area and asks you to hunt the neer ghoul berserker on the Execution Grounds near the village.

Monster to Hunt -  Neer Ghoul Berserker

steps.title: Mysterious Runestone
steps.description: A suspicious stone has been retrieved from the Neer Ghoul Berserkers. Take it to Master Terry in the Town of Dion.\n

steps.title: Hunt the Mutants
steps.description:
After examining the runestone, Terry asks you to investigate the mutants while he continues his work.

Monsters to Hunt -
Fortress of Resistance: Ol Mahum Captains
Orc Barracks: Turek Orc Warlords
Wastelands or Ant Nest: Ant Captains
Gorgon Flower Garden: Turak Bugbear Warriors

steps.title: Return to Terry
steps.description: You've retrieved the runestones from the mutants. Now return to Master Terry in the Town of Dion.\n

steps.title: Finding Victor the Clairvoyant
steps.description: Master Terry asks you to deliver the runestones to Victor in Hunters Village and advises that you tell him Master Terry's full name if he seems unfamiliar with him. Remember this!\n

steps.title: Terry's Real Name
steps.description: You got it wrong! What is Master Terry's full name? Go ask him again!\n

steps.title: Remember the Name
steps.description: Master Terry tells you his full name again and asks that you not forget it. His current name is made by combining the second letters of his full name. He wrote the letter again, so take it with you.\n

steps.title: Medusa's Scales
steps.description:
Victor agrees to investigate if you'll hunt the medusa and bring him 10 of its scales.

Monster to Hunt -  Medusa

steps.title: Return to Victor
steps.description: You've collected 10 scales of medusa. Take them to Trader Victor in Hunters Village and ask him about the runestones.\n

steps.title: Magister of the Ivory Tower
steps.description: Victor explains that the runestones are associated with Shilen. He asks that you deliver his analysis request letter containing his preliminary research results to Magister Marina in the Ivory Tower.\n

steps.title: Errand to  Dwarven Village
steps.description: Magister Marina asks you to get an object from Blacksmith Brunon of Dwarven Village while he performs his analysis.\n

steps.title: Return to Marina
steps.description: Bruno gives you a very fragile object to deliver to Marina. Be careful with it.\n

steps.title: What is the Result of the Analysis?
steps.description: Marina is depressed to find that the analysis confirms her worst fears. Take her results to Master Terry to find out more.\n

steps.title: In Search of the Dark Bezoar
steps.description:
The analysis shows that runestones are being intentionally implanted into the bodies of monsters. Destroy these monsters and retrieve the runestones.

Monsters to Hunt - 
Cruma Marshlands: Marsh Stakato Drones
 Breka's Stronghold: Breka Orc Overlords
Wastelands or Ant Nest: Ant Warrior Captains
Plains of the Lizardmen: Leto Lizardman Warriors

steps.title: In Search of the Dark Bezoar
steps.description:
The analysis shows that runestones are being intentionally implanted into the bodies of monsters. Destroy these monsters and retrieve the Abyssal runestones.

Monsters to Hunt - 
Cruma Marshlands: Marsh Stakato Drones
Breka's Stronghold: Breka Orc Overlords
Wastelands or Ant Nest: Ant Warrior Captains
Plains of the Lizardmen: Leto Lizardman Warriors

steps.title: Return to Terry
steps.description: You've removed the abyss runestones from the monsters. Now take them to Master Terry.\n

214.description: Every Magus must pass the Trial of the Scholar. Passion and humility are essential to success.

steps.title: In Search of High Priest Sylvain
steps.description: To advance your learning, you must pass the Trial of the Scholar. Find the renowned Mystics and do as they say!\nFirst, you should seek out High Priest Sylvain in the Town of Dion.\n

steps.title: Finding Maria
steps.description: High Priest Sylvain asks that you obtain the crystal of purity from Maria in the village so he can purify the Execution Grounds.\n

steps.title: The Stolen Scroll
steps.description: The secret of making crystals of purity has been kept by Maria's family for generations. She tells you that the scroll containing the secret method was stolen a month ago. Find Captain Lucas and ask him what happened.\n

steps.title: The Unrecovered Scroll
steps.description: Unfortunately, Maria's scroll has not yet been found. Go and tell her.\n

steps.title: The Astrologer of Floran Village
steps.description: Maria agrees with Lucas's suggestion that they seek out a fortune-teller. She asks you to speak with Creta in Floran Village.\n

steps.title: Searching for Clues
steps.description: Creta asks you to find clues regarding the robbery. Return to Maria and ask her for clues.\n

steps.title: A Clue in the Handbag?
steps.description: It's Lucilla's handbag! She was a friend of Maria's who was there when the robbery happened. It might hold a clue! Take it to Creta.\n

steps.title: Shadow of the Criminal
steps.description: Creta see the culprit's shadow in the handbag. Could it be the shadow of a Human?\n

steps.title: A Very Mysterious Shadow
steps.description: Maria asks that you show the shadow to Captain Lucas, an expert in such matters.\n

steps.title: Was It a Lizardman's Shadow?
steps.description: Captain Lucas isn't sure that the shadow belongs to the thief, but it appears to belong to a Leto lizardman Warrior!\n

steps.title: Tracking the Lizardmen!
steps.description:
Maria asks you to track down the lizardmen and retrieve the stolen scroll.

Monsters to Hunt - Leto Lizardman Warriors

steps.title: A Torn Scroll
steps.description: You've retrieved the torn scroll from the Leto Lizardmen. Take it to Maria, she'll be able to read it. \n

steps.title: The Crystal of Purity is Complete!
steps.description: The crystal of purity is complete! Take it to High Priest Sylvain.\n

steps.title: Sylvain is Satisfied
steps.description: High Priest Sylvain wanted you to help Maria make the crystal of purity. Return to Magister Mirien for your next assignment.\n

steps.title: In Search of Jurek
steps.description: Mirien says that you must report to Grand Magister Jurek in Giran Castle Town.\n

steps.title: Who Has the Power?
steps.description:
Jurek asks you to hunt down the evil spirits who have recently gained magical powers, and to bring him what he needs for his investigation.

Monsters to Hunt - Wastelands, Plains of Dion: Monster Eye Destroyers
Breka's Stronghold: Breka Orc Shaman
Dragon Valley: Shackles

steps.title: Return to Jurek
steps.description: You've collected all the items that Jurek requires. Take them to him in Giran Castle Town.\n

steps.title: The Trial of Jurek is Complete
steps.description: Jurek has given you a mark as a token of gratitude, and indicates he is still seeking evidence to prove his suspicions. Return to Mirien.\n

steps.title: In Search of Elder Cronos
steps.description: Your last assignment is with Elder Cronos in Hunters Village. Go and find him.\n

steps.title: In Search of the Scripture of  Knowledge
steps.description: Elder Cronos asks you what your purpose is in learning magic. When he is convinced of what you say, he tells you of a book called the Scriptures of Knowledge, which he onced used. Visit Dieter at the Wizard Guild of Giran Castle to obtain the book.\n

steps.title: Finding the Astrologer Again
steps.description: Dieter has lost the Scriptures of Knowledge! Consult Astrologer Creta again.\n

steps.title: Astrology of  Creta
steps.description: Creta gives you a letter of explanation and asks you to deliver it to the owner of the key, saying that she sees several shadows there.\n

steps.title: In Search of Edroc
steps.description: Dieter suggests that you speak with Edroc, the son of the owners of the inn they were staying in. He may remember something.\n

steps.title: Warehouse Keeper of the Harbor
steps.description: T

steps.title: The Drunkard's Brother
