steps.description: Raut gives you the first chapter of the scripture and asks you to forgive his brother's youthful indiscretions. Raut says he doesn't know where the other three chapters are, but suggests you ask his brother and tells you where to find him.\n

steps.title: Finding the Remaining Scriptures of Knowledge
steps.description:
Triff was the lone survivor of a deadly magical attack. They say that he was able to hide some of the scriptures before the evil spirits took the lot of them..

You must journey afar to complete the Scriptures of Knowledge!
Town of Giran: Warehouse Keeper Valkon
Town of Dion: Blacksmith Poitan

Monster to Hunt -  Death Pass: Grandis

steps.title: In Search of the Scriptures of Knowledge
steps.description:
Elder Casian regrets that he cannot understand the contents from only one chapter. You must find the rest of the scriptures!

Death Pass: Evil Spirit Grandis
Giran Castle Town's Warehouse Keeper Valkon.

steps.title: Casian's Magic Ingredient
steps.description:
Elder Casian asks you for the materials he needs to copy the Scriptures of Knowledge.

Monsters to Hunt -
Execution Grounds: Ghouls
Gorgon Flower Garden: Medusas
Death Pass: Fettered Souls
Crater of Ivory Tower: Enchanted Gargoyles

steps.title: Return to Casian
steps.description: You've gotten the materials that Elder Casian needs. Take them to him in the Wastelands.\n

steps.title: An Incomplete Scripture
steps.description: The Scriptures of Knowledge are not complete without the introduction and the fifth chapter! Elder Casian is regretful, but there is nothing to be done since they have been destroyed. You've retrieved all of that's left of the Scriptures of Knowledge. Return to Elder Cronos.\n

steps.title: The Truth of the Scripture
steps.description: Elder Cronos says that the Scriptures of Knowledge are merely one interpretation of the greater Tablet of Maphr, which contains the ultimate secrets of geometry - translated by the giants from the Gods themselves!  He continues to say that the authors had to discontinue their work once it was realized that the dark secrets contained within were too powerful for this world. He is very pleased with you and what you have brought him and gives you something in return. Return to Magister Mirien.\n

215.description: To understand the power of a deity, you must first understand its nature. Open your mind to new patterns of thought. True enlightenment comes to all who seek it.

steps.title: The Teachings of Pa'agrio
steps.description: The Trial of the Pilgrim requires that you learn the ways of the gods by visiting various priests. You should visit Seer Tanapi in the land of the Orcs first.\n

steps.title: Ancestor Martankus
steps.description: Seer Tanapi tells you that in order to truly understand Pa'agrio, the God of Fire, you must meet Ancestor Martankus within the Cave of Trials!\n

steps.title: Essence of Flame
steps.description:
If you wish to understand the true nature of Pa'agrio, Martankus says you must recover the essence of flame from the Forgotten Temple in Gludin Territory. 

Monsters to Hunt - Lava Salamanders

steps.title: Return to Martankus
steps.description: You've got the essence of flame! Take it to Ancestor Martankus in the Cave of Trials.\n

steps.title: Seer Tanapi
steps.description: The essence of flame contains the Soul of Pa'agrio. Should it speak to you, be sure to let Seer Tanapi know of what was said.\n

steps.title: The Teachings of Maphr
steps.description: You've felt the flame. Now you must learn Maphr's truth. Speak with Gauri Twinklerock in Dwarven Village.\n

steps.title: Which is True?
steps.description: To learn the truth of Maphr, meet with Priest Gerald or Wanderer Dorf.\n

steps.title: The Teachings of Einhasad
steps.description: The Teachings of Maphr.  This is like the two sides of a coin. Find Priest Primos in Giran Castle Town to receive the teachings of Einhasad.\n

steps.title: Journey To Talking Island
steps.description: Priest Primos in Giran Castle Town says that he doesn't have anything to tell you. He tells you to go see Priest Petron on Talking Island.\n

steps.title: Kill Nahir
steps.description:
Priest Petron will teach you and give you your assignment if you'll go to the Elven Ruins and destroy the evil spirit known as Nahir.

Monster to Hunt -  Nahir

steps.title: Return to Priest Petron
steps.description: You've killed the evil creature Nahir. Return to Priest Petron on Talking Island.\n

steps.title: The Teachings of Eva
steps.description: The truth of Einhasad is that there's as much jealousy and destruction as there is faith and life in this world. Now you must learn the truth of Eva. Speak with Andellia in Elven Village.\n

steps.title: Defeat the Black Willow
steps.description: Eva's priest asks you to kill the Black Willows located at the falls in the Neutral Zone.  Then to go meet with Uruha, Priestess of Darkness, to warn her not to bring her evil intentions to the Elven Forest ever again.\n

steps.title: Give a Warning to Uruha
steps.description: You've defeated the Black Willow. Now visit Uruha and warn her not to bring her dastardly evil intentions near the Elven Village ever again.\n

steps.title: Book of Darkness
steps.description: In pursuit of the teachings of the opposite.  You've obtained the Book of Darkness which contains the dark secrets of Shilen! How would Andellia, Eva's child, respond to you now?\n

steps.title: Elder of the Wastelands
steps.description: Your next lesson will be learned from Elder Casian of the Wastelands. He has some very unusual, forgotten knowledge. Go see him.\n

steps.title: To Live  a Life with Faith
steps.description: The laws of the gods govern the universe although their intentions are not always clear. We must simply live each day with faith... Now, return to Hermit Santiago.\n

steps.title: The Trial Begins
steps.description: In order to become a full-fledged member of Dwarven society, you must first create 7 journeyman rings. Blacksmith Altran on Talking Island might be a good person to ask. Hold on... Do you see that? Is it a hint?\n

steps.title: Altran's Arthritis
steps.description: Altran's arthritis is bothering him terribly. Return to Warehouse Keeper Valkon for instructions.\n

steps.title: A Medicine for Arthritis
steps.description:
Altran's arthritis is getting much worse. Mandragora berries are supposed to be an excellent remedy. Bring him some and he might listen to you.

Monsters to Hunt - Mandragora Sprouts, Mandragoras, Mandragora Saplings, Mandragora Blossoms

steps.title: Visiting Altran
steps.description: Take the mandragora berries to Altran on Talking Island to treat his arthritis.\n

steps.title: Ingredients of the Journeyman Ring
steps.description: In order to make a journeyman ring you must obtain journeyman gems and journeyman deco beads. You can get the gems from Warehouse Keeper Norman in Gludin Village and the deco beads from Blacksmith Pinter in the Town of Gludio.\n

steps.title: Making a Journeyman Ring
steps.description: You've obtained 7 journeyman deco beads and 7 journeyman gems. Use the recipe to create 7 journeyman rings and take them to Warehouse Keeper Valkon.\n

217.description: Humans have proudly dominated this continent for millennia. But, as has been said, pride goes before the fall.. If they are to survive, they must restore the trust of the other races.

steps.title: The Elven Tetrarch
steps.description: High Priest Hollint warns of a huge pending disaster and the dawn of an era of chaos. He gives you a testimony of trust, asking that you work to strengthen the solidarity between the races in preparation for the dark days ahead. You must visit the leaders of all the tribes and obtain their trust. Meet with Hierarch Asterios in Elven Village first.\n

steps.title: Captains of the Insane Spirits
steps.description:
Hierarch Asterios asks you to slay Luell of Zephyr Winds and Actea of Verdant Wilds, the leaders of the spirits who are destroying the forest, in order to restore the trust between Humans and Elves. Find them by killing lireins and dryads.

Monsters to Hunt - Lireins, Lirein Elders, Luell of Zephyr Winds, Dryads, Dryad Elders, Actea of Verdant Wilds

steps.title: Return to  Asterios
steps.description: You've defeated the leaders of the insane spirits, Luell of Zephyr Winds and Actea of Verdant Wilds. Return to Hierarch Asterios in Elven Village.\n

steps.title: The Dark Elven Tetrarch
steps.description: You've received a letter of trust from Hierarch Asterios, the leader of the Elves. Speak with Tetrarch Thifiell in Dark Elf Village.\n

steps.title: Free the Tetrarch
steps.description: Tetrarch Thifiell will not give his trust easily and asks you to help him free the Dark Elf leader as a sign of good faith. Speak with Magister Clayton in the Town of Dion.\n

steps.title: Three Ingredients
steps.description:
Magister Clayton asks you to gather three ingredients.

Monsters to Hunt -
Death Pass: Guardian Basilisks
Wastelands: Ant Soldiers
Cruma Marshlands: Marsh Stakatos

steps.title: Return to Clayton
steps.description: You've collected all the ingredients that Clayton requested. Return to the Town of Dion.\n

steps.title: To the Dark Elf Village
steps.description: Clayton asks that you take the three ingredients to Tetrarch Thifiell in the Dark Elf Village.\n

steps.title: High Priest of Oren Castle Village
steps.description: You've received a letter of trust from Tetrarch Thifiell, the Dark Elven leader. Return to High Priest Hollint in the Town of Oren.\n

steps.title: To the Temple of Einhasad
steps.description: You've delivered the letters from the leaders of the Elves and the Dark Elves to High Priest Hollint. Now speak with Cardinal Seresin at the entrance of the Temple of Einhasad in the Town of Oren.\n

steps.title: A Lack of Experience
steps.description: Cardinal Seresin advises you to get more experience. You're not skilled enough to complete the Testimony of Trust. Meet with Cardinal Seresin again when you reach level 38.\n

steps.title: Finding the Lord of the Orcs
steps.description: You must obtain a promise of trust from the Orcish and Dwarven leaders. Deliver Cardinal Seresin's letter to the Lord of the Orcs.\n

steps.title: Help Manakia
steps.description: Flame Lord Kakai, the leader of Orcs, has asked you to help Seer Manakia in Giran Castle Town.\n

steps.title: Lota Tribe's Totem
steps.description:
Seer Manakia has asked that you destroy the windsus and collect 10 parasites of Lota. Mad boars are rampaging at the Death Pass at the behest of the totem spirit of the Lota tribe.

Monster to Hunt -  Windsus

steps.title: Return to Manakia
steps.description: You've collected all the parasites of Lota that you need. Return to Seer Manakia.\n

steps.title: Return to Kakai
steps.description: Take Manakia's letter to Flame Lord Kakai.\n

steps.title: The Elder of Dwarven Village
steps.description: You've obtained the mark of trust from the Orcs! Speak with Lockirin of the Iron Gate Guild in Dwarven Village.\n

steps.title: The Maestro of Cruma Tower
steps.description: Lockirin asks that you to help Maestro Nikola at Cruma Tower if you wish to obtain the promise of trust.\n

steps.title: The Heartstones of Porta
steps.description:
Maestro Nikola asks that you bring him 10 heartstones of Porta. Porta lives inside Cruma Tower.

Monster to Hunt -  Porta

steps.title: Return to Nikola
steps.description: You've collected 10 heartstones of Porta. Take them to Maestro Nikola outside of the tower.\n

steps.title: Toward the Dwarven Village
steps.description: You've delivered the heartstones of Porta to Maestro Nikola. Now return to Lockirin in Dwarven Village.\n

steps.title: Return to Oren
steps.description: You've earned the trust of the Dwarves! Return to High Priest Hollint in the Town of Oren.\n

steps.title: The High Priest of Talking Island
steps.description: You've earned the trust of all the leaders of the tribes. Find High Priest Biotin on Talking Island and obtain the mark of trust.\n

218.description: The Mother Tree, the mother and final resting place of all Elves, is dying! To avoid another costly sacrifice, she must have tears from the purest creature, the water of life!

steps.title: The Time of Trial
steps.description: Also known as the mother of all forests and fairies, our Mother Tree is dying. Master Cardien says that many young Elves must be sacrificed if she is to be saved and then gives you the testimony of life. Take his letter to Magister Asterios in Elven Village.\n

steps.title: The Water of Life
steps.description: You must obtain the water of life to revive the Mother Tree. Thalia in the east of Iris Lake knows where to find it. Find her.\n

steps.title: The Dwarven Blacksmith
steps.description: You must first have the grail of purity if you are to obtain the water of life. Blacksmith Pushkin is the only one who knows how to  properly handle pure mithril, an essential ingredient of the grail. Find him in Giran Castle Town.\n

steps.title: Ingredients of the Grail
steps.description:
The grail has three ingredients: pure Mithril Ore, ant soldier acid and wyrm's talons.

Monsters to Hunt -
 Death Pass: Guardian Basilisks, Wyrms
Wastelands, Ant Nest: Various Ants

steps.title: Return to Pushkin
steps.description: You've obtained the ingredients that Blacksmith Pushkin requested. Return to him and create the grail.\n

steps.title: Finished Mithril Glass
steps.description: Blacksmith Pushkin has created a pure mithril cup. Take it to Thalia, east of Iris Lake.\n

steps.title: The Dark Elven Witch
steps.description: You must obtain stardust to make a grail of purity. Meet with Witch Arkenia of the Dark Elves at the Altar of Rites in Dark Elven Forest.\n

steps.title: Searching for the Scripture of Andariel
steps.description: Witch Arkenia will give you stardust if you bring her the Andariel scripture. You'll find it in Einhasad Temple in Gludin Town.\n

steps.title: Making a Copy of the Scripture
steps.description:
Priest Adonius asks for your help with his publishing business and promises to give you a copy of the scripture of Andariel as a reward. Find spider ichor for the ink and harpy's down for the penholders.

Monsters to Hunt -
Cruma Marshlands: Marsh Spiders
Gorgon Flower Garden: Harpy

steps.title: Return to Adonius
steps.description: You've obtained the materials that Adonius asked for. Return to him.\n

steps.title: Completed Scripture
steps.description: Take the scripture that you got from Priest Adonius to Witch Arkenia at the Altar of Rites in the Dark Elven Forest.\n

steps.title: Return to Thalia
steps.description: Take the stardust that you received from Witch Arkenia to Thalia, east of Iris Lake.\n

steps.title: More Concentration
steps.description: Thalia tells you that you must have more experience if you wish to find the water of life. Find her again when you reach level 38.\n

steps.title: Stolen Spear
steps.description: The Talin's spear, essential to finding the water of life, has been stolen. Thalia orders you to retrieve it. Speak with Isael Silvershadow of Hunters Village first.\n

steps.title: Separated Spear
steps.description:
The Talin's spear has been stolen and separated into 6 pieces. Track down the Chief and Shaman of the Leto Lizardmen and retrieve the pieces.

Monsters to Hunt - Leto Lizardman Shaman, Leto Lizardman Overlords

steps.title: Return to Isael
steps.description: You've collected all 6 parts of Talin's spear. Return to Isael Silvershadow in Hunters Village.\n

steps.title: Prepared Readiness
steps.description: Talin's spear has been restored to its original state. Take it to Thalia, east of Iris Lake.\n

steps.title: Genuine Tears
steps.description: Stab Eva's unicorn with Talin's spear and capture the tears in the grail to obtain the water of life. Find the unicorn in the southern mountain range of the Elven Forest.\n

steps.title: The Tears of Eva
steps.description: You've succeeded in capturing the unicorn's tears in the grail. Return to Thalia, east of Iris Lake.\n

steps.title: Water of Life
steps.description: Take the water of life to Hierarch Asterios in Elven Village.\n

steps.title: The Testimony of Life
steps.description: You've delivered the Water of Life to Hierarch Asterios. Now take the amulet he gave you to Master Cardien in the Town of Dion.\n

219.description: Dark Elves believe they are descendents of their abyssal mother, Shilen. They seek her dark truths regarding the chaotic times to come.

steps.title: Alder's Ash
steps.description: Magister Kaira commands you to find  a book called "Kaysha's Revelations", which supposedly contains the secrets of the goddess Shilen. Meet Brother Metheus in  Einhasad Temple in Giran Castle Town and find out more about Alder, who produced copies of the book.\n

steps.title: Little Sister's Ash
steps.description:
Brother Metheus asks you to help him get revenge for his sister in exchange for Alder's skull. He asks that you first find the remains of his sister by killing the Hangman Tree in the Execution Grounds.

Monster to Hunt -  Hangman Tree

steps.title: Return to Metheus
steps.description: You found the remains of Kassandra hanging on a Hangman Tree in the Execution Grounds. Take them to Brother Metheus.\n

steps.title: Belladonna's Deadly Kiss
steps.description: Brother Metheus asks you to obtain some Belladonna for him to avenge the murder of his sister. Find a Dark Elven expert in poisons to help you.\n

steps.title: An Expert in Poisons
steps.description: Find Master Ixia in the Town of Dion and ask him for Belladonna.\n

steps.title: Ingredients of Belladonna
steps.description:
Belladonna contains 10 bloods of medusa, marsh spider fluids, dead seeker dung, tyrant's blood and nightshade root.

Monsters to Hunt -
Gorgon Flower Garden: Medusas
Execution Grounds: Dead Seekers
Wastelands: Tyrants
Cruma Marshlands: Stakatos, Marsh Spiders

steps.title: Return to Ixea
steps.description: You've obtained all the ingredients needed to make belladonna. Return to Master Ixia, the poison expert.\n

steps.title: Cold Revenge
steps.description: Take the belladonna to Brother Metheus.\n

steps.title: Return to Kaira
steps.description: You delivered the belladonna to Brother Metheus and received Alder's skull. Return to Magister Kaira.\n

steps.title: Spirit of Alder
steps.description: Ask Alder's soul about "Kaysha's Revelations".\n

steps.title: Find Roa
steps.description: Find Roa, tell him what you heard from Alder's soul and ask him about "Kaysha's Revelations".\n

steps.title: The Warehouse in Gludin Village
steps.description: Take the ticket from Magister Roa to the warehouse in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: A Copy of the Revelations
steps.description: You've gotten a copy of "Kaysha's Revelations"! Return to Magister Kaira in Giran Castle Town.\n

steps.title: Not Ready
steps.description: Magister Kaira tells you that you're not ready to take the next test. Return to her when you reach level 38.\n

steps.title: Shilen Initiation Ceremony
steps.description: Take the recommendation letter to Tetrarch Thifiell in Dark Elf Village to be initiated into the Shilen Circle.\n

steps.title: The Altar of Rites
steps.description: Take the letter and amulet you got from Tetrarch Thifiell to Witch Arkenia at the Altar of Rites in the Dark Elven Forest.\n

steps.title: Manufacture the Special Ink
steps.description: To be initiated into the Shilen Circle you must first create a special ink from red fairy dust and blight treant sap. Get the ingredients from the bloody pixy and blight treants.\n

steps.title: The Dark Elven Tetrarch
steps.description: You've been initiated into the Shilen Circle! Take Witch Arkenia's letter to Tetrarch Thifiell in Dark Elf Village.\n

220.description: An eternal winter is coming! To survive the imminent chaos you must be able to unite the power of all the Orc tribes. Are you ready for such a task?

steps.title: Trial of Vokian
steps.description:
Prefect Vokian wants to make sure that you're experienced enough to represent the Lord and orders that you prove your ability by hunting monsters.

Monsters to Hunt -
Crater of Ivory Tower: Manashens
Death Pass: Guardian Basilisks
Wastelands: Tyrants

steps.title: Return to Vokian
steps.description: You've defeated the monsters that Vokian ordered and collected all the marks. Return to Prefect Vokian.\n

steps.title: Chianta, Chief of the Gandi Tribe
steps.description: You've proven your abilities to Prefect Vokian. Meet Gandi Chief Chianta in the Town of Dion.\n

steps.title: Five Unique and Honorable Deaths
steps.description: Recover the flame scepter from the 5 lower Orc tribes. The tribes are called the Breka, Enku, Vuku, Turek and Tunath.\nVisit Seer Manakia in Giran Castle Town and Prefect Kasman in Gludin Town for detailed instructions.\n

steps.title: Return to Chianta
steps.description: You've collected the scepters from the 5 lower Orc tribes. Take them to Gandi Chief Chianta.\n

steps.title: Punish the Betrayers
steps.description:
You've recovered the flame scepters from the 5 lower Orc tribes. Now you must make war against the Timak and Tamlin Orc tribes. Bring back 20 heads from each tribe!

Monsters to Hunt -
Timak Outpost: Timak Orcs
Hunters Valley: Tamlin Orcs and their Archers

steps.title: The Punishment Ends
steps.description: You've brought 20 heads from the Tamlin and Timak Orc tribes. Return to Chianta.\n

steps.title: Priest of the Immortal Plateau
steps.description: Take the box you got from Gandi Chief Chianta to Seer Tanapi in Orc Village.\n

steps.title: The Scepter of Tantos
steps.description:
Find the Ragna Orc Overlord or Seer somewhere on the Immortal Plateau and recover the stolen scepter.

Monsters to Hunt - Ragna Orc Overlords, Ragna Orc Seers, Revenant of Tantos Chief

steps.title: Recovered Scepter of Tantos
steps.description: You've recovered the Scepter of the Tantos tribe. Take it to Seer Tanapi.\n

steps.title: To the Lord of Flame
steps.description: You've recovered the stolen scepter and delivered it to Seer Tanapi. Now take the ritual box to Flame Lord Kakai.\n

steps.title: Four Proofs of Prosperity
steps.description: To complete the first part of the Testimony of Prosperity, you must first find the four proofs of prosperity: the proof of wealth, the proof of fertile lands, the proof of fertility and the proof of a sound body. Warehouse Freightman Parman in Giran Castle Town can tell you more about the details of each of these proofs.\n

steps.title: Return to Parman
steps.description: You've collected all four proofs that are symbols of Maphr's prosperity. Return to Warehouse Freightman Parman in Giran Castle Town.\n

steps.title: More Training
steps.description: You've completed the first part of the Testimony of Prosperity. However, you don't have enough experience to begin the second part. Return to Warehouse Freightman Parman in Giran Castle Town after you've reached level 38.\n

steps.title: Maphr's Stone Plate
steps.description: You have completed the first part of the Testimony of Prosperity.  The second part of the test is to find and bring back Maphr's Tablet on which the secrets of absolute geometry is recorded.  For details, go to Maestro Nikola who is located near Cruma Tower and ask him.\n

steps.title: Making an Imprint of the Keyhole
steps.description: According to Maestro Nikola, Maphr's Tablet is hidden in a box located somewhere inside the Cruma Tower.  However, in order to make a key to open the box, you must first make an imprint of the keyhole. Take the clay Maestro Nikola has given you, go to Cruma Tower to copy the  keyhole of the box and return.\n

steps.title: Return to Nikola
steps.description: By using the clay, you have made a copy of the keyhole.  Now, return to Maestro Nikola.\n

steps.title: Ingredients for the Key
steps.description:
In order to open the box containing Maphr's Tablet, you must first make a Key of Titan.  Maestro Nikola has given you the list of materials that are needed to make the key.  Collect the materials and then by using the recipe, make a Key of Titan.  After that, open the box with the completed key and recover Maphr's Tablet.  

 Monsters to hunt -  Marsh Stakatos, Toad Lords, and Marsh Spiders.

steps.title: The Finished Key
steps.description: You have gathered all the materials you need. Now, by using the recipe, make the key and open the Titan's Box.\n

steps.title: Maphr's Stone Plate
steps.description: You've finally obtained Maphr's Tablet! Take it to Warehouse Freightman Parman in Giran Castle Town.\n

222.description: Only the best Fighters in the kingdom earn the title of "Duelist". They must conquer the most powerful evil spirit in each territory!

steps.title: Fighting Evil
steps.description: To pass the Test of the Duelist you must defeat the most powerful evil spirit from each territory in the kingdom. Kaien has ordered that you destroy at least 10 evil spirits in each territory!\n

steps.title: Monster Hunt
steps.description:
The following monsters are to be hunted:

Gludio Territory
Wastelands - Punchers, Ant Nest - Noble Ant Leaders

Dion Territory
Cruma Marshlands - Marsh Stakato Drones, Execution Grounds - Dead Seekers

Giran Territory
Breka's Stronghold - Breka Orc Overlords, Death Pass - Fettered Souls

Oren Territory
Plains of the Lizardmen - Leto Lizardman Overlords, Krator of Ivory Tower - Enchanted Monster Eyes

Aden Territory
Hunters Valley - Tamlin Orcs, Tamlin Orc Archers

steps.title: The First Test Is Over
steps.description: You've killed all the evil spirits for the Test of the Duelist. Return to Kaien.\n

steps.title: The Final Test
steps.description:
To pass the Test of the Duelist, you must prove you are the best in the kingdom. Find the evil creatures listed in the final order and kill at least 3 of each.

Monsters to Hunt -
Cruma Tower: Excuros, Krator
Death Pass: Grandis
Timak Outpost: Timak Orc Overlord
Hunters Valley: Lakin

steps.title: The Final Test Is Complete
steps.description: You've destroyed the evil spirits for the final test. Return to Kaien.\n

223.description: These chaotic times are the best times for Warriors. Everything from mud and gore to love and romance is but for the taking!

steps.title: The Old Soldier's Friend
steps.description: Veteran Ascalon asks you to find his old friend Mason in the southern part of Dion.\n

steps.title: Mason's Revenge
steps.description:
Mason's entire family was massacred by troops of the Gracian army. Exact his revenge upon the Bloody Axe Elites on the Plains of the Lizardmen.

Monsters to Hunt - Bloody Axe Elites

steps.title: Return to Mason
steps.description: You've collected 100 heads of the Bloody Axe Elite. Now take them to Mason.\n

steps.title: Letter to Ascalon
steps.description: Mason is satisfied that his family has been avenged. He asks you to deliver a letter to Ascalon.\n

steps.title: Poison of Medusa
steps.description: Now you must make an antidote for the Giran guards who were poisoned by the medusa. Find Groot in Giran Castle Town.\n

steps.title: An Antidote for Medusa Poisoning
steps.description:
It wasn't a mortal threat to the race, but the number medusa poisonings certainly increased. Create an antidote from a harpy's egg, the medusa's venom and windsus bile.

Monsters to Hunt - Gorgon Flower Garden: Harpy, Medusa
Death Pass: Windsus

steps.title: Return to Groot
steps.description: You've gathered the ingredients to make the antidote for the medusa's venom. Return to Magic Trader Groot.\n

steps.title: Fight of the Old Soldiers
steps.description: Groot thanks you for helping him and tells you that he will make and deliver the antidote. Now return to Ascalon.\n

steps.title: Crisis In the Town of Oren
steps.description: The Town of Oren is threatened! Meet Captain Mouen there!\n

steps.title: Hunting the Road Scavenger
steps.description:
The crisis in Oren was a bit overblown by Ascalon, but the road scavengers are clearly causing trouble. Bring back 100 of their heads!

Monsters to Hunt - Road Scavengers, Road Collectors

steps.title: Return to Mouen
steps.description: You've collected 100 heads of the road scavengers. Return to Captain Mouen.\n

steps.title: Protect Giran Castle
steps.description:
Ascalon was right! the Leto Lizardmen have begun a full frontal assault! You must defend Giran Castle!

Monsters to Hunt - Leto Lizardmen

steps.title: Return to the Captain
steps.description: You've collected 100 fangs of Leto Lizardmen. Return to Captain Mouen.\n

steps.title: Return to Ascalon
steps.description: You've saved Giran! Return to Veteran Ascalon.\n

224.description: Hamil is an amazing archer! He was named Sagittarius at the age of 20! Defeat him and you'll gain his title, the best archer in the whole kingdom!

steps.title: The Test of Sagittarius
steps.description: Hamil in Floran Village is a genius archer from Innadril. Visit him and earn his respect.\n

steps.title: Watchman of the Wastelands
steps.description: Evil is afoot in the Ant Nest of the Wastelands. Meet Sir Aron Tanford, the watcher of the Wastelands.\n

steps.title: A Mark at the Ant Nest
steps.description:
Brankel disappeared into the Ant Nest while searching for pagans. Go to the Ant Nest in the Wastelands and look for clues.

Monsters to Hunt - All Monsters in the Ant Nest

steps.title: Hunter's Rune
steps.description: A rune used by hunters. Take it to Hamil to find out what it means.\n

steps.title: Where Is the Black Egg?
steps.description: The children of Shilen have been acting suspiciously. Visit Prefect Vokian in Giran Castle Town and investigate the movements of the Breka Orcs.\n

steps.title: Searching For Remains of the Snake
steps.description:
Prefect Vokian asks you to investigate all Breka Orc Shamans and Overlords and bring him anything snake-like that you find.

Monsters to Hunt - Breka Orc Overlords, Breka Orc Shamans

steps.title: Return to Vokian
steps.description: You've found a snake-shaped amulet. Take it to Prefect Vokian.\n

steps.title: Brankel's Message
steps.description: The snake amulet summons a totem spirit. To decode Brankel's message, take this information to Hamil.\n

steps.title: Crescent Moon Bow
steps.description: The evil spirit Kadesh has been resurrected! You must have a crescent moon bow to defeat him. Go to the Ivory Tower of Oren and meet Magister Gauen.\n

steps.title: Broken Bow
steps.description:
A crescent moon bow is essential if you are to defeat Commander Kadesh. This one needs a lot of work, however. To restore its function you must obtain some materials... 

Monsters to Hunt -
Crater of Ivory Tower: Manashens
Cruma Marshlands: marsh spiders, marsh stakato workers, marsh stakato soldiers and marsh stakato drones. 
Death Pass: road scavengers

steps.title: Restoring the Crescent Moon Bow
steps.description: You've obtained the materials needed to restore the crescent moon bow. Take them to Magister Gauen in the Ivory Tower.\n

steps.title: Resurrected Evil Archer
steps.description: The crescent moon bow has been restored. It can only shoot wooden arrows. Return to Hamil to find Kadesh's location.\n

steps.title: Evil Spirit Hunting
steps.description:
The evil spirit Kadesh is building his power by consuming Leto Lizardmen. You'll find Kadesh if you hunt them. You can only kill him with the crescent moon bow. Remember, you mustn't use any skill when you kill him!

Monsters to Hunt - Leto Lizardmen, Evil Spirit Kadesh

steps.title: Return to Hamil
steps.description: You've killed the evil spirit Kadesh. Return to Hamil.\n

225.description: Searchers find things which are hidden. To obtain the mark of the searcher, speak with Alex in Floran Village. He was once known as the best scout in the kingdom!

steps.title: Scout of the Kingdom
steps.description: A Searcher has the ability to find hidden things. To obtain the mark of the searcher, visit Alex in Floran Village. He was once known as the best scout in the kingdom.\n

steps.title: Alex's Aide
steps.description: Alex asks you to meet with Leirynn, his aide. She'll tell you what to do.\n

steps.title: Shaman of the Delu Lizardmen
steps.description:
Leirynn orders you to kill the Delu lizardman Shaman in this area.

Monster to Hunt -  Delu Lizardman Shaman

steps.title: Return to Leirynn
steps.description: You've destroyed the Delu lizardman Shaman. Report back to Leirynn.\n

steps.title: Kakis, Chief of the Delu Tribe
steps.description:
Classified documents have revealed that the Delu lizardmen's sole purpose was to find something. Chief Kalkis might know something!

Monster to Hunt -  Delu Chief Kalkis

steps.title: A Suspicious Map
steps.description: You've defeated Kalkis. He has a suspicious map, doesn't he? Return to Leirynn and find out more about it.\n

steps.title: Report to Captain Alex
steps.description: Leirynn doesn't know what the map is for and asks you to take it to Captain Alex.\n

steps.title: Search For the Lost Gold Bars
steps.description: The map shows the location of forgotten gold bars left behind by a general of the Lord's royal guards! Visit Borys in the Town of Gludio who was a royal guard at that time.\n

steps.title: Loosen the Drunkard's Lips
steps.description: Borys isn't going to say a word unless you bring him the best malrukian wine that Tyra can find.\n

steps.title: Red Spore Dust
steps.description: Tyra is willing to exchange the wine for 10 pouches of red spore dust. You can get red spore dust from the giant fungus at the Sea of Spores!\n

steps.title: Return to Tyra
steps.description: You've obtained 10 pouches of red spore dust. Take them to Tyra and trade them for malrukian wine.\n

steps.title: A Happy Drunkard
steps.description: Take the malrukian wine to Borys and get the information!\n

steps.title: The Gold Thief
steps.description: The four royal guards conspired together to conceal the lord's gold. One of them is a man whose name is Jax. He must be protecting merchant convoys in the southern section of the Wastelands. Let's go find him! \n

steps.title: Find the Torn Map
steps.description:
The guards tore the map into 4 pieces and ran away. One of them was killed by road scavengers and another lost his life to the hangman tree. Find the map pieces!

Monsters to Hunt -
Death Pass: Road Scavengers
Execution Grounds: Hangman Trees

steps.title: Return to Jax
steps.description: You've found the pieces of the map that were held by Solt and Makel. Visit Guard Jax to complete the map!\n

steps.title: The Treasure's Location
steps.description: As you piece together the 4 parts of the map, a coordinate appears. Go there!\n

steps.title: A Treasure Box
steps.description: You've discovered a rusty box and a key. Can you open it?\n

steps.title: The Gold Bars Are Discovered!
steps.description: You've discovered 20 gold bars in the rusty box! Take them to Alex right away!\n

steps.title: Alex's Letter of Recommendation
steps.description: Alex writes you a letter of recommendation to give to Master Luther. Take it to him now!\n

226.description: The mark of the healer is only bestowed upon those who recognize the power of purifying light. Prophecies speak of a female who will save the world from darkness and chaos! The conspiracy begins with her..

steps.title: The Girl of Prophecy
steps.description: Ancient revelations tell of a girl that will be born to save the world from the forces of darkness. A girl has been born who claims to be the saint described in the prophecy. Speak with Perrin in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Perrin's Bodyguard
steps.description: Perrin's bodyguard has appeared! Kill him!\n

steps.title: The Evil Perrin
steps.description: You've defeated Tatoma, Perrin's bodyguard. Listen to what Perrin has to say.\n

steps.title: The Ringleader
steps.description: Perrin's companion, Allana is behind this. Find her.\n

steps.title: An Orphan Girl
steps.description: Allana scoffs and claims she only saw such a girl once, in the orphanage near Gludio Castle.\n

steps.title: A Poor Orphanage
steps.description: The orphanage is having serious financial difficulties. They could survive if only they had 100,000 adena.\n

steps.title: A Girl of the Wastelands
steps.description: The head of the orphanage gratefully accepts your 100,000 adena. But one of the girls seems to be missing.\n

steps.title: A Mysterious Girl
steps.description: Windy is a mysterious girl who talks to monsters. She says she'll return to the orphanage and asks you to go there first. Return to the orphanage.\n

steps.title: An Elf from Gludio
steps.description: You haven't find out anything about the saint, but an Elf from Gludio named Sorius might know something.\n

steps.title: Tracking the Followers of Shilen
steps.description: The girl was kidnapped by the followers of Shilen. Meet Daurin Hammercrush in the western part of the Turek Orc Camp!\n

steps.title: Destroy the Leto Lizardmen!
steps.description:
Destroy the Leto Lizardmen!

Monsters to Hunt - Leto Lizardmen

steps.title: The First Secret Letter
steps.description: You've defeated the Leto Lizardmen and obtained the first secret letter! Return to Daurin.\n

steps.title: To the Obelisk!
steps.description: The secret letter describes a ceremony that would take place at the obelisk in the Dark Elven Forest. You may find a clue there. Hurry up! Look for help on the way!\n

steps.title: Subjugate the Forces of Darkness! - Part 1
steps.description:
The mysterious Dark Elf has summoned new recruits! Kill them!

Monsters to Hunt - Leto Lizardman Assassins

steps.title: Tracking the Dark Elf - Part 1
steps.description: You defeated the Leto Lizardmen. Now attack the mysterious Dark Elf!\n

steps.title: Subjugate the Forces of Darkness! - Part 2
steps.description:
More recruits! Defeat them all!

Monsters to Hunt - Leto Lizardman Snipers

steps.title: Tracking the Dark Elf - Part 2
steps.description: You've defeated the Leto Lizardmen. Now attack the mysterious Dark Elf!\n

steps.title: Subjugate the Forces of Darkness! - Part 3
steps.description:
More recruits! Kill the enemy one more time!

Monsters to Hunt - Leto Lizardman Mystics, Leto Lizardman Lords

steps.title: Tracking the Dark Elf - Part 3
steps.description: You've defeated the Leto Lizardmen. This is the end! Keep attacking the mysterious Dark Elf!\n

steps.title: Where is the Saint?
steps.description: The spell that imprisoned the saint has been broken. But where is the saint? Daurin's people may know. Look for clues nearby!\n

steps.title: Finding the Saint
steps.description: The saint can be found in a tent near the Dark Elven Altar of Rites. Find her!\n

steps.title: The Duty of the Saint
steps.description: The Goddess has begun to open her eyes.\nKristina says she has things to do here and asks you to deliver a letter to Master Sorius on her behalf.\n

steps.title: The Trial of the Healer
steps.description: Sorius thanks you for a job well done and promises to speak to Bandellos on your behalf. Return to Priest Bandellos.\n

227.description: Seekers of the true faith, whoever wishes to become a bridge between this world and the next as a Priest, should speak to an exiled preacher named Sla, a true man of faith.

steps.title: To Advance the Light
steps.description:
Do your part to make the world a better place. Use Disrupt Undead to defeat the Nameless Revenants who haunt the Execution Grounds.

Monsters to Hunt - Nameless Revenants

steps.title: Aruraune
steps.description:
A strange entity has emerged among the Nameless Revenants! Kill it! 

Monster to Hunt -  Aruraune

steps.title: A Large Nail
steps.description: Aruraune disappears after telling you that truth would soon be clear. Could this be what Priest Pupina was talking about?\n

steps.title: Shout From the Wilderness
steps.description: The iron nail stuck in Aruraune's head is a tool for brainwashing. Is a temple injecting their religious doctrines directly into people's heads? Visit Preacher Sla in Wastelands to find the answer.\n

steps.title: Light for the Ol Mahum
steps.description: One of Preacher Sla's disciples is a missionary for the Ol Mahum. Meet Katari near the waterfall in the Neutral Zone.\n

steps.title: Protect the Pilgrim
steps.description:
Some Ol Mahums have been reformed by  the power of missionary work, but the Ol Mahum inspector is attacking them! Defend the Ol Mahum pilgrims!

Monster to Hunt -  Ol Mahum Inspector

steps.title: Ol Mahum Divided by 2
steps.description: You've killed the Ol Mahum inspector. Speak with Katari and the Ol Mahums again.\n

steps.title: Defeat the Betrayer!
steps.description:
There's a traitor among the Ol Mahum pilgrims! Kill the betrayer!

Monster to Hunt -  Ol Mahum Betrayer

steps.title: Return to Katari
steps.description: You've killed the Ol Mahum betrayer. Return to Katari.\n

steps.title: Search for the Betrayer
steps.description: The Betrayers may be somewhere else. Return to Preacher Sla and inform him that there are traitors!

steps.title: Scattered Disciples
steps.description: The other Ol Mahums have split into three groups and are scattered throughout the land. First, meet with Kakan in the southeastern Orc Village.

steps.title: Help the Ol Mahums!
steps.description: Use your magic to help the Ol Mahums defeat vicious Crimson Werewolves. Remember: don't attack the creatures directly unless you can kill them with one strike!\n

steps.title: Return to Kakan
steps.description: The Crimson Werewolves have been destroyed. Return to Kakan.\n

steps.title: Visit the Dwarven Village
steps.description: A wise warrior knows when to retreat. Visit Nyakuri in the Dwarven Village.\n

steps.title: Slay the Lizardman!
steps.description:
You must defeat the Lizardman in melee combat, without the aid of magic!

Monster to Hunt - Krudel Lizardman

steps.title: Return to Nyakuri
steps.description: You have defeated the Krudel Lizardman. Return to Nyakuri.\n

steps.title: Travel to Talking Island
steps.description: The Ol Mahums should be safe from Lizardmen attacks for some time. Meet Ramus near the waterfall on Talking Island.\n

steps.title: Preparing for a Memorial Service
steps.description:
Talking Island is a very beautiful place. Bone fragments are needed for a memorial service that will be held here soon. Go to the Elven Ruins and bring a bone fragment from each type of undead monster there.

Monsters to Hunt - Skeleton Archers, Misery Skeletons, Skeleton Marksmen, Skeleton Lords, Silent Horrors

steps.title: Return to Ramus
steps.description: You have collected the bone fragments needed for the memorial service. Return to Ramus.\n

steps.title: Letter from a Disciple
steps.description: Ramus is satisfied that he can hold the memorial service safely and asks you to deliver a letter to his mentor. Return to Sla.\n

228.description: Bard Rukal is searching for a mysterious song that he believes is the origin of elemental magic. He believes that this song will allow him to practice the ultimate magic!

steps.title: A Mysterious Melody
steps.description: A strange melody is only heard by those who have mastered elemental magic. Parina is the only one who knows it. You can find her in the temple of Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Casian the Elder
steps.description: The source of the song is most likely the singing flower, a legendary evil spirit. Casian should be able to tell you more about singing flowers, shouldn't he?\n

steps.title: Seed of the Singing Flower
steps.description:
Elder Casian informs you that there are several types of singing flowers. You must kill them all!

Monsters to Hunt -
Near Fellmere Lake: Singing Flower Phantasms
Oren Territory,  The Gods' Falls Next to Ivory Tower: Singing Flower Nightmares
South Puddle of Giran Castle Town: Singing Flower Darklings

steps.title: Seeds of the Singing Flowers
steps.description: You've eliminated the singing flowers and collected all their seeds. Take them to Bard Rukal.\n

steps.title: Collecting Elemental Tones
steps.description: You must have absolute tone in order to grow a millennium flower. Find the water undine in Fellmere Lake, the salamander of flames in the Ruins of Despair, the wind sylph at the northwest entrance to the Wastelands and the earth snake in the Ruins of Agony. They have the elemental tones.\n

steps.title: Secret of the Tones
steps.description: You've collected the tones of 4 spirits. Return to Rukal to create absolute tone.\n

229.description: The box contains the soul of the Dark Mage Aklantoth, from the time of the Elmoreden Empire! Before you can open it, you must answer his riddle.. What is the secret hidden in the riddle?

steps.title: Spirit of the Black Magi
steps.description: The box contains the soul of Aklantoth, a Magus of the dark arts during the Elmoreden era. To open it, you must answer his riddle. Start at the Luxury Shop in Giran Castle Town.\n

steps.title: Six Treasures of Aklantoth
steps.description: Three gems were sold at the auction. They were bought by Magister Iker and Dark Elf Kaira in the Town of Giran, and Trader Lara in the Town of Dion, respectively. Ask Nestle in Gludin where the other gems are. You must collect all 6 gems.\n

steps.title: To Orim of the Shadow
steps.description: You've collected all 6 gems. Now take them to Orim of the Shadow to have them put in the box.\n

steps.title: Evil Resurrected
steps.description: Entranced by the whispers of a demon, Orim resurrects him. You must defeat him before he regains his power!\n

steps.title: Evil Gone Missing
steps.description: The demon has disappeared! Return to Orim of the Shadow again.\n

steps.title: Sword of Binding and Soultrap Crystal
steps.description: To seal the revived Drevanul Zeruel, you must have the sword of binding and a soultrap crystal. Sir Klaus Vasper in Gludin has the sword of binding and Magister Iker of Giran Castle Town has the soultrap crystal. Visit them!\n

steps.title: Sealing the Evil
steps.description: You've obtained the sword of binding and soultrap crystal. Visit Orim of the Shadow and learn how to seal Drevanul Zeruel.\n

steps.title: Searching for Zeruel
steps.description: Zeruel is probably disguised as a Human somewhere in Floran Village. He must be dealt with at once! Strike the final blow with the sword of binding!\n

steps.title: Zeruel Must Be Defeated!
steps.description: Drevanul Zeruel's hiding place inside Fisherman Evert has at last been revealed! Kill him with the sword of binding!\n

steps.title: Sealing Evil
steps.description: Zeruel has been defeated! Return to Orim of the Shadow.\n

230.description: Summoning magic requires the user to make contact with a high-level and intelligent spirit it.  Once contact is made, the user must then control the spirit.  The Testimonies of Summoning is a competition between users of such magic.

steps.title: Making an Arcana Card
steps.description: The Testimonies of Summoning is a competition between Summoners for Arcana Cards. Visit Trader Lara in the Town of Dion to make an Arcana Card.\n

steps.title: Beginning Arcana
steps.description: Trader Lara will make you two arcana cards if you bring the necessary items. You must defeat 6 Summoners. Come back here after you get the items.\n

steps.title: A Battle of Summoners
steps.description:
You can challenge any Summoner, anytime, anywhere, with arcana cards.
Summoners must only fight against  other Summoners and should never be confronted directly.
One arcana card is consumed with each encounter.
You can find Summoners in the following locations: 

 West of the Elven Ruins: Summoner Almors
Near the south entrance of Wastelands: Summoner Basilla 
A remote house of  Beehives: Summoner Camoniell
ear the Mother Tree south of the Underground Fortress in the Elven Forest: Summoner Celestiel
Cruma Marshlands: Summoner Belthus
Gorgon Flower Garden: Summoner Brynthea.

steps.title: Pass the Test of the Summoner
steps.description: You have collected six types of Arcana cards from six Summoners. Take them to Head Summoner Galatea to receive a mark of her approval. \n

231.description: In order to become a maestro, you must pass the Test of Maestro. Lockrin of the Iron Gate who administers the test says that you must obtain and bring back recommendations from three other elders. Will you indeed be able to obtain recommendations from the three Dwarven elders who are known to have very high standards?

steps.title: The Elders' Recommendations
steps.description: Lockirin explains that if you wish to become a Maestro, you must obtain the recommendations of three elders. \n

steps.title: Return to Lockirin
steps.description: You've collected all three elders' recommendations. Return to Lockirin of the Iron Gate.\n

232.description: Overlords are born, not made. to become an Overlord who also holds the position of Chief, the candidate must pass the Test of the Lord. The test to determine if you are worthy to become an Overlord has begun!

steps.title: Totems of the Five Tribes
steps.description: Flame Lord Kakai says that you must meet the chiefs of all five tribes, except Hestui, and bring back their totems. The Atuba Chief, the Neruga Chief and the Urutu Chief can be found in the Royal Hall; the Duda-Mara Chief is in the Town of Oren and the Gandi Chief is in the Town of Dion.

steps.title: Return to the Flame Lord
steps.description: You've received the five totems from the five chiefs. Return to Flame Lord Kakai.\n

steps.title: Searching for an Ancestor
steps.description: Flame Lord Kakai orders you to go to Ancestor Martankus in the Cave of Trials. Pass his final test and then return.\n

steps.title: Kill the Ragna Orcs
steps.description:
Ancestor Martankus says that you must kill Ragna Orcs and bring their heads as proof.

Monsters to Hunt - Ragna Orc Prefects, Ragna Orc Seers

steps.title: Return to Martankus
steps.description: You've brought the heads of the Ragna Orcs and found  treasonous documents in their bodies. Take them to Ancestor Martankus.\n

steps.title: The First Orc
steps.description: You've done all that Ancestor Martankus asked of you. The very first Orc is coming to congratulate you personally! Will you meet with him?\n

steps.title: Return to Kakai
steps.description: The first Orc tells you an ancient secret and encourages you to become a Lord of the tribe in the future. Return to Flame Lord Kakai.\n

233.description: One of the highest posts a Shaman can hope to achieve is Warcryer. The Warcryer calls on the spirits of his ancestors who died in battle. To become a Warcryer you must retrieve the ashes of a great ancestor!

steps.title: Four Heroes' Ashes
steps.description: Seer Somak orders you to recover the remains of 4 warriors, Braki the Clever, Kiruna the Brave, Tonar the Super and Hermodt the Indomitable. Orim of the Shadow has the remain of Braki, Seer Racoy in Gludio Town has the remains of Kiruna, Seer Pekiron in the Town of Oren has the remains of Tonar and Seer Manakia in Giran Castle Town has Hermodt's remains.\n

steps.title: Return to the Seer
steps.description: You've recovered the remains of the 4 heroes. Take them to Seer Somak.\n

steps.title: Gifts for the Ancestors
steps.description: You've delivered the remains of 4 warriors to Seer Somak. Somak asks for a gift to offer his ancestors and asks you to bring 13 heads of Tamlin Orcs from the south of Aden.\n

steps.title: Return to Somak
steps.description: You've collected 13 heads of Tamlin Orcs. Return to Somak.\n

steps.title: Ancestor Martankus
steps.description: The heads of Tamlin Orcs are the best gifts for the ancestors. Visit  Ancestor Martankus in the Cave of Trials.\n
steps.completionNpcName: Entrance of the Cave of Trails

234.description: Many travelers looking for new hope follow the whispers of the lady of the wind!  Keep heart! You shall soon acquire the flame of purgatory!

steps.title: Save the Soul of Reiria
steps.description: The soul of Reiria, Maestro Reorin's dearly departed wife, is being held hostage by demons. He asks that you free her by slaying Messenger Cabrio and recovering the soul orb. He was last seen lurking in the northern part of the cemetery.\n

steps.title: Infernium Scepter
steps.description: In order to restore his honor, Maestro Reorin wishes to recover his masterpiece from the demons. He asks that you recover his three infernium scepters from Death Lord Hallate, his aide Kernon and Longhorn Golkonda, who can be found in the Tower of Insolence.\n

steps.title: Infernium Varnish
steps.description: Maestro Reorin asks that you go to Warehouse Freightman Cliff in the Town of Oren and obtain infernium varnish so he may continue his enhancement of the infernium scepters.\n

steps.title: Specially Made Hammer
steps.description: Maestro Reorin asks that you recover his hammer from Head Blacksmith Ferris in Aden Castle Town, who confiscated it after expelling the maestro from the guild.\n

steps.title: Maestro-Level Mold
steps.description: Go to Trader Zenkin in the Town of Oren and recover the maestro-level mold that he bought from Reorin.\n

steps.title: To Hardin's Academy
steps.description: Trader Zenkin informs you that Maestro Reorin's mold has already been sold to Magister Kaspar of Hardin's Academy. Try to obtain the mold from him.\n

steps.title: Baium's Blood
steps.description: Magister Kaspar offers to give you Reorin's mold in exchange for a sample of the blood of Baium. Baium is the emperor of the ancient empire who is sealed in a room atop the Tower of Insolence.  He is said to have turned into a beast-like creature. Magister Hanellin of Aden Castle Town will tell you how to enter his room. When you attack him, you must use a pipette knife and stab him with it.\n

steps.title: While Holding the Mold in Your Hand
steps.description: Take the mold back to Maestro Reorin.\n

steps.title: B-Grade Crystal
steps.description: B-Grade crystals are required to process melted infernium. Obtain and take 984 of them to Maestro Reorin.\n

steps.title: Equipment to be Used as an Offering
steps.description: You must melt a B-Grade weapon and mix it with infernium to create  a new alloy to neutralize the harmful aura of infernium. Obtain and take a B-Grade weapon to Maestro Reorin.\n

235.description: The star of destiny changes the fate of anyone who holds it! What is the secret of the ancient giants?

steps.title: Pure Silver, Silvery Light of Purity
steps.description: Magister Ladd tells you how to create Mimir's elixir. Magic Trader Wesley under the Ivory Tower will teach you the basic technique of mixing reagents. Magister Ladd tells you that the formula for pure silver is equal parts Lunargent and Quicksilver.\n

steps.title: True Gold, Sublime Stone(Stone of Supremacy)
steps.description: The second ingredient you'll need to make Mimir's elixir is true gold. Magister Ladd tells you that long ago, he gave his colleague, Joan of the Ivory Tower, some true gold. He suggests that you to go see her.\n

steps.title: In Search of a Sage's Stone
steps.description: Magister Joan tells you that in order to make true gold you will need the sage's stone. She asks you to go to the Silent Valley and find it for her. According to her, one of the chimera pieces is carrying it...\n

steps.title: Return the Sage's Stone to Its Owner
steps.description: You have obtained the sage's stone! Return to Magister Joan of the Ivory Tower in Oren.\n

steps.title: What is Your True Wish?
steps.description: Magister Joan made true gold for you. Now, return to Magister Ladd.\n

steps.title: Blood Fire, the Flames of Purgatory
steps.description: Blood fire is hot enough to meld true gold and pure silver. Slay the bloody guardian in Antharas' Lair and obtain blood fire. Use the mixing urn in the basement of the Ivory Tower to create Mimir's elixir.\n

steps.title: Mimir's Elixir - Last Stage
steps.description: You have obtained blood fire! It is said that if you mix it with pure silver and true gold, Mimir's elixir will be created... Use the mixing urn located in the basement of the Ivory Tower.\n

steps.title: Beyond the Fate
steps.description: You've obtained Mimir's elixir! Magister Ladd will tell you how to use it.\n

241.description: Talien is a bard who wanders around Aden Castle Town. He asks you to help him collect the stories of ancient heroes...

steps.title: Meet Gabrielle
steps.description: Bard Talien is collecting the records of ancient heroes. He has asked you to find a record regarding the seventeen heroes who confronted the Land Dragon Antharas. Go to Giran Castle Town and meet Gabrielle.\n

steps.title: Antharas Watchman Gilmore
steps.description: Gabrielle says that she doesn't know many heroes who have fought Antharas. She suggests that you meet Gilmore, Watchman of the Land Dragon Antharas, who was one of the seventeen heroes. He's become an undead and guards Dragon Valley.\n

steps.title: Elven Witch Baraham, Creature of Evil
steps.description:
Elven Witch Baraham was one of the seventeen heroes who fought Antharas. She became an evil creature of her own free will. She must be carrying "Legend of Seventeen" in her bosom.

Monster to hunt - Baraham

steps.title: Go to Talien
steps.description: Take the "Legend of Seventeen" that Baraham was carrying to Talien in Aden Castle Town. \n

steps.title: Where is Melody Maestro?
steps.description: It is rumored that a Melody Maestro in Heine has the echo crystal that contains a forgotten song of ancient bards regarding King Raul and his five knights. Go get the crystal. \n

steps.title: Malruk Succubus Claw
steps.description:
Melody Maestro Kantabilon told you that in order to repair the old echo crystal, he needs a special tool. He asked you to go to Dragon Valley and obtain at least 10 Malruk Succubus Claws.

Monsters to Hunt - Malruk Succubus and Malruk Succubus Turens

steps.title: Go to the Melody Maestro
steps.description: You've obtained 10 Malruk Succubus Claws! Now take them to Melody Maestro Kantabilon in Heine. \n

steps.title: Take the Echo Crystal to Talien
steps.description: Melody Maestro Kantabilon has given you the echo crystal containing the forgotten song. Return to Talien in Aden Castle Town. \n

steps.title: An Elf whose name is Stedmiel
steps.description: Go to Hunters Village and meet an Elf by the name of Stedmiel. Ask him about the poetry book containing the story of the Warriors who fought Beleth. \n

steps.title: Take the Faded Poetry Book to Talien
steps.description: Master Stedmiel gives you a poetry book in which the story of the warriors who fought against Beleth is written. Take it to Talien in Aden Castle Town. \n

steps.title: Talien's Sponsor Virgil
steps.description: Go see Dwarf Virgil, Talien's sponsor, in the Rune Township.\n

steps.title: Meet Ogmar
steps.description: Kassandra, Virgil's granddaughter, is suffering from an unknown illness. Ogmar, Virgil's colleague, may know a treatment for her illness. Seek his advice. \n

steps.title: Grand Seer's Miracle Cure
steps.description: Meet Grand Seer Rahorakti and ask him about some medicine for Kassandra, the sick Dwarven girl. \n

steps.title: In Search of Crimson Moss
steps.description:
Grand Seer Rahorakti tells you that to make the medicine that Kassandra needs, he must have Crimson Moss. You can obtain it by hunting Splinter Stakato Drones in the Swamp of Screams. Retrive five of them.

Monsters to Hunt -  Splinter Stakatos, Splinter Stakato Walkers, Soldiers, Drones

steps.title: Meet the Grand Seer
steps.description: Take the Crimson Moss to Grand Seer Rahorakti. \n

steps.title: Kassandra
steps.description: Take the medicine Grand Seer Rahorakti gave you to Kassandra. \n

steps.title: Return to Virgil
steps.description: Virgil, Kassandra's grandfather, wants to see you. \n

steps.title: Meet the Lady of the Lake
steps.description: There is a gathering of people who worship the Lady of the Lake. Meet one member of that group, Caradine, in the Town of Goddard. \n

steps.title: Meet Head Blacksmith Noel
steps.description: Head Blacksmith Noel is currently restoring ancient weapons for a new generation of heroes. Go help him with the restoration work. \n

steps.title: Obtain the Ingredients for Noel
steps.description: Obtain the materials Noel needs to restore the ancient weapons. Collect five Lunargents and one bottle of Hellfire Oil. Magic Trader Wesley at the Ivory Tower will tell you how to obtain these materials. \n

steps.title: Return to Caradine
steps.description: You've provided Noel with all the materials he needs. Now, go see Caradine, the messenger of the lake. \n

242.description: Virgil, a Dwarf who worships the Lady of the Lake, asks you to help his granddaughter who has been tormented by a strange nightmare...

steps.title: A Girl's Nightmare
steps.description: Have a conversation with Kassandra, Virgil's granddaughter. \n

steps.title: Scenery in the Dream
steps.description: Talk to Ogmar regarding the vision Kassandra saw in her dream. \n

steps.title: Into the Swamp of Screams
steps.description: Go to the place Ogmar told you about and look for clues. \n
steps.completionNpcName: East of the Swamp of Screams

steps.title: Find a Clue
steps.description: As suggested by the Mysterious Dark Knight, go investigate the Angel corpses. \n

steps.title: Golden Clue
steps.description: You've discovered a strand of blonde hair from an Angel's corpse. Take it to Mysterious Dark Knight. \n

steps.title: In Search of the Witch
steps.description: Take the strand of blonde hair you found from the angel's corpse and go see Witch Kalis. \n

steps.title: Meet the Witch's Disciple
steps.description: Go to Alchemist Matild, pick up an ingredient needed for sorcery, and bring it back. \n

steps.title: Back to Witch Kalis
steps.description: You've received the ingredient needed for the practice of sorcery from Alchemist Matild. Now take it with you and return to Witch Kalis. \n

steps.title: To the Valley of Saints
steps.description: Witch Kalis knows the whereabouts of the Lady of the Lake. She's in the Valley of Saints. \n

steps.title: A Closer Look at the Unicorn
steps.description: All the cornerstones that trapped the Fallen Unicorn have disappeared. Now check on the unicorn.\n

steps.title: Return to Kassandra
steps.description: You've rescued the Lady of the Lake who had taken on the appearance of a pure white unicorn. Return to Kassandra in the Rune Township.\n

246.description: Caradine asks you to help the Lady of the Lake recover her lost strength...

steps.title: Meet Ossian
steps.description: Ask Ossian what you need to do to restore the strength of the Lady of the Lake. \n

steps.title: Oppressors of Splendor
steps.description:
Recover the Ring of Goddess: Waterbinder and Necklace of Goddess: Evergreen. The ring can be obtained from a Pilgrim of Splendor and the necklace can be obtained from a Judge of Splendor.

Monsters to Hunt - Pilgrims of Splendor and Judges of Splendor

steps.title: Recovered Ring and Necklace
steps.description: You've recovered the Ring of Goddess: Waterbinder and the Necklace of Goddess: Evergreen. Take them to Ossian in the Town of Goddard. \n

steps.title: Flame of Splendor, Barakiel
steps.description: Go to the Valley of Saints and confront Barakiel, the Flame of Splendor. Slay him and recover the Rain Song, Staff of the Goddess.\n

steps.title: Take the Rain Song to Ossian
steps.description: Take Rain Song, the Staff of the Goddess, to Ossian in the Town of Goddard.\n

steps.title: To the Ivory Tower
steps.description: Deliver the three sacred relics of the goddess to Magister Ladd at the Ivory Tower.  He's discovered a way to tap the sacred power contained within them.\n

247.description: Caradine asks you to help the Lady of the Lake recover her lost strength...

steps.title: Meaningful Encounter
steps.description: Finally, it's time for you to meet the Lady of the Lake. Have a conversation with Caradine and you can meet her. \n

steps.title: Meeting Place
steps.description: The Lady of the Lake is waiting for you here. Speak with her and wake the precious soul that lies dormant within you! \n

257.description: Talking Island's immigration policy has been relaxed in order to give refuge to those who have fled the violence of the Gracian War. But it's still quite a dangerous place!

steps.title: War with the Primitive Tribe
steps.description: The plan to move the people of Gludio to Talking Island has been announced. The island must be made safe for them. Eliminate the Orcs and werewolves and bring proof to the Lord. Then, you'll be rewarded. Hunt Orcs, Orc archers, Orc fighters, Orc lieutenants, Orc fighter leaders, werewolves, werewolf hunters and werewolf chieftains.\n

258.description: Sir Windawood has ordered the newly-appointed Archon to form a militia to improve security on the island. He has placed a large order for leather armor from Trader Lector. Gather wolf pelts to help secure peace on Talking Island!

steps.title: Wolf Pelts
steps.description: Sir Windawood asks Trader Lector to create leather equipment for the militia. Lector is a great tailor, but is short of materials. He asks you to collect forty wolf pelts and bring them to him right away.\n

steps.title: Return to Trader Lector
steps.description: You've collected 40 wolf pelts. Take them to Trader Lector so he can make leather armor for the militia.\n

259.description: Edmond and Marius dream of building a successful ranch on Talking Island, but certain eight-legged monsters stand in their way...

steps.title: Establish a Ranch!
steps.description: Edmond and his friend Marius want to build a ranch on Talking Island, but giant spiders are killing their livestock. They are offering rewards to hunters based on the number of spiders' husks that they bring back. If you take the husks to Marius, Edmond's partner, you will receive supplies. Hunt giant spiders, blade spiders and talon spiders.\n

260.description: Kaboo Orcs from the Misty Mountains have begun invading the Elven Forest. They've even infiltrated the village under the very eyes of the guards! All brave Elves who can help are asked to report to Sentinel Rayen!

steps.title: Hunt for Kaboo Orcs
steps.description: The Kaboo Orcs in the Misty Mountains have begun attacking the Elven Forest. The Hierarch has ordered Sentinel Rayen to recruit warriors to battle them. The Hierarch will reward those who destroy Kaboo Orcs and bring proof.\n

261.description: Alshupes, an amateur zoologist, has a particular interest in the skins and claws of rare animals. He pays a reward to whoever brings him the legs of the giant mutant spiders that lurk near the village.

steps.title: Collect Spider Legs
steps.description: Alshupes, a collector of unusual claws and pelts, is interested in giant spiders. He asks you to bring him eight legs of crimson spiders, hook spiders or pincer spiders.\n

steps.title: Return to Alshupes
steps.description: You have collected eight legs of giant spiders. Take them to Alshupes to receive your reward.\n

262.description: Trader Vollodos reports an increased demand for special spores produced only in the Dark Elven Forest. He promises a reward to whoever brings him these special spores...

steps.title: Spore Fungus
steps.description: Trader Vollodos, who's had extensive dealing with the Mystics of the Ivory Tower, tells you that lately many Mystics are looking for fungus spores. He offers you a reward if you'll bring him fungus spores. He tells you that you can obtain spores by slaying spore fungi in the Dark Forest. Hunt green fungi and blood fungi.\n

steps.title: Return to Trader Vollodos
steps.description: You have collected 10 spore sacs. Take them to Trader Vollodos in the Dark Elf Village for a reward.\n

263.description: Our former slaves, the Balor Orcs, have dared to defy us! Now they're hiding in the mountains! Arise, warriors of Shilen, and teach our former slaves a lesson!

steps.title: Hunt for Balor Orcs
steps.description: Balor Orcs have invaded the Dark Forest, and the Dark Elves are fiercely defending their territory from their former slaves. Defeat the Balor Orcs and bring proof to Sentry Kayleen for a reward. Hunt Balor Orc archers, Balor Orc fighters, Balor Orc lieutenants and Balor Orc fighter leaders.\n

264.description: Trader Payne has developed a unique arrow that uses a wolf claw as its arrowhead! It is most effective in siege situations. Payne is paying rewards to whoever brings him wolf claws to fill the huge order of Kiel Nighthawk.

steps.title: Collect Claws
steps.description: Trader Payne is a famous maker of arrowheads. Recently he was asked by Sir Kiel Nighthawk to make hooked arrows from wolf claws. In order to make the arrows in time, he needs someone to help him to collect the ingredients. Collect and bring him fifty wolf claws. Hunt ashen wolves and goblins.\n

steps.title: Return to Trader Payne
steps.description: You've collected 50 wolf claws. Take them to Trader Payne so that he can make the arrows.\n

265.description: Our former slaves, the Imps, managed to escape while we were distracted by the war. It's time we teach those ungrateful wretches that no one escapes the Dark Elves!

steps.title: Imp Shackle
steps.description: The imps were created to serve the Dark Elves, but recently have broken the spell that had been binding them and escaped into the woods. The Dark Elven Tetrarchs are preparing a spell to recapture the imps, but they must have an imp shackle. Go to the Dark Elven Forest and take an imp shackle to Sentry Kristin. Hunt imps and imp elders.\n

266.description: Many keltir and wolves have grown unusually large in the Elven Forest, and are now breaking the rules of nature by devouring nesting birds! The Pixy Queen is preparing some special magic to deal with them...

steps.title: Collect Fangs
steps.description: The Queen of the Pixies is preparing a spell to protect nesting birds in the Elven Forest from keltirs and wolves. Pixy Murika has been ordered to collect the ingredients needed. She asks you to bring her 100 red keltir or gray wolf fangs. She will reward you with a sparkling stone that was found in the forest. Hunt young red keltirs, red keltirs, elder red keltirs and gray wolves.\n

steps.title: Return to Pixy Murika
steps.description: You have collected 100 fangs. Take them to Pixy Murika so that the birds in the Elven Forest can be protected.\n

267.description: Treant Bremec, a spirit of the forest, is being tormented by wicked little goblins who recently invaded and began logging his forest. He asks for help in restoring peace to his beloved woods.

steps.title: Goblin Hunting
steps.description: The olen treants guarding the Elven Forest seek revenge on the goblins that damaged the forest. So far the sly goblins have managed to escape punishment. Treant Bremec asks for your help. Defeat the goblins and return the clubs that they stole to Treant Bremec and you shall be rewarded. Hunt the goblin raider.\n

271.description: Are you a real Orc Fighter or just a wannabe? Prove yourself!

steps.title: Kasha Wolf Fang
steps.description: Praetorian Rukain treats young Orcs as if they were children. He believes that those who wish to become Orc Fighters must prove their valor by hunting kasha wolves and bringing back fifty of their fangs.\n

steps.title: Return to Praetorian Rukain
steps.description: You have taken 50 fangs from the kasha wolves. You have done what it takes to become a brave Orc Fighter. Return to Praetorian Rukain and receive your Proof of Valor.\n

272.description: Those impudent goblin grave robbers have insulted the ancient spirits for the last time! There's no longer any reason to put up with their insolence! Let them now taste Orcish steel!

steps.title: The Terrible End of a Grave Robber
steps.description: Seer Livina says that the spirits of the ancestors have been angered by repeated desecrations of Utuku graves by goblin grave robbers. Kill the goblin grave robbers and bring back fifty of their heads. Only then can Seer Livina perform a ritual that will calm the anger of the ancestors. You will find the goblin grave robbers in Valley of Heroes and the goblin tomb raider leaders on the northern Immortal Plateau.\n

steps.title: Return to Seer Livina
steps.description: You have collected 50 heads of goblin grave robbers. Take them to Seer Livina.\n

273.description: Imps are invading the Immortal Plateau, the ancestral Orcish homeland! Those impetus and foolish imps don't stand a chance against us! In the sacred name of Pa'agrio, the Lord of Flame! Arise, Orc warriors! Drive this scourge from our land!

steps.title: Rakeclaw Imp
steps.description: Atuba Chief Varkees reports that rakeclaw imps have invaded the Immortal Plateau, polluting the Holy Land of the Orcs. He explains that rakeclaw imps were created and are being controlled by someone who uses witchcraft. Defeat the vile invaders and collect the soulstones embedded in their hearts to find out who is controlling them. If you bring the red soul stones back to Varkees, you'll receive a greater reward. In Valley of Heroes you must kill rakeclaw imps and rakeclaw imp hunters. On the northern Immortal Plateau, hunt rakeclaw imp chieftains.\n

274.description: The fiendish Maraku Werewolves will pay for murdering a messenger of the Lord of Flame! In the name of Pa'agrio, kill them all!

steps.title: Blood Relatives' Revenge
steps.description: War has been declared against the Maraku Werewolves who have dared to kill the Pa'agrio Lord's messenger! They have sent the messenger's head to us in spite! Prefect Brukurse asks you to slay the Maraku Werewolves and to bring back forty of their heads.\n

steps.title: Return to Prefect Brukurse
steps.description: You have collected 40 Maraku werewolf heads. Take them to Prefect Brukurse.\n

275.description: The time has come for the traitor Baranka to pay for his crimes. Destroy the darkwing bats who spy on the tribes of the kingdom.

steps.title: Baranka's Messenger
steps.description: Baranka is plotting the destruction of the Orc kingdom. He's using darkwing bats to spy on the Orcs. The Magisters have requested darkwing bat fangs in order to protect their territories from the approaching beasts. Neruga Chief Tantus has asked that you hunt darkwing bats and bring back seventy of their fangs. Hunt darkwing bats and Baranka's trackers.\n

steps.title: Return to Neruga Chief Tantus
steps.description: You've collected 70 darkwing bat fangs that can be used to stop Baranka's influence. Take them to Neruga Chief Tantus and set up a magic force field that will block Baranka's spell.\n

276.description: The gray bear totem, longtime guardian of the Hestui Tribe, is under attack from the forces of the evil spirit Kasha! Save the gray bear totem from its grisly fate!

steps.title: Purification of the Grizzlies
steps.description: Many gray bears on the Immortal Plateau have recently become possessed with the evil spirit of Kasha, the spirit of death and decay. This worries Seer Tanapi, who explains that the gray bear is the protective totem of the Hestui Orc tribe. He asks you to kill the possessed gray bears and put their souls to rest. While hunting kasha bears, you will run into the Kasha bear totem spirit. Kill it and take the proof to Seer Tanapi. Hunt Kasha bears and Kasha bear totem spirits.\n

steps.title: Return to Seer Tanapi
steps.description: You've obtained the crystals of the Kasha bear totem spirits! Take them to Seer Tanapi.\n

277.description: Gatekeeper Tamil must make an offering to a totem of spider in order to complete his teleportation studies at the Ivory Tower.

steps.title: Collect Starstones
steps.description: Gatekeeper Tamil says that in order to complete his teleport magic, he needs the aid of the totem spirit of the spider. To get this, he must make regular offerings. He asks you to collect 20 starstones from the greystone golems. He will reward you with a token for a free teleportation to Gludin.\n

steps.title: Return to Gatekeeper Tamil
steps.description: You've collected 20 Starstones by knocking down Greystone Golem. Bring them to Gatekeeper Tamil and have a new ritual ceremony.\n

291.description: As a child, Maryse Redbonnet narrowly escaped being eaten by wolves. Her family was not so lucky. She has sworn revenge on all wolves!

steps.title: Maryse's Anger
steps.description: Maryse Redbonnet lost her family and very nearly her own life to wolves as a child, and therefore burns with hatred for them. She asks that you hunt the black wolves around the village, gather forty of their pelts and bring them back to her. She will reward you with her grandmother's heirloom.\n

steps.title: Maryse's Revenge
steps.description: As Maryse Redbonnet requested, you've hunted wolves and collected 40 wolf pelts. Take them to her.\n

292.description: Convoys of the Golden Wheel Guild have recently come under daring attacks from goblin bandits. For the sake of Maphr, this outrage must be avenged! Let's give those goblins a dose of Dwarven justice!

steps.title: Goblin Hunting
steps.description: Elder Spiron of the Golden Wheel Guild says that his guild has suffered extensive trade losses recently because of goblin brigands, and asks you to purge them from the mountains. Defeat the goblins, collect their necklaces and bring them back for a reward. Hunt goblin snoopers, goblin brigands, goblin brigand lieutenants, goblin brigand leaders and the goblin lord.\n

steps.title: Suspicious Contract
steps.description: When you re-assemble the pieces of the memo, you see that it's a contract between the Silver Scale Guild and a bandit. Elder Spiron of the Golden Wheel Guild and Balanki of the Silver Scale Guild would both find this very interesting... Or you could continue to hunt... Hunt the goblin snoopers, goblin brigands, goblin brigand lieutenants, goblin brigand leaders and the goblin lord.\n

293.description: Elder Filaur, an expert in the construction and mining business, has learned that Otuk Orcs have recently discovered a long-lost chrysolite mine...

steps.title: Chrysolite
steps.description: Elder Filaur of the Gray Pillar Guild asks you for help in searching for hidden Chrysolite veins. Defeat the Utuku Orcs and bring the Chrysolite Ore they possess to receive a reward. Also collect the four pieces of the map that reveals the location of the vein, and take them to Maphr Priestess Chichirin who will put them together for you. Then, take the map to Elder Filaur to claim a great reward. Hunt Utuku Orcs, and Utuku Orc Grunts in Frozen Valley. Hunt Utuku Orc Archers in the Western Mining Zone.\n

294.description: The Bronze Key Guild has dealt in rare ingredients for millenia. They're looking for someone to hunt bats for an important client.

steps.title: Hardin's Request
steps.description: The notorious Black Mage Hardin has asked the Bronze Key Guild to gather bat fangs. For unknown reasons Elder Keef has accepted this request and begun covert dealings with Hardin. Hardin has asked them to slay blade bats or barbed bats and bring back 100 of their fangs. It's dirty work, but the warriors of the guild are happy to do it. You must be very discreet. Hunt blade bats and barbed bats.\n

steps.title: Return to Bronze Key's Keef
steps.description: You've collected 100 bat fangs. Hurry and take them to Elder Keef of the Bronze Key Guild before anyone sees you.\n

295.description: Arin of the Black Anvil Guild has long dreamed of flying, and is now studying the ancient technology of the Titans in pursuit of his goal... But he must first find a monster with a floating stone...

steps.title: Collect Floating Stones
steps.description: Elder Arin, leader of the Black Anvil Guild, has long dreamed of mastering the technology of the Titans and developing the ultimate flying machine. He requires research materials. He asks you to collect 50 floating stones and bring them to him. These stones may be obtained by hunting magical weavers.\n

steps.title: Return to Arin
