steps.description: You have collected 50 floating stones. Take them to Elder Arin of the Black Anvil Guild in Dwarven Village to claim your reward.\n

296.description: The Silver Scale Guild has received a special order for 20 spider silk outfits from the King of Elmore! They are for the emissaries to Aden and must be of the highest quality! Mion, a tailor at the guild, is frantic... He's short of both time and materials!

steps.title: Material for Formal Wear
steps.description:
The king of Elmore has requested the best spider silk formal wear to be made for the emissaries that are being dispatched to Aden. Trader Mion, a tailor from the Silver Scale Guild, doesn't have enough material and asks you to collect tarantula spider silk. Kill the hunter tarantulas and plunder tarantulas and bring back their silk for a reward. Spider silk may also be acquired by taking tarantula spinnerettes to Defender Nathan.

Monsters to Hunt - hunter tarantulas and plunder tarantulas.

297.description: Since Gatekeeper Wirphy began using the technology of the ancient Titans, he's had more business than he can handle! Now he's in need of some special ingredients to recharge his energy source...

steps.title: Collect Starstones
steps.description: Gatekeeper Wirphy of the Dwarven Village is made from the technology of ancient giants. She is exhausted after teleporting a large group of traders. She asks you to collect 20 starstones, the ancient giants' source of energy, and bring them to her. Hunt the whinstone golems.\n

steps.title: Wirphy's Energy Source
steps.description: You have obtained 20 starstones. Take them to Gatekeeper Wirphy in Dwarven Village.\n

298.description: The Maille Lizardmen slowly and menacingly approach the castle. Their secret power will soon be revealed.

steps.title: The Guard's Report
steps.description: Magister Rohmer of the Town of Gludio has been observing the activities of the Maille Lizardmen on the west side of town. Guard Praga asks you to deliver the data and reports his men have collected to Magister Rohmer.\n

steps.title: Search for Beads
steps.description:
You've discovered the sorcery the Maille Lizardmen use to control the spiders. Magister Rohmer can render their sorcery useless if he can only get enough beads. Bring him some beads!

Monsters to Hunt - Maille Lizardman Warriors, Maille Lizardman Shamans, Maille Lizardman Matriarchs, Poison Arachnids and King Arachnids

steps.title: Collection Complete
steps.description: You've discovered clues to the conspiracy between the Maille Lizardmen and the arachnids. Return to Magister Rohmer.\n

299.description: To make a special pie for this weekend's banquet, help Emily collect honey from bees.

steps.title: Collecting Honey Pouches
steps.description:
Mrs. Emily wants to bake a pie for the tea party at the temple this weekend. Collect honey from wasps in the Beehive area.

Monsters to Hunt - Wasp Leaders and Workers

steps.title: Collection of Honey Pouches Completed
steps.description: After much hard work,  you've collected 100 pouches of honey. Deliver them to Mrs. Emily.\n

steps.title: Fetch the Spices
steps.description: Mrs. Emily asks you to get spices from Miss Lara for her. You wouldn't go to the trouble if she wasn't so pitiful.\n

steps.title: Deliver the Spices
steps.description: You've got the spices from Miss Lara. Now return to Mrs. Emily.\n

steps.title: Fetch the Fruit Basket
steps.description: Mrs. Emily asks you to get the fruit basket from Bright. You wouldn't help her if she wasn't so old and frail, would you?\n

steps.title: Deliver the Fruit Basket
steps.description: Bright tells you to deliver the fruit basket to Mrs. Emily. How can they expect a mercenary like you to deliver fruit to a hobbled old lady?\n

300.description: Repulse the Leto Lizardmen that suddenly gained power!

steps.title: Hunt Leto Lizardman
steps.description:
Leto Lizardmen on the Plains of the Lizardmen are behaving very strangely. Don't interrupt their ritual, but destroy them, except their Shamans.

Monsters to Hunt - Leto Lizardmen, Leto Lizardman Archers, Leto Lizardman Soldiers, Leto Lizardman Chiefs and Leto Lizardman Warriors

steps.title: Collection of Lizardmen's Bracelets Completed
steps.description: You've collected all the evidence that you hunted Leto Lizardmen. Hurry up and take them to Guard Rath.\n

303.description: Minia is a collector of odd weapons from diverse cultures. She's recently begun collecting the weaponry of Turak Orcs, native to Talking Island...

steps.title: Tunath Orcs' Bow
steps.description: Master Minia of the Fighters Guild is a collector of odd weapons. She has recently become interested in the weaponry of the Tunath Orc marksmen, and asks you to retrieve their arrowheads in the Elven Ruins.\n

steps.title: Return to Master Minia
steps.description: You've collected 10 arrowheads from Tunath Orc marksmen. Take them to Master Minia of the Fighters Guild in Talking Island Village.\n

306.description: Hidden deep within the Elven Ruins are rare relics, once used in rituals honoring the ancient spirits of water and fire!... Destroy the evil that guards them and retrieve the priceless relics!

steps.title: Soulstone Fragment
steps.description: Trader Katerina specializes in jewelry. She asks you to go to the Elven Ruins and collect soul ore shards, which were used by ancient Elven mystics. Hunt salamanders and undines in the Elven Ruins to obtain flame shards and ice shards respectively. Hunt salamanders, salamander elders, salamander nobles, undines, undine elders and undine nobles.\n

313.description: The Sea of Spores was created by an evil magic set loose in the Great War over 2000 years ago! The evil poison has endured through the millenia, and even now is crossing the mountains, making its way straight towards the Elven Forest! The Elves are frantically trying to find a way to stop it.

steps.title: Research of Spores
steps.description: The Elven Forest is being slowly contaminated by the poisonous Sea of Spores. The Elven Hierarachs are researching a neutralizer with the aid of Trader Herbiel. Herbiel asks for spore powder, essential to the research. Collect 10 spore sacs from spore fungi found in the Elven Forest and take them to Herbiel.\n

steps.title: Return to Trader Herbiel
steps.description: You've collected 10 spore sacs. Take them to Trader Herbiel of the Elven Village so that they can be used for spore research.\n

316.description: The Elves have never forgiven the ratmen for introducing plague into their sacred Elven Forest... Not to mention their unholy alliance with the Dark Elves that resulted in the deaths of thousands of Elves! Master Ellenia is recruiting volunteers to destroy the filthy beasts...

steps.title: Plague Carriers
steps.description: The ratmen, known by Elves as "the plague carriers," were responsible for an epidemic in the Elven Forest and once fought on the side of the Dark Elves. Understandably, the Elves harbor great bitterness towards them. Master Ellenia asks you to kill the ratmen that are nesting in the Elven Underground Fortress. You must especially destroy Varool Foulclaw, their boss, and bring her back his fangs as proof. She has promised you a reward. Hunt the sukar wererats, the sukar wererat leaders and Varool Foulclaw.\n

317.description: Lireins are wind spirits, and can quickly stir up quite a storm! Within their bodies you'll find soulstone wind shards, good for a variety of purposes!

steps.title: The Spirit of the Storm
steps.description: Lireins, the spirits of the storm, possess a soulstone known as wind shard in their bodies. Rizraell asks you to collect them to create the Scroll of the Wind. Defeat the lireins and return the wind shards to Rizraell. You will find lireins near the Neutral Zone towards the end of the Elven Forest.\n

319.description: A bit of ground-up corpse skin is essential for growing nightshade...

steps.title: Special Fertilizer
steps.description: Trader Minaless, who grows herbs on the side, has recently been growing a flower called nightshade. This plant requires a special fertilizer known as zombie dust. You must have zombie skin in order to create zombie dust. Trader Minaless asks you to go to the Marshlands south of the Dark Forest, slay the marsh zombies and bring back five zombie skins.\n

steps.title: Return to Trader Minaless
steps.description: You've obtained five zombie skins as requested. Deliver them to Trader Minaless in Dark Elf Village.\n

320.description: Tetrarch Kaitar predicts the future with dead men's bones. He foresees an approaching darkness that threatens to destroy all the races! He needs a secret ingredient containing awesome death energy to fully understand the prophecy...

steps.title: Dead Men's Bones
steps.description: Tetrarch Kaitar tells the future by throwing the bones of the undead. He performs a monthly reading to predict any imminent threat to the Dark Elves. He needs more bone fragments of the undead and asks you to go and collect 10 of them for him. You can obtain them by going to the School of Dark Arts and slaying skeletons.\n

steps.title: Return to Tetrarch Kaitar
steps.description: You have collected 10 bone fragments from the undead skeletons. Take them to Tetrarch Kaitar and claim your reward.\n

324.description: Dark Elves are very fond of drevient wine, a drink made from the venom of spiders. Astaron, a master brewer, offers to make some for you if you'll bring him the ingredients he needs.

steps.title: Dreviant Wine
steps.description: Astaron explains that dreviant wine is brewed from spider venom. He wants to use grapes imported from Gludio a while back by Trader Vollodos. He asks that you obtain 10 spider venom sacs which are the most difficult to find among the ingredients he needs. Hunt spiders in the Dark Forest and return the sacs to Astaron for a reward. Hunt poison spiders, arachnid trackers and prowlers.\n

steps.title: Return to Astaron
steps.description: You've collected 10 spider venom sacs. Take them to Astaron so he can make dreviant wine.\n

325.description: Legend says that there is someone who collects bits and pieces of undead things... What could he be thinking?

steps.title: Collecting Corpses
steps.description: While discussing the ruins, Guard Curtis speaks of some good work and tells you about Samed. Visit Samed and talk about Curtis. You'll be asked to run an errand.\n

326.description: The Black Lion Mercenaries are seeking volunteers to help rid the kingdom of the last of the filthy Gracian invaders! After their humiliating defeat, most of the Gracians returned home, but a few stragglers stayed behind to loot and pillage. Stand with the Black Lion against the filthy invaders!

steps.title: War with the Ol Mahums
steps.description:
The Black Lion Mercenaries, hired by the Lord of Gludio to dispose of the ol mahums, have performed very poorly. Having suffered massive losses, they are recruiting skilled fighters to join their battle against the ol mahums. Defeat the ol mahums and collect their badges as proof. Leopold will reward you.

Monsters to Hunt - Ol Mahum patrols, Ol Mahum guards, Ol Mahum stragglers, Ol Mahum shooters, Ol Mahum captains, Ol Mahum recruits, Ol Mahum suppliers, and Ol Mahum generals.

327.description: All that awaited the farmers returning home from the long war was burned land and evil barbarians!

steps.title: Turek Orc Hunting
steps.description: Turek Orcs have infested the previously fertile farmland northwest of Gludio. On behalf of the farmers of Gludio, Farmer Piotur is recruiting mercenaries to drive out the Orcs from their stolen farmland. Slay the Turek Orcs, collect the proofs and take them to Piotur. He will give you a reward.\n

steps.title: Piotur's Mercenary
steps.description: Kill all the Turek Orcs and take proof to the farmer Piotur. He will give you a reward.\n

steps.title: Turek Orc Hunting
steps.description: Slay the Turek Orcs, collect the proofs and take them to Farmer Piotur. He will give you a reward.\n

steps.title: Relics of the Old Empire
steps.description: Guard Leiken explains that Magic Trader Asha, Trader Nestle and Magister Iris of Einhasad Temple are all quite knowledgeable about relics of the old empire.\n

steps.title: Expert of Relics
steps.description: According to Leiken, the only people in Gludin Village interested in imperial relics are Magic Trader Asha, Magister Iris of Einhasad Temple, and Trader Nestle in the grocery store.\n

328.description: Legends speak of a hidden treasure in the Wastelands... How could such a desolate place hold treasure?

steps.title: Find the Magical Ingredients
steps.description: Trader Sarien sells rare magical ingredients to the Ivory Tower of Oren. He tells you that you can acquire monster eye meat and jade in the Wastelandss. He also asks you to retrieve a monster eye carcass and a basilisk's gizzard.\n\nMonster to be hunted

329.description: Dwarves are naturally curious, but Rolento is even more curious than most! He's looking for some like-minded individuals to join him...

steps.title: Golem's Stoneheart
steps.description:
Dwarven Trader Rolento is interested in studying the internal structure and activation methods of golems. He's especially interested in their power source, and asks you to obtain a piece of stone that is known as "Heart Stone." It can be obtained from granite golems or punchers.

Monsters to Hunt - punchers and granite golems.

330.description: Chef Jonas' dream has always been to return to his hometown a world-class chef. He plans to enter a royal competition, which will be judged by none other than Magister Mirien, a notoriously finicky eater!... What ever shall he prepare...?

steps.title: Satisfy Magister Mirien
steps.description: Chef Jonas is preparing a monster eye steak for a competition. The judge is Magister Mirien, also known as the 'Adept of Taste'. You must collect the highest-quality ingredients in order to satisfy her.\n

331.description: The land dragon Antharas has been ravaging the kingdom of Aden for the past several years. There is one person in particular who seeks to avenge his tyranny...

steps.title: Death Arrow
steps.description: Guard Belton burns for revenge after losing his family to the land dragon, antharas. He is making a special arrow of harpy feather, medusa venom, and wyrm's tooth in order to slay the dragon. He asks you to help him collect the ingredients.\n\nMonster to

333.description: Evil spirits have taken advantage of Aden's weakness after the Gracian War to wreak havoc all over the kingdom. The Lords from each territory have called upon the Black Lion Mercenaries to drive the evil spirits away...

steps.title: War Mission
steps.description: Sophya, the captain of the Black Lion Mercenaries, asks that you help to rid the Town of Dion of monsters. Eliminate the undead on the Execution Grounds, the Ol Mahums in the Fortress of Resistance, the Delu Lizardmen on the southern shores and the Marsh Stakato in the Cruma Marshlands.\n

334.description: Alchemist Matild has long tried to create a mysterious potion. She recently discovered a book containing the recipe and asks you to bring it to her. She gives you a book of alchemy and gives you directions to the secret keeper tree.

steps.title: Secret Keeper Tree
steps.description: Alchemist Matild has long wished to create a mysterious potion. She has recently discovered its recipe and asks you to bring the ingredients to her. She gives you a book of alchemy, along with directions to the ingredients for the mysterious potion. Find the secret keeper tree.\n

steps.title: Return to Matild
steps.description: The secret keeper tree gives you a secret book. Return to Matild.\n

steps.title: Ingredients for a Wish Potion
steps.description:
Alchemist Matild gives you a list of materials and asks that you help find necessary materials to make a wish potion.

Monsters to Hunt -
Execution Grounds: Amber Basilisks
Windy Hill: Whispering Winds
Plains of Dion: Glass Jaguars
Cruma Marshlands: Horror Mist Rippers
 Plains of Dion: Silenos
Wastelands: Ant Soldiers, Ant Warrior Captains, Tyrants, Tyrant Kingpins
Gorgon Flower Garden: Turak Bugbears, Turak Bugbear Warriors

steps.title: Returning to Matild
steps.description: You've gathered all the materials. Return to Matild and make a wish potion.\n

steps.title: Matild's Mark
steps.description: Matild makes you a wish potion and gives you one bead with a promise to make it again anytime you bring the materials.\n

335.description: The Hunters Guild has a long, romantic history, and has always been in the dreams of youths who seek adventure... Whether they choose to hunt criminals or monsters! It's definitely not an easy task to join the Hunters Guild.

steps.title: Test of the Hunters Union
steps.description: Grey of the Hunters Union tells you about the union and says that in order to join, you must pass a test to obtain a hunter's license. Bring back three or more of the items listed on the test to receive a circle 1 hunter's license. Those in possession of such a license may carry out various missions for the guild.\n

steps.title: Hunting as a 1st Circle Member
steps.description: You now have the 1st circle hunter license! You can now receive and carry out hunting requests. Visit Hunter Guild Member Tor and confirm the orders. Or, you could go and meet people that hire hunters.\n

steps.title: Hunting as a 2nd Circle Member
steps.description: You now have the 2nd circle hunter license! You're now authorized to receive and carry out the hunting requests that are the purvey of 2nd circle hunters. Visit Tor and confirm the list of orders, or you could go and meet people that hire hunters.

336.description: Who would have thought that coin collecting could lead to such horrific chaos throughout the kingdom? It seems impossible to control now! Can you get the Coin Collector Membership 1?

steps.title: The Leader of the Hunter's Guild
steps.description: Coin Collector Warehouse Keeper Sorint asks you to meet with Hunters Union President Bernard and retrieve the golden dragon of Kaldis.\n

steps.title: A Coin in The Forest of Mirrors
steps.description:
Bernard's coin is a family heirloom and you can't have it. You might find something similar, however, since the Mystic who gave it to us  was ultimately killed by lizardman in the Forest of Mirrors..?

Monsters to Hunt - Harit Lizardman Shaman, Harit Lizardman Chief

steps.title: Return to Sorint
steps.description: You've obtained Kaldis's gold dragon coin. Take it to Warehouse Keeper Sorint.\n

steps.title: Level 3 Coin Collecting
steps.description: Sorint accepts the coin and offers you a Coin Collector Membership Level 3 as a reward. Get the coins by hunting monsters. You can also trade low-grade coins with other Level 3 members. Ask Sorint for details.\n

steps.title: Level 3 Coin Collectors
steps.description:
You can find other level 3 coin collectors at the following locations:

Entrance to Cruma Tower: Researcher Lorain
the Town of Oren: Warehouse Keeper Hagger
Hunters Village: Magister Page

steps.title: A Question for Bernard
steps.description: Ask Bernard what you should hunt to collect coins.\n

steps.title: Monsters Who Drop Coins
steps.description:
The following monsters are known to drop coins - 

Hunters Valley: Lakins
Plains of Glory: Vanor Silenos Shaman
Timak Outpost: Timak Orcs
War-Torn Plains: Hatar Hanishees
Forest of Evil: Formors, Tarlk Bugbears
Outlaw Forest: Ol Mahums
Dragon Valley: Malruk Succubus Turens, Headless Knights, Royal Cave Servants, Shackles
The Cemetery: Tortured Undead
Killing Ground: Grave Lich, Doom Servant, Doom Archer, Doom Knight
Garden of Wild Beasts: Kookaburra, Antelope, Bandersnatch, Buffalo
Valley of Saints: Claws of Splendor, Wisdom of Splendor, Punishment of Splendor, Wailing of Splendor
An Old Battlefield: Hungered Corpse, Bloody Ghost, Nihil Invader, Dark Guard

Take any coins you collect to Warehouse Keeper Sorint.

steps.title: Moving Up to Level 2
steps.description: To advance your membership level, you must obtain the following low-grade coins. Trade with other members for them and then take them to Sorint.\n

steps.title: Level 2 member
steps.description:
You've become a level 2 member of the Coin Collector's Club. You're now eligible for the level 2 premium and may trade with level 2 members.
Members who can be traded with at present: 
Level 2 Member
the Town of Oren: Guard Stan
Hunters Village: Blacksmith Duning
Underground Shop

steps.title: Moving Up to Level 1
steps.description: To become a Level 1 member, you must collect mid-grade coins. Take them to Sorint.\n

steps.title: Level 1 Membership
steps.description:
You've become a level 1 member of the Coin Collector's Club. You may now trade all premiums from Sorint and trade with all members.
Level 1 Members:
Aden Castle Town: Head Blacksmith Ferris
Giran Castle Town: Warehouse Keeper Collob
Floran Village: Grocer Pano

337.description: The land dragon Antharas has rampaged throughout the entire kingdom of Giran since he awoke from his ancient slumber. Gabrielle is  looking for a warrior to rid the land of this scourge.

steps.title: Guardian of the Seals
steps.description: The quest to obtain the portal stone, needed to enter Antharas' Lair. Seal Watchman Gabrielle warns that Antharas has been awakened, and asks you to join the party going to slay the dragon.  She says that Antharas' Lair is surrounded by a magical field and is unapproachable, but she thinks that the portal stone may activate the heart of the field and allow one to pass through. Only those acknowledged by the seal watchmen may receive the stone. Follow Gabrielle's instructions and visit the other four watchmen. Complete their assignments and receive their acknowledgements. The four watchmen of the seal are: Magister Kaiena of the Ivory Tower, Prefect Chakiris of the Hunters' Village, Master Kendra of Aden Castle Town and High Priest Orven of Aden Castle Town.\n

steps.title: Abyss Jewel
steps.description: Gabrielle says that there are those who long for the awakening of Antharas and that you must prevent their entry. She asks you to meet with Warehouse Chief Moke of Gludin and Blacksmith Helton of Oren. After meeting with them, seek and destroy the abyss jewel.\n

steps.title: Watchman of the Land Dragon Antharas
steps.description: Take the mark of watchman to Gilmore at the entrance to Dragon Valley.\n

steps.title: Portal Stone
steps.description: Kill the cave keeper and cave maidens in Dragon Valley and get the third abyss jewel. Destroy it and take the fragments to Theodric at the entrance to Antharas' Lair. \n

338.description: Giant alligators threaten Innadril! Trader Enbern is looking for someone to help him capture some the beasts...

steps.title: Alligator Hunting
steps.description: Trader Enverun asks you to join him on a hunting excursion to Alligator Island. He offers to pay you a reward for each alligator pelt.\n

340.description: Whilst beset from all directions, yet another force has begun threatening Gludio! Lizardmen have begun looting and pillaging throughout the land! Destroy them and restore the peace!

steps.title: Subjugation of Felim Lizardmen
steps.description: Guard Weisz's orders state that you must recover the cargo that belongs to the Aden trade union from the Felim lizardmen in the Fellmere Harvesting Grounds. Recover 30 units of cargo from the Felim lizardmen, Felim lizardman scouts and Felim lizardman warriors.\n

steps.title: Pilgrims' Remains
steps.description: The priests of Einhasad request that you retrieve the relics of pilgrims killed by lizardmen. Go to the temple in Gludin Village and meet with Priest Adonius.\n

steps.title: Agnes' Relics
steps.description: Recover Priestess Agnes' rosary and crucifix from the Langk Lizardmen on the southeast shore of Gludio.\n

steps.title: For the Peace and Safety of Gludio
steps.description: Priest Adonius requests your assistance in a matter vital to the security of the people of Gludio. Meet with High Priestess Levian at the Einhasad Temple.\n

steps.title: Slay Bifrons
steps.description: You must destroy the evil spirit Bifrons, recover the black mark from the box he protects and take it to High Priestess Levian. Bifrons can be found lurking on the south shore of Gludio.\n

steps.title: Ominous Totem
steps.description: Take the black mark from Bifron's box to High Priestess Levian in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Return to Weisz
steps.description: You have fulfilled all the requests made of you by Einhasad Temple. Now return to Guard Weisz.\n

341.description: The salmon returned to the river as quick as lightning! Grocer Pano rushed to sell fishing supplies, but unforseen problems threaten his very existence...

steps.title: Bear Hunting
steps.description: Grocer Pano asks you to drive away the bears that are threatening his proposed fishing resort west of Floran Village. Take 20 pelts to him to claim your reward. Hunt Dion grizzlies in the Dion Hills, grizzly bears and red bears on the Fellmere Harvesting Grounds, and brown bears on Windmill Hill.\n

343.description: The long-sought-after mineral, Nebulite, was used by the ancient giants as a magic amplifier. A secret mission is underway to secure a supply of it...

steps.title: Nebulite Orb
steps.description: Magic Trader Cema asks you to collect Nebulite orbs by killing monsters in a crater near the Ivory Tower of Oren. Dwarven Collector Marsha and Collector Trumpin were originally hired to do this work but Cema has not heard from them since they left. While collecting the orbs, if you happen to run into them, ask them what happened. Hunt manashen gargoyles, enchanted monster eyes, enchanted stone golems and enchanted iron golems.\n

344.description: Long ago, brave, sword-wielding warriors left to slay the land dragon, Antharas. Their shining armor and beautiful white horses gleaming in the sun, they headed off into the sunset to confront the beast, never to return...

steps.title: Relics of the Fallen Soldiers
steps.description: Antharas Watchman Gilmore seeks to avenge the soldiers who were made undead after failing in their brave attempt to subjugate the evil beast 1,000 years ago. He requests that you destroy the cave servants and recover the belongings of the fallen soldiers. Hunt cave servants, cave servant archers, cave servant warriors, cave servant captains and the royal cave servant.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Relics
steps.description: Gilmore asks you to take the fallen heroes' belongings to their descendents.\n

345.description: After many hardships, Locksmith Dorothy and her friends succeeded in stealing the treasure of the legendary pirate, Zaken! The shining fang awaited them near the village.

steps.title: Collecting Victim's Bones
steps.description: Locksmith Dorothy asks you to determine what happened to her recently vanished friends who disappeared along with a pirate's treasure. She fears that they were eaten by Crokians on the Field of Whispers and wants you to search there for their bones. Hunt Crokians and crokian warriors.\n

steps.title: In Search of a Dark Elf
steps.description: You find Dorothy's friends' bones but no other clues. Dorothy tells you a rumor of a clay jar, in the possession of the Dark Elf Guild, that supposedly has the power to raise the dead.\n

steps.title: Medium's Jar
steps.description: Magister Xenovia sells you the magic powder needed to summon dead souls with the clay jar.\n

steps.title: What Dorothy Wanted
steps.description: You have spoken with the spirit of the victim through the medium's jar.\n

steps.title: Who is this?
steps.description: The spirit in the medium's jar was no friend of Dorothy.\n

347.description: Isn't it said that insanity always lies at the heart of genius? Blacksmith Brunon dreams of being first to visit the moon, but must have something first...

steps.title: To the Trade Guild
steps.description: You must travel to the Dwarven Village to obtain a newly developed calculator for the blacksmith Brunon, who has promised a considerable reward. The Trade Guild will have information regarding the device.\n

steps.title: Where is the Female Dwarf?
steps.description: You learn that the calculator is in the possession of a female Dwarf, somewhere in the Dwarven Village. Go look for more information.\n

steps.title: He is closer to you than you think perhaps?
steps.description: Clues suggest that the device is closer than you think. Keep looking for more information.\n

steps.title: I've got it!
steps.description: Hmm... A female dwarf in Dwarven Village is in possession of the calculator and the person is closer than I think? I've got it! I know the answer!\n

steps.title: Silvera's Request
steps.description: Blacksmith Silvera will give you the calculator in exchange for 10 gemstone beasts.\n

steps.title: New Model Calculator
steps.description: Take the calculator to blacksmith Brunon.\n

348.description: Above the Tower of Insolence swirls a mysterious vortex. There the gods have sealed Baium, the arrogant creator of the tower. What can you learn there?

steps.title: The Search Begins
steps.description: A mysterious, swirling vortex over the tower of an ancient king.\n

steps.title: Hunt of Lesser Giants
steps.description: Magister Hanellin asks that you go to The Giant's Cave, defeat a lesser giant elder or a lesser giant mage and bring back the Titan's powerstone.\n

steps.title: Find Companions
steps.description: Learning of your wish to work with your companions, Magister Hanellin gives you three flowers and orders you to distribute them to each of your companions and then come back to her.\n

steps.title: Search by Yourself
steps.description: You have decided to work alone.\n

steps.title: Three Sacred Relics
steps.description: Magister Hanelin asks that you meet with Claudia Athebalt in Aden Castle Town, Martien in Giran Castle Town and Magister Harne in Dark Elf Village. At each meeting you will be given the location of an ark containing a sacred relic. They will mark on the map the location of each ark with a red flag. Once you find and retrieve a sacred relic, the red mark will disappear. Now, go and collect the three sacred relics. (If a flag disappears before you find a sacred relic, return to the person who marked its location on the map and make your inquiry again. The flag will reappear). If anything gets in your way, kill it and get the sacred relics.\n

steps.title: Owner of the White Flower
steps.description: Upon receiving the white flower Magister Hanellin gives you a letter and asks you to take it to Magister Harne in Dark Elf Village.\n

steps.title: Owner of the Red Flower
steps.description: Upon receiving the red flower Magister Hanellin gives you a letter and asks you to take it to Claudia Athebalt in Aden Castle Town.\n

steps.title: Owner of the Yellow Flower
steps.description: Upon receiving the yellow flower Magister Hanellin gives you a letter and asks that you take it to Martien in Giran Castle Town.\n

steps.title: In Search of Sacred Arks
steps.description: Claudia Athebalt explains that although she possesses the sacred chest she cannot open it, as it is being guarded by an angel. She requests that you kill the angel. Kill the ark guardian Elberoth.\n

steps.title: Locked Sacred Ark
steps.description: The sacred ark is locked. While examining the lock you are attacked by the ark guardian Elberoth.\n

steps.title: Key of Sacred Ark
steps.description: You have defeated Elberoth and retrieved the key to the sacred ark. Open it.\n

steps.title: Book of Saint
steps.description: You have unlocked the sacred ark and taken possession of the "Book of Saint". Gather up all three sacred relics and take them to Magister Hanellin in Aden Castle Town.\n

steps.title: In Search of Sacred Arks
steps.description: Martien explains that although the sacred ark has been located, it is being guarded by a werewolf wearing armor and cannot be opened. He requests that you destroy the ark guardian Shadowfang located near Tanor Canyon southwest of Giran Castle Town. Monster to hunt: ark guardian Shadowfang.\n

steps.title: Locked Sacred Ark
steps.description: The sacred ark is locked. As you are examining the lock, Shadowfang suddenly appears in front of you.\n

steps.title: Key of Sacred Ark
steps.description: You have slain Shadowfang and taken the key tp the ark from him. Open it.\n

steps.title: Bough of Saint
steps.description: You've opened the ark and acquired the bough of saint. Gather up all three sacred relics and take them to Magister Hanellin in Aden Castle Town.\n

steps.title: In Search of a Sacred Ark
steps.description: Magister Harne asks that you find a sacred ark hidden in the western Misty Mountains.\n

steps.title: Corpse of the Guardian of the Sacred Ark
steps.description: While examining the corpse of the ark guardian, an angel killer appears and claims that he killed the guardian.\n

steps.title: Key of Sacred Ark
steps.description: The angel killer tells you about a key hidden on the corpse of the guardian of the ark, and then disappears. Search the corpse for the key and open the sacred ark.\n

steps.title: Blood of Saint
steps.description: You have unlocked the ark and acquired the Blood of Saint. Gather up all three sacred relics and take them to Magister Hanellin in Aden Castle Town.\n

steps.title: Magister Hanelin
steps.description: You have obtained all three sacred relics. Go to Magister Hanellin in Aden Castle Town and ask her how to activate the angelic vortex.\n

steps.title: The time for investigation has come!
steps.description: You've obtained the three sacred relics and given them to Magister Hanelin. She says she needs time to investigate and asks you to go to a grocery store and buy five antidotes and a greater healing potion for her.\n

steps.title: White Fabric
steps.description: Magister Hanellin gives you three pieces of cloth, asks that you distribute them among your companions and then return to her.\n

steps.title: Blooded Fabric
steps.description: Magister Hanellin asks that you dip the cloths in the blood of a platinum overlord or a platinum shaman.\n

steps.title: Blooded Fabric
steps.description: Magister Hanellin promises to tell you a secret after you have dipped the cloths in the blood of a platinum overlord or platinum shaman.\n

steps.title: Angel's Blood
steps.description: Magister Hanellin gives you several white cloths and asks that you dip them in the blood of a seal angel or guardian angel and bring them back to her.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Blood
steps.description: Magister Hanellin asks that you deliver the blood-soaked cloths to Sir Gustav Athebaldt in the Town of Oren, to Hardin in Hardin's Academy and Iason Heine in Heine.\n

steps.title: Will New Blood Be Spilled?
steps.description: As a reward for successfully completing the delivery, you are given the reward that was promised. Magister Hanellin asks if you would like to continue to work for her.\n

steps.title: Blood Continues to Be Spilt
steps.description: Magister Hanellin gives you more white fabric and asks that you kill seal angels and guardian angels. Deliver 10 blood-soaked cloths and you'll receive another reward.\n

350.description: A great, unknown darkness looms on the horizon... Sensing the coming chaos, the Magisters and Maestros are preparing secret ways to counter the threat.

steps.title: Very Special Weapon
steps.description:
Many Magisters and Maestros have been recruiting volunteers to form a united front against the coming dark days. They have developed methods of strengthening weaponry as a way of empowering individual members of their forces. They tell you that now is the time to grow individual strength to prepare for the approaching darkness and ask you to learn to use enhanced weaponry...

Monsters that Soul Crystals can be used on -
Antharas' Lair: Malruk Knight, Malruk Berserker, Malruk Lord, Limal Karinness, Karik, Pytan, Pytan Knight
Devil's Isle: Bloody Bat, Unpleasant Humming, Death Flyer, Fiend Archer, Musveren, Zaken's Royal Guard, Kaim Vanul, Pirate Zombie Captain, Doll Blader, Vale Master, Sairon, Sairon's Doll, Sairon's Puppet, Light Bringer
Timak Outpost: Timak Orc Series, Timak Orc Troop Series
Fields of Massacre: Doom Servant, Doom Guard, Doom Archer, Doom Trooper, Doom Warrior, Doom Knight
Giants Cave: Halingka, Yintzu, Paliote, Hamrut, Kranrot
Forest of Mirrors: Forest of Mirrors Ghost, Mirror, Harit Lizardman, Harit Lizardman Grunt, Harit Lizardman Archer
Tower of Insolence: Erin Ediunce, Platinum Series, Angel Series
Garden of Eva: Nos, Blade Stakato Series, Water Giant, Queen Undine Lad, Eva's Seeker, Theeder Piker, Theeder Mage, Doll Master, Light Worm, Garden Guard Leader, Garden Guard

351.description: Tasaba lizardmen have stolen cargo belonging to Iason Heine, owner of the the most successful commercial guild in Heine! Kill the lizardmen and recover the cargo!

steps.title: Subjugation of Tasaba Lizardmen
steps.description: Captain Gosta of Heine asks you to kill the Tasaba lizardmen that stole the cargo belonging to Iason Heine's Commercial Guild. Slay the Tasaba lizardmen and bring back their fangs or the barrels of league that were stolen and Iason Heine will give you a reward. Kill the Tasaba lizardmen and Tasaba lizardmen shamans.\n

steps.title: Iason Heine's Reward
steps.description: The cargo belonging to the Commercial Guild of Iason Heine has been stolen by Tasaba lizardmen. You are hunting them. Bring back their fangs and Iason Heine will give you a reward. Recover the barrels of league that were stolen and he will give you some bills of Iason Heine worth 1000 adena each. If you take them to Head Blacksmith Roman in Heine he will exchange them for items.\n

352.description: Could it be true that a beautiful, noble pet has been discovered in the silent field of reeds?

steps.title: In Search of Lienrik's Eggs
steps.description: Pet Manager Rood of Heine wants to raise a new pet. He asks you to obtain lienrik eggs. A lienrik is a beautiful beast that lives in the Field of Silence. Female lienrik eggs are much rarer than male lienrik eggs. Hunt lienriks and lienrik lads.\n

353.description: Galman spends his time alone in Dragon Valley... Nobody wants to go near him, but he has a story to tell...

steps.title: Power of Darkness
steps.description: Galman is a businessman in Dragon Valley. He is very depressed because his lover is dying. Out of desperation he has begun delving into the powers of darkness. He asks you to find him a stone of contract. Hunt the Malruk succubus and the Malruk succubus turens.\n

354.description: After being driven from their trade routes from Giran to Innadril by the Humans, the Dwarven guild authorities agreed to establish new markets for their goods. However, they may get more than they bargained for...

steps.title: Subjugation on Alligator Island
steps.description: Warehouse Freightman Kluck of Heine intends to develop a free trade zone on Alligator Island. He asks you to wipe out the evil creatures there and bring him their teeth as proof. Take 100 or more proofs to him at once and he will give you a bonus. Hunt crokian lads, dailaon lads, crokian lad warriors, farhite lads, nos lads and swamp tribes.\n

steps.title: Recover the Stolen Antiques!
steps.description: Although Trader Galibredo of the Town of Oren is now a mere merchant, his roots are aristocratic. Some time ago, he purchased several busts made by the ancient sculptor, Berona. As they were being delivered to him they were stolen by orcs. He desperately wishes to recover the ancient statues, regardless of the cost. He promises an extra reward each time you bring him 100 or more statues. Hunt Timak orc troop archers, warriors, troop leaders and troop shamans.\n

356.description: The Wizards of the Ivory Tower have sought to stem the spread of the Sea of Spores since ancient times. Now they want a permanent solution to this problem.

steps.title: Collect Spores
steps.description: Magister Gauen of the Ivory Tower wishes to perform an in-depth study of the Sea of Spores. He asks that you bring him 50 carnivore spores and 50 herbivorous spores. Perhaps he would settle for just 50 of one type... Hunt rotting trees and spore zombies.\n

steps.title: Continue collecting? Or will you return?
steps.description: You've filled a spore sac. Do you wish to fill the other sac or do you wish to return to Magister Gauen at the Ivory Tower? Hunt rotting trees and spore zombies.\n

steps.title: Return to Gauen
steps.description: You've filled up both of the spore sacs. Return to Magister Gauen at the Ivory Tower.\n

357.description: Warehouse Chief Baxt recently announced retirement, and the competition to replace him has already grown fierce among the freightmen.

steps.title: Collect Jade Crystals
steps.description: Warehouse Freightman Silva wishes to become the next Warehouse Chief. She intends to obtain this position through the jade crystal business. She asks that you collect jade crystals for her. She offers an extra reward if you bring her 100 or more jade crystals at a time. You should hunt forest runners, Fline elders, Liele elders and valley treant elders.\n

358.description: Dark Elves think of Shilen as their mother, as she may well be, but children born of such lunacy are bound to cast a dark shadow...

steps.title: For Divine Glory
steps.description: To protect Shilen's reputation, Grand Master Oltlin asks you to destroy the evil creatures that are evidence of her descent into madness. Collect 108 snake scales from the evil creatures that look like her and take them to Grand Master Oltlin. You will find them in front of the Forbidden Gateway. Hunt Falibati and Trives.\n

steps.title: Let's Return To Oltlin
steps.description: You have collected 108 snake scales. Take them to Grand Master Oltlin of Dark Elf Guild in Aden Castle.\n

359.description: The king's bitterness at his defeat was so great that it even transcended his death! To this day, he wanders his ruined castle...

steps.title: Eternal Rest to Soldiers of the Castle
steps.description: Knight Gustav of Elmore has resurrected the dead heroes of Aden to serve his evil purposes. Recover 60 of their remains and take them to High Priest Orven in Aden Castle so that they can be laid to rest. Hunt doom archers, doom guards and doom servants.\n

steps.title: Return To Oltlin
steps.description: You have collected 60 corpses. Take them to High Priest Orven in Aden Castle and perform the ceremony of purification.\n

steps.title: Prayer for the Dead
steps.description: Go back to see High Priest Orven after he has finished praying.\n

360.description: Kings, nobles and heroes are buried in the National Cemetery. Since the collapse of the kingdom, this holy place has been overrun with monsters! There are evil forces behind this.

steps.title: Stop the Supply Line!
steps.description: Monsters are defiling the Cemetery where the heroes of this kingdom are buried. You are part of the forces pledged to drive them out. You must interrupt their supply line, kill them and take all the supplies and documents they are carrying to Guard Coleman in Aden Castle Town. Hunt Taik orc seekers and Taik orc supply leaders.\n

362.description: Music is the most beautiful form of expression!. A certain young man, shy and blinded by love, knows this all too well...

steps.title: Swan's Flute
steps.description: Bard Swan, a secret admirer of Musician Nanarin, wants to give her a rare and precious flute. He asks that you visit Trader Woodrow, an importer of flutes.\n

steps.title: Toward Giran Harbor
steps.description: Woodrow explains that if you need an imported flute right away you should see Galion in Giran Harbor.\n

steps.title: Received Flute
steps.description: Take the flute you received to Swan in the Town of Dion.\n

steps.title: Swan's Letter
steps.description: After looking at the flute, Swan asks you to deliver it to Musician Nanarin along with his letter.\n

steps.title: Nanarin's Heart
steps.description: Tell Swan how Nanarin feels about him.\n

363.description: Music is the most beautiful form of expression! Even a certain lady of nobility with exquisite taste is helpless in its embrace!

steps.title: Listen Carefully to the Dwarf
steps.description: Dark Elf Nanarin, enchanted at the sight of Dwarf Barbado's bountiful beard, wishes to pursue a relationship with him but her pride keeps her from expressing her true feelings. She suggests you find out from the Dwarves in the village what he likes. Ask the Dwarves in the blacksmith shop and the warehouse.\n

steps.title: Barbado's Favorites
steps.description: You are finding out from Barbado's friends what kinds of things he likes.\n

steps.title: Nanarin's Gift
steps.description: Musician Nanarin gives you something to deliver to Barbado.\n

steps.title: Barbado's Response
steps.description: Describe Barbado's reaction to the gift from Nanarin.\n

364.description: Somebody said music is the most beautiful way to show yourself... The musician who loves music and calls himself the master of the melody, is looking for someone who can play with him...

steps.title: Barbado's Request
steps.description: Barbado explains that he has long been an admirer of Swan's music and his fondest wish is to someday play a duet with him. Swan has not responded to his invitation, and Barbado has gotten the impression that Swan is avoiding him. Barbado asks you to visit Swan on his behalf.\n

steps.title: Swan's Errand
steps.description: You are asked to run an errand for Bard Swan. Obtain a black beer from Jonas' box and deliver it to Trader Sabrin. Obtain a garment from Sonia's box and give it to Guard Xaber.\n

steps.title: Consent to an Ensemble
steps.description: Troubadour Swan has agreed to perform in an ensemble. Relay this news to Barbado.\n

365.description: Pirate Captain Zaken searched for treasure all his life. While he died an untimely death, his curse lives on, on Devil's Isle!

steps.title: Bring Back the Treasure Chest
steps.description: Pirate Zaken's followers imprisoned him on Devil's Isle and stole his treasure, but he eventually got his revenge by killing them all and turning them into pirate zombies and pirate zombie captains. You must go there, conduct an investigation, recover the stolen treasure, and take it to Warehouse Keeper Randolf in Giran Castle Town.\n

366.description: Devil's Isle is home to the restless spirits of Pirate Captain Zaken and his men. That island holds some ghastly secrets...

steps.title: Bring Back a Strand of Silver Hair
steps.description: Magister Dieter of Giran Castle Town wishes to obtain the silver hair of Sairon which can be found on Devil's Isle. Rumor says that this hair is what gives the doll its power. Go to Devil's Isle and slay Sairon, her doll and puppet, and then take some of her silver hair to Magister Dieter.\n

367.description: All the best discoveries are accidental! What scientific secrets might we learn from the ancient giants?

steps.title: Bzzt Bzzt Wow, What a Blast!
steps.description: Researcher Lorain says that she has discovered the secret of the Titan's energy. She asks that you use an ancient item in a fight against Catherok, the monster of Cruma Tower and thereby expose the ancient item to the influence of the skill Catherok uses.\n

steps.title: Lamp that Shines More Brightly
steps.description: The Titan lamp must be returned to Lorain.\n

368.description: The Garden of Eva is the holy sanctuary of the Goddess of Water! What are all those evil creatures doing there?!

steps.title: Protect the Garden of Eva
steps.description: The Garden of Eva is the goddess' sanctuary. Lately, monsters have been invading it, and the garden guards are overwhelmed. Priestess Restina of Heine has requested the help of outsiders to drive out the monsters. Kill blade stakatos, blade stakato workers, blade stakato warriors, and blade stakato drones.\n

369.description: Magister Nell wants to know the connection between the soul stone found at the Elven Ruins on Talking Island and the one found at the Forgotten Temple... And that's not her only question!

steps.title: Jewel Collection
steps.description: Magister Nell is researching the Forgotten Temple. After learning of a relationship between the Forgotten Temple and the Elven Ruins, she asks you to bring her back broken fragments of elemental stone. Obtain 50 flame shards and 50 ice shards. Hunt roxides, lakin undines, rowin undines, death fires, lakin salamanders and salamander rowins.\n

steps.title: Return to Nell
steps.description: You have collected 50 ice shards and 50 flame shards. Take them to Magister Nell in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Jewel Collection For the Sake of Love
steps.description: You have collected the spirit ore needed for Nell's research. Her instructor now requests that you bring the him some ore, too. Hunt the roxide, Lakin undine, rowin undine, death fire, Lakin salamander and salamander rowin.\n

steps.title: Gift for Nell
steps.description: You have collected 200 ice shards and 200 flame shards. You must take these heavy items to Magister Nell in Gludin Village.\n

370.description: The forbidden spellbook, used to protect against the devil Beleth, immediately transformed the once-fertile land south of Aden into a barren wasteland. Now, at last, Elder Casian has hopes of rekindling life there.

steps.title: Find Kranvel's Spellbook
steps.description: Great Magus Kranvel's spellbook has been opened for the upcoming fight with Beleth. The magic power emanating from the book has destroyed fertile farmland and produced weird and grotesque creatures. Filled with rage and grief, Spellsinger Diena destroyed the magus's spellbook. Rumor says it is now located in the Ant Nest. Elder Casian wishes to open Great Magus Kranvel's spellbook again. Obtain the Great Magus Kranvel's spellbook so he can recultivate the Wastelands. Kill Ant Recruits, Ant Patrols, Ant Guards, Noble Ants and Noble Ant Leaders.\n

371.description: The Tower of Insolence was built with the blood and bones of its many innocent victims. That place is haunted by the souls of those wrongly executed there! Would you pacify them?

steps.title: Ancient Ash Urn
steps.description: Seer Reva of Aden Castle Town asks you to find an ancient ash urn. You can obtain it by going to the Tower of Insolence and killing the followers of the evil Hallate. You will receive an extra reward if you bring back 100 ash urns at once. If in your search you happen to find an ancient porcelain, take it to antique dealer Patrin in the Town of Oren and get it appraised. Hunt Hallate's warriors, Hallate's knights and Hallate's commander.\n

372.description: The Tower of Insolence is definitely one of the most marvelous structures in history! The Gray Pillar Guild, expert architects, felt they had to reclaim the inheritance of their Dwarven ancestors' technology.

steps.title: In Search of Ancient Documents
steps.description: Warehouse Keeper Walderal belongs to the Gray Pillar Guild. He needs a blueprint of the Tower of Insolence to further his research. Slay the powerful enemies in the Tower of Insolence and recover the blueprint! If you find other books, ask Walderal about them. You must kill the corrupt sages, Erin Ediunce, Hallate's inspectors, platinum tribe overlords, platinum guardian prefects and messenger angels.\n

steps.title: Collecting Ancient Documents
steps.description:
Warehouse Keeper Walderal needs the blueprints for the Tower of Insolence. Defeat the powerful monsters in the Tower of Insolence and retrieve the blueprints. You should also look for some books that other people have been asking for.

Take "The Revelation of the Seals" to Madam Claudia Athebalt near Aden Castle or Magister Desmond in Aden Castle Town. Take "The Imperial Genealogy" to Trader Holly in Aden Castle Town. Take "The Ancient Epic" to Antique Dealer Patrin in the Town of Oren.

Monsters to Hunt - corrupt sages, Erin Ediunce, Hallate's inspectors, platinum tribe overlords, platinum guardian prefects and messenger angels.

373.description: The Ivory Tower is the crowning achievement of our civilization! Research done here will benefit future generations! Magic is the way of the future!

steps.title: Preparation of Reagents
steps.description: You have agreed to obtain the reagent that Magic Trader Wesley needs for his magic research. Slay the evil creatures in the Tower of Insolence and the Blazing Swamp and collect reagent ingredients. Once you collect the ingredients, use the mixing urn in the basement of the Ivory Tower to create reagents. Refer to the note that is attached to the mixing urn for instructions on how to use the urn and for the formulas used to mix the ingredients. In the Tower of Insolence you should hunt Crendions, Hallate's Maids, Hallate's Guardians, Platinum Tribe Shamans and Platinum Guardian Shamans. In the Blazing Swamp hunt Lava Wyrms and Hames Orc Shamans.\n

374.description: A dark chaos is about to descend upon the world! Seer Manakia received a warning in a dream, and is planning a ceremony to try and better understand the coming darkness...

steps.title: Onto Antharas' Lair
steps.description: Seer Manakia wants to perform a ritual to better predict the future. He asks you to obtain the items he needs. He needs 65 molars of cave beasts and 65 flames of death wave.\n

steps.title: Mysterious Stone
steps.description: Take the sealed mysterious stone to Dwarf Torai near the entrance to Dragon Valley.\n

steps.title: Onto Antharas' Lair
steps.description: Show the mysterious stone to Seer Manakia. If you wish to help him, obtain the molars of cave beasts and flames of death wave he needs for the ritual.\n

375.description: Seer Manakia is not able to adequately foresee the coming darkness. He asks for help in acquiring better materials.

steps.title: Deepest part of Antharas' Lair
steps.description: Seer Manakia asks you to obtain 100 skulls of cave howler and 100 horns of karik.\n

376.description: Dwarf Sobling solved the puzzle of the past and revealed the truth. There's still something else he needs to do at Giants Cave.

steps.title: Exploration of Giants Cave
steps.description: Head Researcher Sobling asks you to find the relics of ancient Titans that are guarded by monsters in the cave. Hunt yintzus, paliotes, hamruts and kranrots.\n

steps.title: Mysterious Book
steps.description: Head Researcher Sobling asks you to take the mysterious book to Warehouse Freightman Cliff in the Town of Oren.\n

steps.title: Exploration of Giants Cave
steps.description: Show Head Researcher Sobling the "Ancient Language Dictionary: Intermediate Level". If you wish to continue helping Sobling, you must bring him relics of ancient Titans. Hunt yintzus, paliotes, hamruts and kranrots.\n

377.description: Sobling's efforts are finally starting to pay off. However, he says that there is still room for improvement.

steps.title: Exploration of Giants Cave, Part 2
steps.description: Head Researcher Sobling asks you to find the relics of the Titans from the deepest recesses of Giants Cave using the newly acquired "Ancient Language Dictionary: Intermediate Level". Hunt lesser giant soldiers, lesser giant scouts, lesser giant mages and lesser giant elders.\n

378.description: Chief Warehouse Keeper Lansfo has taken care of the warehouse at Dion for 40 years. Now he's been offered the promotion of a lifetime!

steps.title: Find the top quality wine!
steps.description: Help Guard Harlan of the Town of Dion by obtaining and bringing back some top quality wine!\n

steps.title: Music score for the festivities!
steps.description: Meet with Musician Barbado in the Town of Dion and obtain the Musical Score - Theme of the Feast.\n

steps.title: Obtain the Secret Recipe!
steps.description: Meet with Jonas, a would-be chef, and obtain his secret recipe.\n

steps.title: Obtain the Recipe for Desserts!
steps.description: Meet with Magister Rollant and obtain his recipe for desserts. He is located in the temple of the Town of Dion.\n

379.description: Fathers would brave the fires of hell for their daughters! Guard Harlan of Dion is no exception.

steps.title: Fantasy Wine
steps.description: It is the tradition of Guard Harlan's family in Dion Village to make wine whenever a new child is born. To celebrate the birth of a daughter, they plan to make fantasy wine. They need 80 leaves of eucalyptus and 100 stones of chill. Hunt Enku orc champions and Enku orc shamans.\n

steps.title: Return to Guard Harlan
steps.description: You have collected all the ingredients. Take them to Guard Harlan in the Town of Dion.\n

380.description: Dion is always packed for its monthly cooking contest. One magister who likes to cook plans to embarrass the other cooks with his expert technique!

steps.title: Collection of Ingredients for Desserts!
steps.description: Magister Rollant of Dion Castle is an aspiring chef. He has become disillusioned by the shoddy practices of other chefs. Bring him four ritron fruits, 20 moon face flowers, 10 drops of leech fluids and two antidotes and he will make a top quality dish that is far superior to anything else. Hunt dire wolves, Kadif werewolves and giant mist leeches.\n

steps.title: Return to Rollant
steps.description: You have collected all the ingredients. Make sure that you have two antidotes and return to Magister Rollant in the Town of Dion.\n

steps.title: Waiting For the Dish to Be Ready
steps.description: Rollant is cooking. Come back later.\n

steps.title: Waiting For the Dish to Be Ready
steps.description: Rollant is cooking. Be patient.\n

steps.title: Waiting For the Dish to Be Ready
steps.description: He is still cooking. Wait!\n

steps.title: Waiting For the Dish to Be Ready
steps.description: Rollant is still cooking. It's taking him forever!\n

381.description: The Coin Collectors Club has members from every land! Would you care to take the test to join?

steps.title: Let's Become a Royal Member!
steps.description: Warehouse Keeper Sorint explains that a royal membership program has recently been introduced for level 1 members. To become royalty you must obtain Kail's coin from the monsters of the Forsaken Plains. You must also obtain the coin collecting album sold by Trader Sandra in Giran. Hunt ancient gargoyles.\n

382.description: Kail, known as th right hand of the devil Beleth, had a habit of making weird coins. There is a certain collector who collects no others...

steps.title: Collecting Magic Coins
steps.description: Head Blacksmith Vergara has just joined the coin collecting club. He wants to trade his coins for rarer coins. Bring the coins Vergara wants so that he will give you the coins you want. Hunt fallen orcs, fallen orc archers, fallen orc shamans and fallen orc captains.\n

383.description: The legendary Pirate Captain Zaken left many legends and even more bodies in his wake! One story tells of his treasure, and it seems to be the one most people want to hear... Trader Espen can tell you more!

steps.title: Decipher the Pirate's Treasure Map!
steps.description: Ask Trader Espen of Heine to decipher the pirate's treasure map for you.\n

steps.title: Find the Pirate's Treasure Chest!
steps.description: The pirate's treasure map has disclosed the location of the hidden treasure chest! Go to the place marked on the map.\n

384.description: Trading is mind-numbing work! Freightmen must make up their own ways to kill time.

steps.title: Recover Warehouse Keeper's Medal
steps.description:
Some Warehouse Keeper's medals that were being delivered to the Town of Oren were stolen by monsters. Recover them and take them to Warehouse Freightman Cliff of the Town of Oren or Warehouse Chief Baxt of Hunters Village and you'll be allowed to play bingo.

Monsters to Hunt -
Tanor Canyon: nightmare lords, nightmare keepers and nightmare guides.
Dragon Valley: hunter gargoyles, dustwind gargoyles, thunder wyrms, dragon bearer chiefs, dragon bearer warriors, and dragon bearer archers.
Skyshadow Meadow: connabis, sanhidros, cadeines, innersens, luminuns, and bartal.
 Sea of Spores: rotting golems, and giant monstereyes.
Outlaw Forest: hunter gargoyles.
 Hunters Valley: weird drakes.
 Blazing Swamp: tulbens, konzur bat lords, and konzur bats. 
The Cemetery: grave guards.
 Forest of Mirrors: carinkains.

385.description: The Gate Keeper Ziggurat, who longs to become Human again, asks you to slay the guardians and collect the scrolls of ancient magic.

steps.title: Scroll of Ancient Magic
steps.description: The Gatekeeper Ziggurat wants to become a human again and asks you to slay the guardians of ancient magic and collect the scrolls of ancient magic. You'll receive a blank scroll as a reward. The blank scroll will be helpful when dealing with the Trader of Mammon. Journey into the necropolises and catacombs and find monsters whose name contain lookout, watcher, guard, monk, overlord, shaman, consul, inquisitor, guardian, Elder, court guard, and preacher. Exclude Nephilim, Lilim, Gigant and Lith.\n

386.description: The Iron Gate Guild is furious that the infernium ore that it needs to construct a warehouse has been stolen by monsters! They have asked for assistance in recovering the ore.

steps.title: Recover Stolen Infernium Ore
steps.description:
The infernium ore that the Iron Gate Guild needs to construct a warehouse has been stolen by monsters. Recover the infernium ore and take it to Warehouse Freightman Romp. For every 100 units of infernium ore you take to him, you can play one round of bingo. If you win, you'll receive a prize from the Iron Gate Guild.

Monsters to Hunt -
Ancient Battleground: past knights, Hungered Corpses, bloody lords, bloody ghosts, dark guards, and Death Agents.
Blazing Swamp: glow wisps, marsh predators, Hames orc snipers, cursed guardians, and Hames orc overlords.
Fields of Massacre: wretched archers, grave liches, grave predators, spiteful soul leaders, and spiteful soul wizards.
The Forbidden Gateway: crimson drakes, and kadios.
Forsaken Plains: fallen orc shamans, and sharp talon tigers.
Silent Valley: huge footmarks, giant's shadows, past creatures, and soldiers of ancient times.

401.description: All warriors must be courageous and tenacious. Do you possess these qualities?

steps.title: Onward Toward Your Trial
steps.description: Quest that must be fulfilled in order to change occupations to a Warrior. Tell Master Aymus that you wish to become a Warrior, and he will tell you to first visit Trader Simplon in the Town of Gludio and find the 'Sword of Trial.'\n

steps.title: Test of Spirit
steps.description: To obtain the Sword of Trial, you must carry out a task for Trader Simplon. Fight the tracker skeletons in the Ruins of Agony and return with 10 of their rusted swords.\n

steps.title: Return to Trader Simplon
steps.description: You have obtained 10 rusted swords. Now, take them to Trader Simplon in the Town of Gludio.\n

steps.title: Nature of the Sword of Trial
steps.description: What a surprise! The rusted sword and the sword of trial are the same!  Well, since you have them, take them to Master Auron in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Trial of a Warrior
steps.description: Using the sword of trial you received from Trader Simplon, you must defeat the poison spiders, then collect and bring back 20 of their legs! They can be found on Windmill Hill in the southern plains of the village. Kill poison spiders and arachnid trackers!\n

steps.title: Return to Auron
steps.description: Take the 20 spiders' legs to Master Auron in Gludin Village.\n

402.description: To become a Knight you must endure the legendary quest known as Path to a Human Knight.

steps.title: Trial of an Apprentice Human Knight
steps.description: The quest to change one's occupation to Knight. Squires must travel to Gludin Village, the Town of Gludio, and Talking Island Village and run errands for captains and high priests. Gather three or more Coins of Lords.\n

403.description: Speak first with Guard Bezique if you wish to follow the Path to a Rogue.

steps.title: Let's obtain a Recommendation to Become a Rogue!
steps.description: Quest to change occupation to Rogue. Find Captain Bezique and tell him you wish to become a Rogue. He says that in order to earn his respect, you must catch one of the thieves. He suggests you meet with Neti.\n

steps.title: Neti's Test
steps.description: In order to catch an elusive band of thieves you must act quickly to hunt for skeletons, using only the dagger and bow you received from Neti. Hunt the skeletons and spartois in the Ruins of Agony and collect 10 spartoi's bones. You will get these bones by killing tracker skeletons, tracker skeleton leaders, skeleton scouts, skeleton bowmen, ruin spartoi and raging spartoi.\n

steps.title: Return to Neti
steps.description: You have collected 10 spartoi's bones. Now take them to Neti in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Neti's Recognition
steps.description: Take the horseshoe of light you obtained from Neti to Captain Bezique.\n

steps.title: Subjugation of Cat's Eye Bandits
steps.description: Captain Bezique has ordered you to defeat the cat's eye bandits near the Abandoned Camp and recover some stolen goods. Using the weapons Neti gave you, defeat them and recover the stolen items.\n

steps.title: Return to Captain Bezique
steps.description: You have defeated the bandits and recovered  the stolen goods. Now, return to Captain Bezique of Gludin Village.\n

404.description: Wizards must have a deep understanding of the power and meanings of each of the four elements. A token of fire is essential if you are to follow the Path to a Wizard!

steps.title: In Search of the Spirit of Flame
steps.description: The quest to change occupation to Wizard. Parina asks that you find tokens which symbolize earth, fire, water, and wind. Go to the Ruins of Despair and meet the fire spirit salamander.\n

steps.title: Key of Flame
steps.description: The key of flame once kept by the fire spirit salamander has been stolen. Go to the northwest corner of the Ruins of Despair, slay the ratman warriors there and recover the key of flame.\n

steps.title: Return to the Flame Salamander
steps.description: You have recovered the key of flame from the ratman warriors. Return it to the fire spirit salamander in the Ruins of Despair.\n

steps.title: In Search of Wind Sylph
steps.description: Your curiosity knows no bounds! Your endless quest for knowledge is not unlike the wandering wind... Your next teacher shall be the Wind Sylph, located at the northwestern entrance of the Wastelands.\n

steps.title: Silence the Noise of Lizardman
steps.description: The Wind Sylph complains to you that the racket created by the lizardman who recently appeared in the south of the Wastelands has made it impossible for her to hear the wind. Go meet with him and ask him not to make so much noise.\n

steps.title: Return to Wind Sylph
steps.description: Wastelands Lizardman apologizes for the noise, and hands over Wind Feather which seems to belong to Wind Sylph to you. Take this to Wind Sylph.\n

steps.title: In Search of Water Undine
steps.description: Your pursuit of knowledge has led to a time of contemplation and reflection. Contemplation of acquired knowledge is much like water. Your next teacher shall be the Water Undine. You will find her near Fellmere Lake.\n

steps.title: Destroy Water Seer
steps.description: The Water Undine asks you to defeat the Water Seer that is disturbing the energy of the water. The beast looks like an eye, and is located across the lake. Then, as proof, bring back two sparkling pebbles.\n

steps.title: Return to Undine
steps.description: Take the two sparkling pebbles you have obtained to the Water Undine across the lake.\n

steps.title: In Search of Earth Snake
steps.description: The time for reflection is over. You must now strengthen your resolve by learning the way of the earth. Your next teacher will be Earth Snake, found north of the Ruins of Agony.\n

steps.title: In Search of Red Soil
steps.description: The earth snake asks that you collect red soil containing the life energy of the earth from the red bears in the Fellmere Harvesting Grounds between the Ruins of Agony and Windy Hill.\n

steps.title: Let's Return to the Earth Snake
steps.description: Take the red soil to the Earth Snake in the Ruins of Agony and obtain a token of earth.\n

steps.title: Path to a Human Wizard
steps.description: You now possess all four tokens. You are well along the path to enlightenment. Now you must visit Parina in Gludin Village to continue the path of a Wizard.\n

405.description: Potential Clerics should confiscate subversive books and take them to Priest Zigaunt... He'll be very impressed!

steps.title: Proof of Faith
steps.description: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Cleric. Tell Priest Zigaunt that you wish to become a Cleric, and he ask you to prove your pure faith. To do this, you must remove all inappropriate books that criticize the current order. The first rumors about those books appeared in the Town of Gludio. Go there and ask Trader Simplon about the book, 'Understanding of Miracles.' Then recover all the books the trader has sold.\n

steps.title: Recovery of Inappropriate Books
steps.description: You have recovered all five books. Now take them to Priest Zigaunt of the Temple of Einhasad in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Meeting with the Author - Part 1
steps.description: Although you now have all the books available, as long as the author lives more may be produced. Go and find a former priest named Lionel. It is said that he is in hiding somewhere on Talking Island.\n

steps.title: Knowledge that Should Be Hidden
steps.description: Lionel explains that although he believes his books, he does not wish to anger the powers-that-be in the temple. He promises not to write any more books if you will take the remaining books to Grand Magister Gallint in the Einhovant School of Magic located on Talking Island.\n

steps.title: Meeting with the Author - Part 2
steps.description: Gallint says he knew it was going to be like this, and accepts the book. Now go back to Lionel.\n

steps.title: Proven Faith...?
steps.description: You have received Lionel's covenant not to author any more books. Now return to Priest Zigaunt in the Temple of Einhasad in Gludin Village.\n

406.description: For millenia Elven warriors have traveled either the path of the sword or the path of the arrow. Both paths inevitably lead through Eva and Einhasad...

steps.title: Testimony of Sorius
steps.description: Quest that must be fulfilled in order to change occupation to Elven Knight. Tell Master Sorius that you wish to become an Elven Knight. He will order you to go to the Ruins of Agony and defeat the undead to collect pieces of topaz. The undead will include tracker skeletons, tracker skeleton leaders, skeleton scouts, skeleton bowmen, and raging spartoi.\n

steps.title: Let's Return to Master Sorius
steps.description: You've collected 20 fragments of Topaz. Go back to Master Sorius of the Town of Gludio.\n

steps.title: Elven Knight's Brooch
steps.description: The topaz pieces are used to make an Elven Knight brooch and proof of an Elven Knight. Take them to Blacksmith Kluto of Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Blacksmith's Request
steps.description: Kluto says that he will make you the brooch if you go to the Abandoned Camp, kill ol mahum novices and bring back 20 gemstones.\n

steps.title: Return to Kluto
steps.description: You've collected 20 fragments of Emerald. Bring them to Blacksmith Kluto of Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Completed Brooch
steps.description: The gemstones you have collected will be turned into a brooch for future Elven Knights. The gemstones collected by former Elven Knight applicants will shine in your heart. After receiving the Kluto Box, return to Master Sorius of the Town of Gludio.\n

407.description: Elven Scouts are the most dextrous and elegant of all Elves! To become Scouts they must first prove their worth in battle...

steps.title: Proof of Ability
steps.description: The quest that must be fulfilled to change one's occupation to that of an Elven Scout. In order to become an Elven Scout, Master Reisa tells you to prove your skills by finding Guard Moretti's lost friend.\n

steps.title: Missing Friend
steps.description: Guard Moretti's friend Prias disappeared while trying to elude an ol mahum patrol. Confront the ol mahum patrol and find out what you can regarding Prias' whereabouts.\n

steps.title: Return to Moretti
steps.description: You recovered torn pieces of a letter from the ol mahum patrols. Take them to Guard Moretti of the Town of Gludio.\n

steps.title: Find Prias
steps.description: You find out that Prias was kidnapped and taken to the Neutral Zone of the Elven Forest. Due to the impending invasion of ol mahums, Guard Moretti cannot leave his post to look for his friend. He asks you to go and rescue Prias.\n

steps.title: Take Away the Key
steps.description: Prias is bound in shackles. Kill the ol mahum sentry, take his key and unlock the shackles.\n

steps.title: Release Prias
steps.description: You have secured the key from the ol mahum sentry. Free Prias from his shackles.\n

steps.title: Reply Letter From Prias
steps.description: Prias was grateful to receive Moretti's herb. He tells you that he must complete his mission. He asks you to give his regards to Moretti.\n

steps.title: Honorary Guard
steps.description: Moretti gives you a Certificate of Honorary Guard as a reward for rescuing Prias. Show it to Reisa.\n

408.description: Elven Wizards have a way with spirits... But first, they must perform a ritual for Eva...

steps.title: Jewel Collection
steps.description: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Elven Wizard. Rosella tells you that to become an Elven Wizard, you must collect the jewels that represent each of the four elements: water, fire, wind and earth. She hands you the fertility period, which symbolizes earth, and asks you to find the rest.\n

409.description: The revelation of flame has been passed down among Elven priests for centuries. Rumors persist that a girl of revelation has appeared recently...

steps.title: Miracle Girl
steps.description: This quest must be fulfilled to change occupation to Oracle. Tell Priest Manuel that you wish to become an Oracle. He tells you about the Revelation of the TOrch, and asks you to investigate the truth about the recent appearance of a miraculous girl near the lighthouse in Gludin Harbor.\n

steps.title: Girl Shaking in Fear
steps.description: You have met Allana. She seems afraid...\n

steps.title: Girl Shaking in Fear
steps.description: Mysterious lizardmen attempted to catch Allana. You defeat them and obtain the Lizard Captain Order. Ask Allana about the situation again.\n

steps.title: Girl's Request
steps.description: Allana explains that she has the ability to cure her younger sister's illness. She asks you to meet an old man named Perrin who gave her this ability and get her money back.\n

steps.title: Let's Interrogate Perrin
steps.description: You have defeated Tamil, guard of the evil Perrin. Interrogate him.\n

steps.title: Let's Return to Allana
steps.description: You retrieved Allana's money from Perrin. Take it to her. You will find her near the lighthouse.\n

steps.title: Manuel's Urgent Business
steps.description: Priest Manuel of the Town of Gludio has contacted you through the crystal for emergency. Go meet him quickly.\n

steps.title: Pursued Girl
steps.description: You receive a tip that mercenary lizardmen were hired to kidnap the girl of prophecy. Hurry to the lighthouse in Gludin Harbor and protect her.\n

steps.title: Results of Prophecy
steps.description: You could not save the girl's younger brother. Return to Priest Manuel and tell him.\n

410.description: Dark Elven Knights must pass two trials to become an elite Palus Knight. Are you worthy to join them?

steps.title: Ritual of 13 Skulls
steps.description: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Palus Knight. Master Virgil asks that you capture the 'gaze of abyss' through a trial in order to become a Palus Knight. He says you must then go to the Neutral Zone and bring back 13 Lycanthrope Skulls needed for the 13 Skull Ceremony. This will fulfill the first stage of the trial.\n

steps.title: Return to Master Virgil
steps.description: You have collected all 13 skulls. Go to Master Virgil of the Town of Gludio and find out about the second trial.\n

steps.title: Ritual of Red Coffin
steps.description: The second trial involves making a red coffin. Visit Abyssal Celebrant Kalinta of the Dark Elf Guild in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Coffin of Eternal Rest
steps.description: The Trial of Red Coffin requires you to make a coffin. You must go to Windmill Hill south of Gludin Village and obtain one Predator's Carapace and five units of Arachnid Tracker Silk.\n

steps.title: Return to Kalinta
steps.description: You have obtained all the ingredients to make the Coffin of Eternal Rest. Take them to Abyssal Celebrant Kalinta of the Dark Elf Guild in Gludin Village and ask him to make the coffin for you.\n

steps.title: Owner of the Coffin of Eternal Rest
steps.description: By carving your name on the coffin, you have become its true owner. Now, take it and return to Master Virgil in the Town of Gludio.\n

411.description: A Warrior of Darkness is a ruthless, silent assassin. Find Arkenia at the altar of coming-of-age ceremony and prove yourself to her.

steps.title: Towards the Altar of Rites
steps.description: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Assassin. To become an Assassin, Triskell asks you to prove your skills by helping Witch Arkenia who can be found at the Altar of Rites.\n

steps.title: In Search of Shilen's Tears
steps.description: Witch Arkenia asks you to recover Shilen's tears that were stolen from her. You can get more information about the theft from Guard Leikan in Gludin Village. Go and see him.\n

steps.title: Leikan's Request
steps.description: Guard Leikan tells you that if you obtain 10 moonstone beast's molars for him, he will tell you who stole Shilen's Tears.\n

steps.title: Return to Leikan
steps.description: You have obtained 10 Moonstone Beast's molars. Take them to Guard Leikan in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Recover Shilen's Tears
steps.description: Guard Leikan tells you that the thief who stole Shilen's Tears is an Orc named Calpico. You will find him near the School of Dark Arts. Kill him and recover Shilen's Tears.\n

steps.title: Return to Arkenia
steps.description: You defeated Calpico. Take Shilen's Tears to Witch Arkenia at the Altar of Rites.\n

steps.title: Recommendation of Witch Arkenia
steps.description: You have returned Shilen's Tears to Witch Arkenia for which she gave you a Recommendation to become an Assassin. Take it to Triskel in the Town of Gludio.\n

412.description: Shilen is the mother of the dark arts. To become a Dark Wizard, one must prove capable of controlling the spirits with her power.

steps.title: Four Seeds
steps.description: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Dark Wizard. Witch Varika speaks of the four seeds representing anger, despair, horror, and lunacy. One who obtains them all may become a Dark Wizard. She gives you a Seed of Despair and asks you to find the rest.\n

413.description: Shillien Oracles seek truth and enlightenment in the darkness that surrounds us. Not all are worthy of such a noble profession.

steps.title: Two Books
steps.description: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Shillien Oracle. Magister Sidra explains that to become a Shilien Oracle you must acquire two books written in ancient rune: the 'Garmiel book' and the 'Andariel book'.
