First you must visit Magister Talbot in the Village of Gludin, and learn how to obtain the Garmiel book.\n

steps.title: Bloody Runes
steps.description: Magister Talbot asks you to slay Dark Succubi and bring back five bloody runes. You will find those abominations in a spider nest west of the Altar of Rites. In return he will compile the Garmiel Book for you. Monsters to hunt: Dark Succubi.\n

steps.title: Return to Talbot
steps.description: You have collected all five bloody runes. Return to Magister Talbot in Gludin Village and ask him to make the Garmiel Book for you.\n

steps.title: Another Book
steps.description: You have obtained the Garmiel book from Magister Talbot. Now you must obtain the Andariel book from Priest Adonius at Einhasad Temple in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Ritual of Atonement?
steps.description: Priest Adonius promises you that if you slay the skeletons and zombies in the Ruins of Despair and bring back 10 Ashen Bones, he will give you a copy of the Andariel book. You should hunt Skeleton Infantrymen, Shield Skeletons, Zombie Soldiers and Zombie Warriors.\n

steps.title: Return to Adonius
steps.description: You have collected 10 Ashen Bones. Return to Priest Adonius at Einhasad Temple in Gludin Village and receive a copy of the Andariel book.\n

steps.title: Shillien Oracle
steps.description: You have obtained the Andariel Book from Priest Adonius. Return to Magister Sidra.\n

414.description: Orc Raiders inspire fear in their enemies with their death-defying courage and royal bearing.

steps.title: Defeat Ratman Leader
steps.description: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Orc Raider. Prefect Karukia says that Orc Raiders must prove that their courage and loyalty are without fault. To prove your courage you must destroy the Goblins and their Kuruka Ratmen helpers that are ruining this land. Kill Goblin Tomb Raider Leaders and Kuruka Ratman Leaders.\n

steps.title: Return to Prefect Karukia
steps.description: You have killed all the Kuruka Ratman Leaders. Now, return to Prefect Karukia of Orc Fortress.\n

steps.title: Kill the Betrayers!
steps.description: Prefect Karukia orders you to kill two traitors who betrayed their tribe and went into hiding with Umbar tribe. Take their heads and go to Prefect Kasman of Gludin Village. Read the betrayer's report and by using the information in it, slay the Orc betrayers!\n

steps.title: Visit Prefect Kasman
steps.description: You have slain the betrayerous Orc who hid out with the Umbar tribe. Take the head to Prefect Kasman in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Toward the Town of Schuttgart
steps.description: Go to Prefect Tazeer of Schuttgart. He will advise you on what to do.\n

steps.title: Defeat the Timora Orc!
steps.description: Prefect Tazeer tells you to kill the Orc, Timora, the betrayer, who is hiding among the Ragna Orcs. Return with the traitor's head.\n

steps.title: Return to Tazeer
steps.description: You have claimed the Orc Timora's head. Return to Prefect Tazeer in the Town of Schuttgart.\n

415.description: Orc Monks are masters of the traditional Orc martial art, kabart. The path of Monk requires that they receive scrolls from two masters.

steps.title: Find Khavatari Rosheek
steps.description: You must undertake this quest in order to change your occupation to Monk. Gantaki Zu Urutu will instruct you in traditional Orc martial arts. He informs you that you must receive a scroll from two Masters. Go first to Khavatari Rosheek, who is training somewhere on the Immortal Plateau.\n

steps.title: 1st Spirit Scroll
steps.description: Khavatari Rosheek says that he doesn't have time to waste on a novice like you. He orders you to go and slay five Kasha bears, collect their claws in a pouch and bring them to him. You must use only fist-type weapons for this task.\n

steps.title: Return to Khavatari Rosheek
steps.description: You have slain five Kasha bears. Return to Khavatari Rosheek. You will find him near the Frozen Waterfalls.\n

steps.title: 2nd Spirit Scroll
steps.description: Khavatari Rosheek is meditating. He orders you  to slay five Kasha blade spiders, collect their claws in a pouch and bring them back to him. You must only use fist-type weapons for this task.\n

steps.title: Return to Khavatari Rosheek
steps.description: You have collected five claws of Kasha blade spiders in a pouch. Take the pouch to Khavatari Rosheek near the Frozen Waterfalls.\n

steps.title: 3rd Spirit Scroll
steps.description:
Khavatari Rosheek is about to go on break. He tells you to slay five Scarlet Salamanders, collect their scales in a pouch and bring it back to him. You must only use fist-type weapons for this task.

Monsters to Hunt - Scarlet Salamanders.

steps.title: Return to Khavatari Rosheek
steps.description: You have collected five scales of scarlet salamanders in a pouch. Take the pouch to Khavatari Rosheek near the Frozen Waterfalls.\n

steps.title: Fiery Spirit
steps.description: Khavatari Rosheek has given you a fiery spirit scroll! Return to Gantaki Zu Urutu in Orc Village.\n

steps.title: Second Scroll
steps.description: Prefect Kasman in Gludin Village will tell you about the second scroll you will need to obtain to become a Monk.\n

steps.title: Iron Will Scroll
steps.description: In order to find the second scroll, you must meet Khavatari Toruku. He is located near the fork in the road in the northern part of Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Trial of Iron
steps.description: Khavatari Toruku asks that you defeat many different types and levels of warriors. Slay a Vuku Orc fighter on Windmill Hill, a ratman warrior in a corner of the Ruins, a Langk lizardman in the Langk Lizardman Dwellings and a Felim lizardman in the Fellmere Harvesting Grounds. You must kill three of each for a total of 12, collect the proofs in a pouch and take them to Khavatari Toruku. You may use only bare hands, or hand-to-hand weapons for this task. Hunt Vuku Orc fighters, ratman warriors, Langk lizardman warriors, and Felim lizardman warriors.\n

steps.title: Return toruku
steps.description: You have collected all of the proofs. Deliver the pouch to Khavatari Toruku.\n

steps.title: Warrior of Iron and Fire
steps.description: You have passed the Testimony of Khavatari Toruku, and thus received the Iron Will Scroll. Return to Prefect Kasman of Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Forgotten Teacher
steps.description: Gantaki Zu Urutu tells you to travel to the Valley of the Lords to meet Khavatari Aren.\n

steps.title: Trial of Aren
steps.description:
Khavatari Aren asks you to collect 6 spider fangs, from either the Kasha Blade Spider or the Kasha Fang Spider. You must do it with your bare hands or fist weapons.

Monsters to Hunt: Kasha Blade Spider, Kasha Fang Spider
steps.completionNpcName: Entrance of the Valley of the Lords

steps.title: Return to Khavatari Aren
steps.description: You have collected 6 spider fangs. Return to Khavatari Aren.\n

steps.title: Hunt of Baar Dre Vanul
steps.description:
Khavatari Aren asks you to hunt the Baar Dre Vanul, found in the southern reaches of the Immortal Plateau. You must do so using only fist weapons or your bare hands.

Monster to Hunt - Baar Dre Vanul

steps.title: Return to Khavatari Aren
steps.description: You have Baar Dre Vanul's horn. Return to Khavatari Aren.\n

steps.title: Khavatari's Zenith
steps.description: Khavatari Aren tells you the tale of Khavatari's Zenith and asks you to visit the Seer Moira in the Town of Schuttgart.\n

steps.title: What is the Zenith?
steps.description: What is Khavatari's Zenith? Think carefully about what Khavatari Aren said and then go back to Seer Moira.\n

416.description: Orc Shamans must master the language of fire in order to communicate with souls on the battlefield.

steps.title: Preparation of Offering
steps.description:
Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Orc Shaman. Tataru Zu Hestui explains that in order to become an Orc Shaman, you must learn to lead spirits. In order to accomplish this, you must master the 'Language of Fire' which will enable you to communicate with spirits. There are three items needed to prepare for learning the language of fire. You must collect the pelt of a Kasha bear, the husk of a Kasha blade spider and a fiery egg of a scarlet salamander. Kasha bears and Kasha blade spiders can be found in the northern Immortal Plateau and scarlet salamanders can be found in the Cave of Trials. Monsters to hunt: Kasha bears, Kasha blade spiders and scarlet salamanders.

Monsters to hunt: Kasha bears, Kasha blade spiders and scarlet salamanders.

steps.title: Tataru zu Hestui
steps.description: You have collected all three items. Return to Tataru Zu Hestui and prepare to meet with the spirit.\n

steps.title: Hestui Totem Spirit
steps.description: Take the Hestui Mask and Fiery Egg to the Hestui Totem Spirit. You will find it in the southern ruins of the Pa'agrio Temple.\n

steps.title: Flame Ritual
steps.description: The Hestui totem spirit has given you a claw as a present. Now, return to Tataru Zu Hestui in Orc Village.\n

steps.title: Names of Spirits
steps.description: You have performed a ritual using the claw you received from Hestui totem spirit and learned the language of fire. Take the recommendation you received from Tataru Zu Hestui to Seer Umos in Gludin Village. He will tell you how to learn the names of 99 spirits.\n

steps.title: Duda-Mara Totem Spirit
steps.description: Seer Umos explains that the second test to become an Orc Shaman involves learning the names of 99 spirits. For this, you must meet with the Duda-Mara totem spirit. But first, you must prepare yourself. Hunt grizzly bears in Fellmere Harvesting Grounds above Gludin Village and bring back three bottles of grizzly blood. Monsters to hunt: grizzly bears.\n

steps.title: Return to Seer Umos
steps.description: You have collected all the Grizzly Blood. Now take it to Seer Umos of Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Manager of Names
steps.description: Take the jar containing the blood and go visit the Duda-Mara totem spirit. The totem spirit is said to be located north of the Arena in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Durka Spirit
steps.description: The Duda-Mara totem spirit has asked you to catch the Durka spirit. You will find this spirit while hunting for poison spiders and arachnid trackers in the Fellmere Harvesting Grounds.\n

steps.title: Duda-Mara Totem Spirit
steps.description: You have captured the Durka Spirit alive. Take it to the Duda-Mara totem spirit in the north of the Arena.\n

steps.title: Blood of Duda-Mara Totem Spirit
steps.description: The Duda-Mara totem spirit has given you a drop of blood as a present. Take it to Priest Umos in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Wisdom of Souls
steps.description: You must meet with the Seer Moira of the Town of Schuttgart if you want to receive the Wisdom of Souls.\n

steps.title: The Wisest Totem Spirit
steps.description: The Seer Moira tells you to approach the Totem Spirit of Gandi for knowledge.\n

steps.title: To the Valley of the Lords
steps.description:
The Totem Spirit of Gandi said to defeat the Black Leopard in the Valley of the Lords to receive the Wisdom of Souls. Go to the Valley of the Lords!

Monster to Hunt - Black Leopard

steps.title: The Teachings of Blood
steps.description: Whenever the Black Leopard's blood touches your body, you feel a curious sensation and hear a strange voice. Is the dying leopard trying to say something? Study the dead leopard's carcass.\n

steps.title: Sacrifice Required
steps.description:
You could almost feel something from the Dead Leopard's Carcass. You might be able to grasp the answer if you kill more of them.

Monster to Hunt - Black Leopard

steps.title: Voice
steps.description: The Dead Leopard's Carcass is calling out to you. Talk to him!\n

steps.title: Last Blood
steps.description:
One must have the Black Leopard's blood on one's hands in order to receive the final lesson.

Monster to Hunt - Black Leopard

steps.title: Bloody Body
steps.description: The Black Leopard's blood covers your body. Return to the Dead Leopard's Carcass.\n

steps.title: Wisdom of Gandi
steps.description: You suddenly see an image of the Totem Spirit of Gandi. Is it calling you?\n

steps.title: The Road to an Orc Shaman
steps.description: The Totem Spirit of Gandi knows of your recent experiences. It told you to seek Seer Moira, who will lead you to a shaman.\n

417.description: Master Toma, teacher of the way of scavenger, is missing! You must find him!

steps.title: In Search of Master Toma - Part 1
steps.description: This quest must be fulfilled before transferring to Scavenger class. Collector Pippi of the Dwarven Village encourages all aspiring Dwarves to become Scavengers. To become a Scavenger, you must receive the permission of Master Toma, whose whereabouts are currently unknown. It is said that his younger sister, Trader Mion of Dwarven Village, may know his whereabouts.\n

steps.title: In Search of Master Toma - Part 2
steps.description: Trader Mion promises to find the location of Master Toma. In exchange, you have agreed to help her with her business. She asks you to deliver some items to her customers.\n

steps.title: In Search of Master Toma - Part 3
steps.description: Trader Mion promises to find the location of Master Toma. In exchange, you have agreed to help her with her business. But she is making unreasonable demands.\n

steps.title: In Search of Master Toma - Part 4
steps.description: Take the letter you got from Trader Mion to Master Toma. Master Toma can be found in the Abandoned Coal Mines east of Dwarven Village, the easternmost part of the Dwarven Kingdom, or perhaps somewhere on the northern coast.\n

steps.title: Honey Jar Spoil
steps.description:
Master Toma said that if you want to be a scavenger, you must first run an errand for him. He asked you to bring him back five honey jars. You can obtain them by using Spoil on honey bears. You can find honey bears while hunting hunter bears. In order to find hunter bears, start from the western entrance of the Abandoned Coal Mines, then go up north until you reach the area where two shorelines merge. A large population of hunter bears are said to be found in that area.

Monsters to hunt - hunter bears and honey bears.
 Monsters to use Spoil on - honey bears.

steps.title: Return toma
steps.description: You have found all five honey jars. Let Master Toma's mouth be filled with the sweetness of honey!\n

steps.title: Bead of Tarantula
steps.description:
As your next assignment, Master Toma asks you to bring him 20 tarantula beads. They can be obtained by using Spoil on hunter tarantulas and plunder tarantulas.

Monsters to use Spoil on - hunter tarantulas and plunder tarantulas.

steps.title: Return toma
steps.description: You have collected 20 beads. Take them to Master Toma.\n

steps.title: Pay Back for the Drink
steps.description: Take the package of beads Master Toma gave you to Warehouse Freightman Raut in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: In Search of Raut's Nephew
steps.description: Warehouse Freightman Raut asks you to deliver Raut's teleport scroll to his nephew. His nephew lives in Dragon Valley.\n

steps.title: Return to Raut
steps.description: You have delivered Raut's Teleport Scroll torai. Take the succubus undies you received to Warehouse Freightman Raut in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Toma's Friend
steps.description: Master Toma gives you shining beads and asks that you give them to Warehouse Chief Yasheni of the Town of Schuttgart.\n

418.description: Dwarven Artisans are consummate craftsmen. They must pass tests from three blacksmiths.

steps.title: The First Blacksmith Test
steps.description: Quest that must be fulfilled to change occupation to Artisan. The Dwarf Village Blacksmith Silvery tells you that to become an Artisan you must receive recognition from three Blacksmiths that have been Artisans for a long time. He asks you to go to the Abandoned Coal Mines and obtain 10 boogle ratman teeth and two boogle ratman leader's big teeth.\n

steps.title: Return to Silvera
steps.description: You have collected all the teeth of Ratmen. Take them to Blacksmith Silvera.\n

steps.title: The Second Blacksmith Test
steps.description: In order to take the second test, you must visit Blacksmith Kluto. You can find him at the blacksmith's shop in Gludin Village.\n

steps.title: Errant to Pinter
steps.description: Take the letter you received from Blacksmith Kluto Blacksmith Pinter in the Town of Gludio.\n

steps.title: Missing Box
steps.description: The item that Blacksmith Kluto commissioned from Blacksmith Pinter has been stolen by a Vuku Orc fighter. Find the culprit and recover the stolen secret box. The thief can be found on Windmill Hill south of Gludin Village. Monster to hunt: Vuku Orc fighter.\n

steps.title: Return to Blacksmith Pinter
steps.description: You have recovered the box. Return it to Blacksmith Pinter of the Town of Gludio.\n

steps.title: What is the Blacksmith's Test...?
steps.description: Blacksmith Pinter rewards you with a 2nd Pass Certificate. Take the secret box to Blacksmith Kluto.\n

steps.title: Railroad Worker Obi
steps.description: In order to take the second test, you must first meet with Railroad Worker Obi who is on the Plunderous Plains. Go see him.\n

steps.title: Solidarity of the Dwarves
steps.description: Railroad Worker Obi tells you a story about the Solidarity of Dwarves.  He asks you to relay the story that can potentially disrupt the Dwarves' loyalty to Mineral Trader Hitchi in the Town of Schuttgart. What do you think you should do?\n

steps.title: A Thoughtless Person
steps.description: Lockirin of Dwarven Village will instruct you on your next task.\n

steps.title: Message Delivered
steps.description: Mineral Trader Hitchi tells you to go back and visit Obi once more. Go see him.\n

steps.title: A Shrewd Response
steps.description: When you relay the message to him, Mineral Trader Hitchi tells you to go see Rydel.\n

419.description: A pet will be your friend in the most difficult of times. It's not easy to acquire one, however.

steps.title: To Obtain a Pet
steps.description: To receive a pet, you must earn the approval of Pet Manager Martin in Gludin Village. He says that you must have love for and knowledge of animals to prove that you deserve a pet. He asks you to return to your hometown, eliminate all animal killers and return to him.\n

420.description: Hatchlings are, quite honestly, ugly little creatures! But how else are you to get a strider and wyvern?

steps.title: Elder Cronos
steps.description: Quest that must be completed in order to obtain a pet hatchling. Visit Pet Manager Cooper and tell him that you wish to raise a hatchling. He will tell you to seek help from Elder Cronos of Hunters Village.\n

steps.title: Make a Fairy Stone
steps.description: After collecting the items requested by Elder Cronos, find Maria in the Town of Dion and ask her to make a Fairy Stone for you. Take the Fairy Stone to Cronos and he'll tell you what you need to do next.\n

steps.title: Fairy's Existence
steps.description: Take the completed Elven stone to Guard Byron and ask him about fairies.\n

steps.title: In Search of a Fairy
steps.description: Go to Fairy Valley and find a fairy who will talk with you.\n

steps.title: In Search of a Dragon Species
steps.description: Take the juice of monkshood that Fairy Mimyu gave you to the drake or wyrm that she introduced you to.\n

steps.title: Find the Stolen Eggs
steps.description: Recover 20 stolen eggs.\n

steps.title: Hatching Ritual
steps.description: Take the eggs to Fairy Mimyu.\n

421.description: Raising a fat, lazy hatchling isn't an easy task! You shall now reap the harvest of your hard work!

steps.title: In Search of Mimyu
steps.description: Elder Cronos suggests you consult Fairy Mimyu concerning the raising of Hatchling to Strider.\n

steps.title: The Sap of Fairy Trees
steps.description: Fairy Mimyu examines your hatchling and tells you the story of the four fairy trees and their guardians. She tells you to feed the sap of these trees to your hatchling. Go to each of the four fairy trees of wind, star, twilight and abyss and let your hatchling drink their sap. You must guard your hatchling as it drinks. When it has finished drinking, attach a fairy leaf to the fairy tree.\n

steps.title: Return to Fairy Mimyu
steps.description: Your hatchling has drunk the sap of all four fairy trees-- the wind, star, twilight and abyss. The preparations for its growth have been completed. Return to Fairy Mimyu.\n

422.description: The Black Judge gives sinners a chance for redemption. Will you follow the path of penitence, sinner? Be warned, it is sure to be filled with trials and tribulations!

steps.title: Sincerity of a Penitent's Heart
steps.description: The Black Judge tells the sinner that he has a chance for redemption. Will you follow the path of penitence, sure to be filled with trials and tribulations?\n

steps.title: Sincerity of a Penitent's Heart
steps.description: The Black Judge wants to test your sincerity in seeking atonement for your sins. She asks you to go and help Katari and then return to her.\n

steps.title: Sincerity of a Penitent's Heart
steps.description: The Black Judge wants to test your sincerity in seeking atonement for your sins. She asks you to go and help Piotur and then return to her.\n

steps.title: Sincerity of a Penitent's Heart
steps.description: The Black Judge wants to test your sincerity in seeking atonement for your sins. She asks you to go and help Elder Casian and then return to her. (If you add or change your sub-class while fulfilling this quest, the quest will automatically be terminated.)\n

steps.title: Sincerity of a Penitent's Heart
steps.description: The Black Judge wants to test your sincerity in seeking atonement for your sins. She asks you to go and help Magister Joan and then return to her. (If you add or change your sub-class while fulfilling this quest, the quest will automatically be terminated.)\n

steps.title: Help with the Missionary Work
steps.description: Katari requests that you kill the scavenger wererats that have been disrupting her missionary work.\n

steps.title: Help with the Farming
steps.description: Piotur says that his farm is being attacked by Turek war hounds. He asks you to drive them away.\n

steps.title: Help the Wastelands
steps.description: Elder Casian asks you to bring him the heart of a tyrant kingpin.\n

steps.title: Help with Spore Research
steps.description: Magister Joan requests that you kill a trisalim tarantula and bring back its venom sac.\n

steps.title: To the Black Judge
steps.description: You have completed the task Katari requested. Return to the Black Judge.\n

steps.title: To the Black Judge
steps.description: You have completed the task requested by Piotur. Return to the Black Judge.\n

steps.title: To the Black Judge
steps.description: You have completed the task requested by Elder Casian. Return to the Black Judge.\n

steps.title: To the Black Judge
steps.description: You have completed the task requested by Magister Joan. Return to the Black Judge.\n

steps.title: Make a Penitent's Manacle
steps.description: The Black Judge asks you to go to Blacksmith Pushkin and make a Penitent's Manacle.\n

steps.title: Toward Judgement
steps.description: You asked Blacksmith Pushkin to make Penitent's Manacles. Return to the Black Judge.\n

steps.title: Cleanse Your Own Sins
steps.description: The Black Judge asks you to lock up the sin eater with a manacle of penitent and to care for him for the sake of cleansing your soul.\n

426.description: Members of the Fishermen's Guild in each village are known for making fishing shots from a sweet fluid that the water spirits like.

steps.title: Collecting Sweet Fluid
steps.description: In order to create a fishing shot, you must collect sweet fluid that the water spirits are fond of. Any member of the Fishermen's Guild can tell you where to find it.\n

431.description: Melody Maestro Kantabilon has found the musical score for a wedding march and asks you to get a special echo crystal to contain the song.

steps.title: Silver Crystals
steps.description:
Melody Maestro Kantabilon asks that you bring him some Silver Crystals for him to store his new song in. Hunt Lienriks in the Field of Silence and collect 50 Silver Crystals.

Monsters to Hunt -Lienriks, Lienrik Lads

steps.title: Return to Kantabilon
steps.description: You've collected 50 Silver Crystals. Return to Kantabilon.\n

432.description: The beautiful weather has inspired Melody Maestro Octavia to finish a musical birthday piece.  Will you help her to store it?

steps.title: Red Crystal
steps.description:
Melody Maestro Octavia asks you to bring her some Red Crystals to hold a new song. Hunt Roughly-Hewn Rock Golems in the Floran Agricultural Area and bring back 50 Red Crystals.

Monster to Hunt - Roughly-Hewn Rock Golems

steps.title: Return to Octavia
steps.description: You've collected 50 Red Crystals. Return to Octavia.\n

501.description: The winds of destiny have brought you to this place! The chaotic chronicle must cease! When we accomplish this, our clan will be stronger than ever! Arise!

steps.title: Testimony of a Witch
steps.description: Quest that must be completed in order to raise a clan level to level 4. Sir Kristof Rodemai of the Town of Giran is seeking a clan leader to restore order in the kingdom. Find Sir Rodemai and speak to him. He will say that he cannot join forces with someone whose skills are yet unproven, and recommends you to first attempt and pass the trial of Witch Kalis. If you complete her test and return safely, he promises to give you the 'Alliance Manifesto,' which will thus expand the clan's powers and influences. First, go and seek Witch Kalis near the vicinity of the Ivory Tower.\n

steps.title: Proof of Loyalty
steps.description: Witch Kalis says she will test whether the clan members will give up their lives for their clan leader and says to prove the faithfulness of three clan members on the altar of sacrifice. If you get three marks of faithfulness, you can pass her test.\n

steps.title: Can They Be Trusted?
steps.description:
Witch Kalis is testing the trust of the clan leader by asking him to take poison. Before the clan leader dies, the clan members must obtain all the ingredients on the antidote's ingredient list. Of those ingredients, blood of Eva can be only obtained by meeting Witch Athrea.

Monsters to Hunt -
 Plains of Glory: Vanor Silenos shamans
Outlaw Forest: Ol Mahum witch doctors
The Forest of Mirrors: Harit lizardman shamans.

steps.title: Hero with a Sincere Heart
steps.description: You have passed the test of Witch Kalis and received a Voucher of Faith. Now, go to Giran Castle Town and meet with Sir Kristof Rodemai, a true hero. He is waiting for your return.\n

503.description: Sir Gustav Athebaldt has grave concerns about the future of the kingdom. He wants nothing more than to help the young and courageous leaders to bring peace to the land! If you join forces with him in the Town of Oren, he'll give you a  proof of expectation, increasing the power of the clan!

steps.title: Sir Gustav's Business
steps.description: Quest that must be fulfilled in order to raise a clan to level 5. Upon meeting Sir Gustav Athebaldt in the Town of Oren, he expresses his desire to aid the young and courageous leaders of the kingdom. He promises to give you the 'Seal of Aspiration,' which is needed when expanding the clan's powers and influences should you agree to join forces with him. Sir Athebaldt asks you to help him prepare for the attack against the dragon Antharas; and tells you to go meet Marvin in the Town of Giran.\n

steps.title: Collect Wyrm Eggs
steps.description:
Martien is running a business that involves collecting eggs of Drakes and Wyrms. He asks that you go to Dragon Valley and collect ten eggs each of Thunder Wyrm, Drake, Blitz Wyrm and Mist Drake. Blitz Wyrms and Mist Drakes are very rare and cannot be found by ordinary methods. Get some clues if you meet with the Dwarven Bounty Hunters who have been dispatched earlier.

Monster to be Hunted - Drake, Thunder Wyrm, Blitz Wyrm

steps.title: Sir Gustav Athebaldt
steps.description: You have collected all the drake and wyrm eggs and delivered them to Martien. Now, return to Sir Gustav Athebaldt.\n

steps.title: Dwarven Artisan
steps.description: Sir Gustav Athebaldt instructs you to go meet Dwarven Artisan Balthazar, who he is supporting, and help him in his research. Go to Hunters Village and meet Balthazar.\n

steps.title: Golem Research
steps.description: Dwarf Artisan Balthazar is developing a new type of golem. He asks you to bring him 10 Titan's powerstones and 10 Nebulite Crystals. They can be obtained from lesser giant soldiers and scouts in The Giant's Cave.\n

steps.title: Sir Gustav Athebaldt
steps.description: You have gotten all the ingredients required for Balthazar's research into golem development. Now go back to Sir Gustav Athebaldt.\n

steps.title: Scepter of Judgment
steps.description: Sir Gustav Athebaldt says that he wants to hold the scepter of judgment in his hand and says to go get that. First go to Aden and meet Sir Eric Rodemai, who is a follower of Sir Athebaldt.\n

steps.title: Mysterious Witch
steps.description: In order for Sir Eric Rodemai to give you a hint on where you can find the scepter of judgment, he says that you must meet Witch Cleo. Follow his instructions and find Witch Cleo who is to the east of Aden.\n

steps.title: Witch's Riddle
steps.description: You asked Witch Cleo about the scepter of judgment and all you got in return was a cryptic answer. Go back to Sir Eric Rodemai and ask him about the meaning of the riddle.\n

steps.title: Ancient Grave
steps.description: Sir Eric Rodemai solved the riddle of Witch Cleo for you. Use the clues he gives you to get the scepter of judgment. Hunt the grave keymaster, imperial slave and the imperial gravekeeper.\n

steps.title: Glory in Your Hand
steps.description: You've got the scepter of judgment! Now take this to Sir Gustav Athebaldt.\n

steps.title: Who is the Valid Heir?
steps.description: Are you going to give the scepter of judgment to Sir Gustav Athebaldt or just talk to him about it?\n

504.description: A holy war has broken out over the position of ol mahum chief of the Bandit Stronghold! The competition has become so fierce that it's been opened up to outsiders!

steps.title: Right to Participate
steps.description: This quest must be accomplished in order to participate in a clan hall war. You must be the first of five to kill Tarlk bugbears and Tarlk basilisks and bring back 30 proofs. Successful completion of this quest permits participation in a clan hall war. In the Forest of Evil, hunt Tarlk Bugbears, Tarlk Bugbear Warriors and Tarlk Bugbear High Warriors. In the Outlaw Forest hunt Tarlk Basilisks and Elder Tarlk Basilisks.\n

505.description: Kill as many evil creatures as possible within 18 minutes!

steps.title: Hunt Dungeon Monsters for an Offering
steps.description: Slay as many of evil creatures as you can within 18 minutes and collect the blood offering! \nIf you wish to quit without completing the festival, or if you wish to make the festival more challenging, speak with a Festival Witch.\n

508.description: Sir Eric Rodemai in Aden Castle Town is looking for a brave adventurer to raise the clan's reputation.

steps.title: Raise the Clan's Reputation
steps.description: Sir Eric Rodemai of Aden Castle Town needs a brave adventurer to help boost the clan's reputation by defeating the Raid Bosses currently terrorizing the townspeople. Get more details from Sir Eric.\n

509.description: Grand Magister Baldis in the Rune Township is looking for a powerful clan that can enhance the clan's prestige.

steps.title: Enhance the Clan's Prestige
steps.description: Grand Magister Valdis of the Rune Township is looking for a brave mage to  help enhance the clan's prestige by defeating the Raid Bosses currently terrorizing the townspeople. Get more details from Grand Magister Valdis.\n

510.description: Grand Magister Valdis of Rune Township needs a special ingredient in order to craft weapons and armor for his guards.

steps.title: Clan Reputation Increase
steps.description: Grand Magister Valdis in Rune Township is looking for a clan anxious to enhance its reputation. If you retrieve the Tyrannosaurus claw that he needs from the Primeval Isle, he promises to help you increase your clan's reputation. Go find the Tyrannosaurus claw. \n

601.description: The Eye of Argos asks you to kill the disciples that are making its life miserable.

steps.title: Hunting Disciples
steps.description:
The Eye of Argos orders you to punish the disciples who tormented him and bring back 100 marks of disciple.

Monsters to Hunt - Disciples of Protection, Disciples of Punishment, Disciples of Authority

steps.title: Mark of Disciple
steps.description: You've collected all the marks of disciple. Show them to the Eye of Argos.\n

602.description: When Daimon the White-Eyed tries to control the monsters here, the Eye of Argos sought soldiers to defeat him.

steps.title: Daimon's Family
steps.description:
The Eye of Argos orders you to catch monsters controlled by the family of Daimon the White-Eyed and collect 100 eyes of darkness in order to prevent Daimon from expanding his power.

Monsters to Hunt - Buffalo Slaves, Grendel Slaves

steps.title: Eye of Darkness
steps.description: You've collected the 100 eyes of darkness that Eye of Argos demanded. Take them to the Eye of Argos.\n

603.description: The Eye of Argos asks you to destroy the gigantic eye born of his dark side.

steps.title: Secret of Tablet - 1
steps.description: The Eye of Argos orders you to find the ancient tablet that describes how the ancient heroes defeated Daimon the White-Eyed.\n

steps.title: Secret of Tablet - 2
steps.description: It describes how the heroes defeated Daimon, but the text is incomplete. Find another tablet.\n

steps.title: Secret of Tablet - 3
steps.description: It describes how the heroes defeated Daimon, but the text is incomplete. Find another tablet.\n

steps.title: Secret of Tablet - 4
steps.description: It describes how the heroes defeated Daimon, but the text is incomplete. Find another tablet.\n

steps.title: Secret of Tablet - 5
steps.description: It describes how the heroes defeated Daimon, but the text is incomplete. Find another tablet.\n

steps.title: Towards the Eye of Argos
steps.description: You've figured out how the heroes defeated Daimon. Take the crystal piece to the Eye of Argos.\n

steps.title: Collect the Thoughts of Darkness
steps.description:
The Eye of Argos needs 10 thoughts of darkness to make a bead of summoning to call Daimon the White-Eyed. Get the thoughts of darkness from Canyon Bandersnatch Slaves, Buffalo Slaves and Grendel Slaves, Daimon's family.

Monsters to Hunt - Canyon Bandersnatch Slaves, Buffalo Slaves, Grendel Slaves

steps.title: To the Eye of Argos
steps.description: You've collected all 200 thoughts of darkness. Take them to the Eye of Argos.\n

604.description: The Eye of Argos gives you a bead of summoning and asks you to destroy Daimon the White-Eyed.

steps.title: Ritual of Summoning
steps.description: The Eye of Argos gives you a bead of summoning to call Daimon the White-Eyed and tells you to go to the Altar of Daimon, summon Daimon and kill him.\n

steps.title: Battle - Daimon the White-Eyed
steps.description: Daimon the White-Eyed with the scary look has showed up. You must become the sword of justice to judge evils in the world and defeat Daimon.\n

steps.title: The Hero's Escape
steps.description: You've killed Daimon the White-Eyed. Go to the Eye of Argos and tell him that you defeated Daimon.\n

605.description: Messenger Wahkan asks you to be an ally of Ketra Orcs and join them in fighting Varka Silenos, the sworn enemy of Ketra Orcs...

steps.title: Form an Alliance!
steps.description:
To obtain a "Mark of Ketra's Alliance - Level 1" as proof of your acceptance by the Ketra Orcs, you must bring back 100 "Varka's Badges - Soldier".

Monsters to Hunt - Varka Silenos Recruits, Varka Silenos Footmen, Varka Silenos Scouts, Varka Silenos Hunters and Varka Silenos Shamans.

steps.title: Strengthen the Alliance!
steps.description:
To obtain the "Mark of Ketra's Alliance - Level 2," you must bring back 200 "Varka's Badges - Soldier" and 100 "Varka's Badges - Captain." 
 If you harm a Ketra Orc while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken.

Monsters to Hunt - Varka Silenos Recruits, Varka Silenos Footmen, Varka Silenos Scouts, Varka Silenos Hunters, Varka Silenos Shamans, Varka Silenos Priests, Warriors, Mediums, Magus, Officers, Commanders and Elite Guards

steps.title: Strengthen the Alliance!
steps.description:
To obtain the "Mark of Ketra's Alliance - Level 3," you must bring back 300 "Varka's Badges - Soldier," 200 "Varka's Badges - Captain," and 100 "Varka's Badges - General."  
 If you harm a Ketra Orc while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken.

Monsters to Hunt - Varka Silenos Recruits, Varka Silenos Footmen, Varka Silenos Scouts, Varka Silenos Hunters, Varka Silenos Shamans, Varka Silenos Priests, Warriors, Mediums, Magus, Officers, Commanders, Elite Guards, Varka Silenos Great Magus, Generals, Great Seers, Varka's Prophets and Diciples of Prophet, Prophet Guards, Varka's Head Magus and Varka's Head Guards.

steps.title: Strengthen the Alliance!
steps.description:
To obtain "Mark of Ketra's Alliance - Level 4" you must bring back 300 "Varka's Badges - Soldier," 300 "Varka's Badges - Captain," and 100 "Varka's Badges - General." You must also obtain the totem of courage by fulfilling the Prove your Courage quest and bringing back the totem.
 If you harm a Ketra Orc while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken.

Monsters to Hunt - Varka Silenos Recruits, Varka Silenos Footmen, Varka Silenos Scouts, Varka Silenos Hunters, Varka Silenos Shamans, Varka Silenos Priests, Warriors, Mediums, Magus, Officers, Commanders, Elite Guards, Varka Silenos Great Magus, Generals, Great Seers, Varka's prophets and Disciples of Prophet, Prophet Guards, Varka's Head Magus and Varka's Head Guard.

steps.title: Strengthen the Alliance!
steps.description:
To obtain "Mark of Ketra's Alliance - Level 5" you must bring back 400 "Varka's Badges - Soldier," 400 "Varka's Badges - Captain," and 200 "Varka's Badges - General." You must also obtain the totem of strategy by fulfilling the Slay the Enemy Commander quest. 
 If you harm a Ketra Orc while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken.

Monsters to Hunt - Varka Silenos Recruits, Varka Silenos Footmen, Varka Silenos Scouts, Varka Silenos Hunters, Varka Silenos Shamans, Varka Silenos Priests, Warriors, Mediums, Magus, Officers, Commanders, Elite Guards, Varka Silenos Great Magus, Generals, Great Seers, Varka's Prophets and Disciples of Prophet, Prophet Guards, Varka's Head Magus and Varka's Head Guard.

steps.title: Privilege of an Alliance
steps.description: The Ketra Orcs grant many privileges to their allies. They may purchase various supplies from Grocer Atan and specialty items from Trader Jumara, and also ask Gatekeeper Kurfa for teleportation service. \n If you harm a Ketra Orc while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken.\n

606.description: Kadun Zu Ketra, the chief of Ketra Orcs is looking for a brave fighter who will defeat Varka Silenos, their sworn enemy...

steps.title: Defeat the enemy!
steps.description:
Hierarch Kadun Zu Ketra has issued the order to attack! Go to their stronghold and slay the Varka Silenos! As proof, collect and bring back 100 manes of Varka Silenos. 
 If you harm a Ketra Orc while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken.

Monsters to Hunt - Varka Silenos Recruits, Varka Silenos Scouts, Varka Silenos Hunters, Varka Silenos Shamans, Varka Silenos Priests, Varka Silenos Warriors, Varka Silenos Mediums, Varka Silenos Officers, Varka Silenos Seers, Varka Silenos Great Magus, Varka Silenos Generals, Varka Silenos Great Seers, Varka Silenos Commanders and Varka's Head Magus.

607.description: You heard the news that Kadun Zu Hestui, the elder of Ketra Orcs is looking for a warrior who can defeat Shadith, the hero of the Varka Silenos tribe.

steps.title: Slay the hero!
steps.description:
Kadun Zu Ketra, the elder of Ketra Orcs has assigned to you the Test of Courage. Go to Varka Silenos Stronghold, slay Varka's Hero Shadith and bring back his head. 
 While carrying out the mission, if you attack a Ketra Orc, the mission will be canceled automatically.

Monster to hunt - Varka's Hero Shadith

steps.title: Return to the Elder
steps.description: You've slain Shadith, hero of Varka and cut off his head! Return to Kadun Zu Ketra, the elder of Ketra Orcs!  \n While carrying out the mission, if you attack a Ketra Orc, this mission will be canceled automatically.\n

608.description: You heard the news that Kadun Zu Hestui, the elder of Ketra Orcs is looking for a warrior who can defeat Shadith, the hero of the Varka Silenos tribe.

steps.title: Slay the Commander!
steps.description:
Kadun Zu Ketra, the elder of Ketra Orcs has issued a special strategic order. Go to the Varka Silenos Stronghold, slay Varka's commander Mos and bring back his head. 
 While carrying out the mission, if you attack a Ketra Orc, this mission will be canceled automatically.

Monster to hunt - Varka's commander Mos

steps.title: Return to the Elder
steps.description: You've slain Varka's commander Mos and cut off his head!  Return to Kadun Zu Ketra, the elder of Ketra Orcs!  \nWhile carrying out the mission, if you attack a Ketra Orc, this mission will be canceled automatically.\n

609.description: Ketra's Messenger Wahkan has given you the assignment to steal the source of the magical power from the shaman of Varka Silenos, their enemy...

steps.title: Meet the Guide of Dead Souls!
steps.description: Meet Asefa in the Ketra Orc Village. \n However, if you ever harm a Ketra Orc while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken.\n

steps.title: Steal the magical power of water!
steps.description: Steal the totem from the box of Udan Mardui in the Varka Silenos Stronghold. If you're discovered in the midst of your mission and get accursed, you must stop the mission and return to Asefa, Guide of Dead Souls. \n However, if you ever harm a Ketra Orc while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken.\n

steps.title: Return to Asefa
steps.description: You've successfully stolen the totem from the box of Udan Mardui! Return to Asefa!\n

610.description: You must use the totem you stole from the shaman of Varka Silenos to summon the Spirit of Water and slay it...

steps.title: Varka's Sacred Altar
steps.description:
Go to the sacred altar of Varka Silenos and use the green totem. A spirit of water will appear. Kill it and obtain the essence of its power! 
 However, if you ever harm a Ketra Orc while carrying out this mission your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken.

Monster to Hunt - Ashutar, the Spirit of Water

steps.title: Slay the Spirit of Water
steps.description:
Slay Ashutar, the spirit of water, and steal the source of its power!  
While carrying out the mission, if you attack a Ketra Orc, this mission will be canceled automatically.

Monster to Hunt - Ashutar, the Spirit of Water

steps.title: Return to the Guide of Dead Souls!
steps.description: Take the ice heart of Ashutar and return to Asefa, Guide of Dead Souls.  \nWhile carrying out the mission, if you attack a Ketra Orc, this mission will be canceled automatically.\n

611.description: Naran Ashanuk, Varka's Messenger asks you to become a friend of Varka Silenos and join them in fighting against Ketra Orcs their sworn enemy...

steps.title: Form an Alliance!
steps.description:
In order to obtain the Mark of Varka's Alliance - Level 1, you must first bring back 100 Ketra's Badges - Soldier. 

 Monsters to Hunt - Ketra Orc Footmen, Ketra Orc Raiders, Ketra Orc Scouts, Ketra Orc Shamans and Ketra's War Hounds.

steps.title: Strengthen the Alliance!
steps.description:
In order to obtain the Mark of Varka's Alliance - Level 2, you must bring back 200 Ketra's Badges - Soldier and 100 Ketra's Badges - Captain. 
 However, if you ever harm a Varka Silenos while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken.

Monsters to Hunt - Ketra Orc Footman, Raiders, War Hounds, Scouts, and Shamans for the Soldier badge.  Ketra Orc Warriors, Lieutenants, Mediums, Elite Soldiers, Commands, Elite Guards, White Captains, and Seers to obtain the Captain badge.

steps.title: Strengthen the Alliance!
steps.description:
In order to obtain the Mark of Varka's Alliance - Level 3, you must bring back 300 Ketra's Badges - Soldier, 200 Ketra's Badges - Captain, and 100 Ketra's Badges - General. 
 If you harm a Varka Silenos while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded  one level and the alliance will be broken.

Monsters to Hunt - Ketra Orc Footman, Raiders, War Hounds, Scouts, and Shamans for the Soldier badge.  Ketra Orc Warriors, Lieutenants, Mediums, Elite Soldiers, Commands, Elite Guards, White Captains, and Seers to obtain the Captain badge.  To get the General's Badge you must kill Ketra Orc Generals, Battalion Commanders, Grand Seers, Head Shamans, Head Guards, Prophets, Prophet's Guard, and Prophet's Aide.

steps.title: Strengthen the Alliance!
steps.description:
In order to obtain Mark of Ketra's Alliance - Level 4 you must bring back 300 Varka's Badges - Soldier, 200 Varka's Badges - Captain, and 100 Varka's Badges - General. You must also obtain the totem of courage by fulfilling the Prove your Courage quest and bringing back the totem.

Monsters to Hunt -  Ketra Orc Footman, Raiders, War Hounds, Scouts, and Shamans for the Soldier badge.  Ketra Orc Warriors, Lieutenants, Mediums, Elite Soldiers, Commands, Elite Guards, White Captains, and Seers to obtain the Captain badge.  To get the General's Badge you must kill Ketra Orc Generals, Battalion Commanders, Grand Seers, Head Shamans, Head Guards, Prophets, Prophet's Guard, and Prophet's Aide.

steps.title: Strengthen the Alliance!
steps.description:
In order to obtain Mark of Varka's Alliance - Level 5 you must bring back 400 Ketra's Badges - Soldier, 400 Ketra's Badges - Captain, and 200 Ketra's Badges - General. You must also obtain the feather of strategy by fulfilling the Slay the Enemy Commander quest. 
 If you ever harm a Varka Silenos while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken.

Monsters to Hunt - Ketra Orc Footman, Raiders, War Hounds, Scouts, and Shamans for the Soldier badge.  Ketra Orc Warriors, Lieutenants, Mediums, Elite Soldiers, Commands, Elite Guards, White Captains, and Seers to obtain the Captain badge.  To get the General's Badge you must kill Ketra Orc Generals, Battalion Commanders, Grand Seers, Head Shamans, Head Guards, Prophets, Prophet's Guard, and Prophet's Aide.

steps.title: Privileges of the Alliance
steps.description: The Varka Silenos Tribe grants many privileges to their allies. They can purchase various supplies from Grocer Diyabu and specialty items from Trader Shikon, and also ask Gatekeeper Teranu Mardui for teleportation service.\n If you ever harm a Varka Silenos while carrying out this mission, your mark of ally will be downgraded one level and the alliance will be broken.\n

612.description: Ashas Varka Durai, Varka Silenos' Chief is looking for a fighter who will defeat Ketra Orcs, the sworn enemy of Varka Silenos...

steps.title: Defeat the Enemy!
steps.description:
Elder Ashas Varka Durai issued the order to attack! Go to the Ketra Orc Outpost and slay the enemy, Ketra Orcs. And as proof, collect and bring back 100 molars of Ketra Orcs.
 However, if you ever harm a Varka Silenos while carrying out this mission, the mission will be cancelled automatically.

Monsters to hunt - Ketra Orc Footman, Ketra Orc Raider, Ketra Orc Scout, Ketra Orc Shaman, Ketra Orc Warrior, Ketra Orc Lieutenant, Ketra Orc Medium, Ketra Orc Commander, Ketra Orc General, Ketra Orc Battalion Commander, Ketra Orc Grand Seer, Ketra's Head Shaman, and Ketra Prophet.

613.description: Ashas Varka Durai, Varka Silenos' Chief is looking for a fighter who will defeat Ketra Orcs, the sworn enemy of Varka Silenos...

steps.title: Slay the Hero!
steps.description:
Ashas Varka Durai, the elder of Varka Silenos has assigned to you the Test of Courage. Go to the Ketra Orc Outpost, slay Ketra's Hero Hekaton and bring back his head.

Monster to hunt - Ketra's Hero Hekaton.  
While carrying out the mission, if you attack a Varka Silenos, this mission will be cancelled automatically.

steps.title: Return to the Elder
steps.description: You have slain Hekaton, hero of Ketra and cut off his head! Now, return to Ashas Varka Durai, the elder of Varka Silenos.  \nWhile carrying out the mission, if you attack a Varka Silenos, this mission will be cancelled automatically.\n

614.description: Ashas Varka Durai, Varka Silenos' Chief is looking for a fighter who will defeat Ketra Orcs, the sworn enemy of Varka Silenos...

steps.title: Slay the Commander!
steps.description:
Ashas Varka Durai, the elder of Varka Silenos has issued a special strategic order.  Go to Ketra Orc Outpost, slay Ketra's commander Tayr and bring back his head.

Monster to hunt - Ketra Commander Tayr  
While carrying out the mission, if you attack a Varka Silenos, this mission will be cancelled automatically.

steps.title: Return to the Elder
steps.description: You have slain Ketra's commander Tayr and cut off his head!  Now, return to Ashas Varka Durai, the elder of Varka Silenos!  \nWhile carrying out the mission, if you attack a Varka Silenos, this mission will be cancelled automatically.\n

615.description: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk has given you the assignment to steal the source of the magical power from the shaman of Ketra Orcs, their enemy...

steps.title: Meet the Guide of Dead Souls!
steps.description: Meet Udan Mardui, Guide of Dead Souls, who is located in the Varka Silenos Village. \n However, if you ever harm a Varka Silenos while carrying out this mission, the mission will be cancelled automatically.\n
steps.completionNpcName: Udan Mardui, Guide of Dead Souls

steps.title: Steal the Magical Power of Fire!
steps.description:
Steal the totem from the box of Asefa who is located in Ketra Orc Outpost. If you are discovered in the midst of your mission and get accursed, you must stop the mission and return to Udan Mardui, Guide of Dead Souls. 
 If you ever harm a Varka Silenos while carrying out this mission, the mission will be cancelled automatically.

steps.title: Return to Mardui
steps.description: You have successfully stolen the totem from the box of Asefa! Now, return to Guide of Dead Souls Udan Mardui!\n
steps.completionNpcName: Guide of Dead Souls Udan Mardui

616.description: You must use the totem you stole from the shaman of Ketra Orcs to summon the Spirit of Water and slay it...

steps.title: Ketra's Sacred Altar
steps.description:
Go to the sacred altar of Ketra Orcs and use the red totem. Then, a spirit of fire will appear. Kill the spirit of fire and obtain the essence of its power! 
 However, if you ever harm a Varka Silenos while carrying out this mission, the mission will be cancelled automatically.


 Monster to hunt - Nastron, the Spirit of Fire.

steps.title: Slay the Spirit of Fire!
steps.description:
Slay Nastron, a spirit of fire and steal the source of its power! 
While carrying out the mission, if you attack a Varka Silenos, this mission will be cancelled automatically.

Monster to hunt - Nastron, the Spirit of Fire.

steps.title: Return to the Guide of Dead Souls!
steps.description: Take the flaming heart of Nastron and return to Udan Mardui, Guide of Dead Souls. \nWhile carrying out the mission, if you attack a Varka Silenos, this mission will be cancelled automatically.\n
steps.completionNpcName: Udan Mardui, Guide of Dead Souls

617.description: Vulcan is collecting flames in the lower level of the Forge of the Gods. He'll give you a special reward if you defeat all the monsters there and bring him the flames that you collect.

steps.title: Collecting Flames
steps.description:
Blacksmith Vulcan is collecting the Torches located in the lower level of the Forge of the Gods. You can obtain them by slaying the monsters within the Forge of the Gods. Take 1,000 Torches to Vulcan and he will give you a random S-grade weapon recipe.
Blacksmith Rooney, who is wandering in the Forge of the Gods, is also collecting the Torches. Take 1,200 Torches to him and he will give you an S-grade weapon recipe of your choice.

Monsters to Hunt - All monsters in the Forge of the Gods

618.description: You'll need a set of floating stones to enter the Flame Pass within the Forge of the Gods.

steps.title: Get the Vacualite
steps.description: Klein says you must have a set of floating stones to enter the Flame Pass. You can create the set of floating stones with vacualite. Speak with Blacksmith Hilda in the Town of Goddard to obtain vacualite.\n

steps.title: Obtain the Ore
steps.description: You need Vacualite ore to make Vacualite. Hunt monsters in the Garden of Beasts and collect 50 Vacualite ore.  Monsters to Hunt - Kookaburras, Bandersnatch and Grendels\n

steps.title: Return to Blacksmith Hilda
steps.description: You've collected the Vacualite ore you need. Return to Blacksmith Hilda in the Town of Goddard.\n

steps.title: Return to Klein
steps.description: You've got the vacualite. Return to Klein at the Forge of the Gods.\n

619.description: The Ghost of Adventurer collects relics of the nobles who were killed when they came to the cemetery to pay their respects. Take him 1000 relics and he'll give you a reward.

steps.title: Collecting Relics
steps.description:
The Ghost of Adventurer collects relics of the nobles who were killed when they came to the cemetery to pay their respects. Take him 1000 relics and he'll give you a reward.

Monsters to Hunt - All the Monsters inside of the Imperial Tomb

620.description: The Nameless Spirit at the entrance of the Four Sepulchers is collecting 4 goblets which you can get from the Shadows of Halisha inside the Four Sepulchers.

steps.title: Collecting Four Goblets
steps.description:
The Nameless Spirit at the entrance to the four Sepulchers is collecting four goblets that can be recovered by killing the Shadows of Halisha. Kill the Shadows of Halisha deep inside of the four Sepulchers and collect the four goblets.

Monsters to Hunt - Shadows of Halisha

steps.title: Destroy the Evil Spirits
steps.description: You've delivered the four goblets to the Nameless Spirit. It asks that you continue to destroy the evil spirits inside of the four Sepulchers.\n

621.description: Chef Jeremy is looking for someone to deliver boiled eggs to his customers.

steps.title: Delivery of Eggs - Pulin
steps.description: You've decided to become Jeremy's eggman. Deliver the boiled eggs to Pulin in the northeast part of the Hot Springs area.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Eggs - Naff
steps.description: You've decided to become Jeremy's eggman. Deliver the boiled eggs to Naff in the center of the Hot Springs area.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Eggs - Crocus
steps.description: You've decided to become Jeremy's eggman. Deliver the boiled eggs to Crocus in the west of the Hot Springs area.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Eggs - Kuber
steps.description: You've decided to become Jeremy's eggman. Deliver the boiled eggs to Kuber in the northwest of the Hot Springs area.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Eggs - Beolin
steps.description: You've decided to become Jeremy's eggman. Deliver the boiled eggs to Beolin in the north of the Hot Springs area.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Eggs - To Jeremy
steps.description: You've worked hard and finished all of Jeremy's deliveries. Return to him and get your wages.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Eggs - To Valentine
steps.description: Chef Jeremy says he doesn't have money and tells you to ask Valentine in the Town of Goddard for payment.\n

622.description: Chef Jeremy is looking for someone to deliver special liquor to his customers.

steps.title: Delivery of Specialty Liquor - Beolin
steps.description: You've decided to become Jeremy's liquor delivery person. Deliver the special liquor to Beolin in the north of the Hot Springs area.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Specialty Liquor - Kuber
steps.description: You've decided to become Jeremy's liquor delivery person. Deliver the special liquor to Kuber in the northwest of the Hot Springs area.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Specialty Liquor - Crocus
steps.description: You've decided to become Jeremy's liquor delivery person. Deliver the special liquor to Crocus in the west of the Hot Springs area.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Specialty Liquor - Naff
steps.description: You've decided to become Jeremy's liquor delivery person. Deliver the special liquor to Naff in the center of the Hot Springs area.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Specialty Liquor - Pulin
steps.description: You've decided to become Jeremy's liquor delivery person. Deliver the special liquor to Pulin in the northeast part of the Hot Springs area.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Specialty Liquor - To Jeremy
steps.description: You've worked hard and finished all of Jeremy's deliveries. Return to him and get your wages.\n

steps.title: Delivery of Specialty Liquor - To Lietta
steps.description: Chef Jeremy says he doesn't have money and tells you to ask Warehouse Keeper Lietta in the Town of Goddard for payment.\n

623.description: Chef Jeremy asks you to gather the ingredients so he can develop a special regional dish.

steps.title: Pride of the Master Chef
steps.description:
Chef Jeremy asks you to obtain 100 Flava Leaves, 100 Pieces of Buffalo Meat and 100 Antelope Horns in order to make a dish that will definitely impress the nobles who insulted him. 

Monsters to Hunt - Hot Springs Flava, Hot Springs Buffalo, Hot Springs Antelope

steps.title: Delivering Rare Ingredients
steps.description: You've obtained 100 each of flava leaves, buffalo meat and antelope horns. Deliver them to Chef Jeremy.\n

624.description: Chef Jeremy asks you to gather ingredients to attract Icicle Emperor Bumbalump, the king of yetis, so you can get some excellent yeti meat.

steps.title: Get the Bait
steps.description:
Chef Jeremy needs some yeti meat to win the cooking contest. He asks you to bring him some.

Monsters to Hunt - Hot Springs Atrox, Hot Springs Atroxspawn, Hot Springs Bandersnatchlings, Hot Springs Nepenthes

steps.title: Delivering Rare Ingredients
steps.description: You've obtained 50 each of nepenthes stems, bandersnatchling foot soles and secret spices. Deliver them to Chef Jeremy.\n

steps.title: Return to Jeremy
steps.description: You've obtained all the ingredients Chef Jeremy requested. Now take them to him.\n

625.description: Chef Jeremy asks you to gather ingredients to attract Icicle Emperor Bumbalump, the king of yetis, so you can get some excellent yeti meat.

steps.title: Bumbalump Hunting
steps.description: Chef Jeremy cooked a very special dish for the Icicle Emperor Bumbalump. Go to the yeti's table, put the dish down and wait for him.\n

steps.title: Entice Bumbalump!
steps.description: Catch Icicle Emperor Bumbalump and get the yeti meat.\n

steps.title: The Hunter's Escape
steps.description: You've obtained the ingredient that Chef Jeremy wanted by catching Bumbalump. Take it to Chef Jeremy.\n

626.description: The Hierarch in charge of the Evil Altar asks you to eliminate those who interfere with the activities of his followers.

steps.title: Killing Splendors
steps.description:
The Hierarch asks you to eliminate the splendors and collect Blood of Saint as proof.
Get rid of them and obtain 300 units of Blood of Saint.

Monsters to Hunt - Eye of Splendor, Flash of Splendor, Blade of Splendor, Wisdom of Splendor, Soul of Splendor, Victory of Splendor, Punishment of Splendor, Shout of Splendor, Signet of Splendor, Crown of Splendor and Wailing of Splendor

steps.title: Blood Proofs
steps.description: As the Hierarch requested, you've collected 300 units of Blood of Saint as proof of your accomplishments. Take them to the Hierarch.\n

627.description: The Mysterious Necromancer stands morosely near the entrance of the Valley of Saints. He says that he's gathering materials for his research into increased power.

steps.title: Collect the Beads of Obedience
steps.description:
The Mysterious Necromancer asks you to collect 300 Beads of Obedience.

Monsters to Hunt - Eye of Splendor, Flash of Splendor, Blade of Splendor, Wisdom of Splendor, Soul of Splendor, Victory of Splendor, Punishment of Splendor, Shout of Splendor, Signet of Splendor, Crown of Splendor and Wailing of Splendor

steps.title: Find the Mysterious Necromancer
steps.description: You've collected all 300 Beads of Obedience that the Mysterious Necromancer asked for. Deliver the beads to him.\n

steps.title: Find Enfeux
steps.description: Enfeux is the place where saints' bones are kept. Take the Seal of Light that the Mysterious Necromancer gave you and visit Enfeux.\n

steps.title: Find the Mysterious Necromancer
steps.description: You've got the saints' bones by using the Seal of Light. Deliver the saints' bones to the Mysterious Necromancer.\n

628.description: The Golden Ram Mercenary Force is currently recruiting! This prestigious mercenary force is currently carrying out the mission of subjugating/driving out stakatos from the Swamp of Screams...

steps.title: Join the Golden Ram
steps.description:
In order to join the Golden Ram Mercenary Force, you must first prove your ability. Go to the Swamp of Screams, slay stakatos and collect the proofs. After completing the mission, return to Mercenary Kahman.

Monsters to Hunt - Splinter Stakatos, Splinter Stakato Workers, Splinter Stakato Soldiers and Splinter Stakato Drones

steps.title: Promotion to Elite Soldier
steps.description:
The recruits of the Golden Ram Mercenary force receive a few privileges. One can receive a quest from Mercenary Captain Pierce and obtain specialty items from Mercenary Supplier Abercrombie. 
 If you would like to receive more privileges, you must first become an elite soldier. Go to the Swamp of Screams, kill stakatos and contribute to the war effort! After completing the mission, return to Mercenary Kahman.

Monsters to Hunt - Splinter Stakatos, Splinter Stakato Workers, Splinter Stakato Soldiers, Splinter Stakato Drones, Needle Stakatos, Needle Stakato Workers, Needle Stakato Soldiers and 
Needle Stakato Drones

steps.title: Elite Soldier Privileges
steps.description: An elite soldier of the Golden Ram Mercenary Force receives several privileges. One can receive a quest from Mercenary Captain Pierce and obtain specialty items from Mercenary Supplier Abercrombie. In addition, an elite soldier can also receive help from Mercenary Medic Selina in the form of beneficial magic. \n

629.description: Pierce, captain of the Golden Ram Mercenary Force has assigned the task of driving out stakatos to you. You must go to the Swamp of Screams to carry out this mission...

steps.title: Slaughter the Stakatos!
steps.description:
Pierce, captain of the Golden Ram Mercenary Force has assigned you the task of driving out the stakatos. Go to the Swamp of Screams and slay splinter stakatos and needle stakatos. As proof of your success, collect 100 claws of stakatos. When you bring them back to the barracks of the mercenary force, you'll receive a reward.

Monsters to Hunt - Splinter Stakatos, Splinter Stakato Workers, Splinter Stakato Soldiers, Splinter Stakato Drones, Needle Stakatos, Needle Stakato Workers, Needle Stakato Soldiers and Needle Stakato Drones

631.description: The best meat comes from a mature animal, but with no one left to raise them, those animals have become too fierce to approach!

steps.title: Get Meat
steps.description:
Tunatun needs good quality meat. You get the best if you butcher a beast in the Pasturelands when it's grown large enough. Hunt beasts for food and fame!

Monsters to Hunt - Alpen Kookaburras, Alpen Buffalos and third-stage Alpen Cougars

steps.title: Return to Tunatun
steps.description: You've got 120 slices of good quality meat. Return to Tunatun to get a reward.\n

632.description: The Necromancer in the Forest of the Dead asks you to destroy the vampires that are interfering with his collection of magic materials.

steps.title: Vampire Hunting
steps.description:
The Mysterious Wizard in the Forest of the Dead town asks two things. Kill vampires and hunt the undead that show up at night. Do this for him.

Monsters to Hunt - 
Vampire - Devil Bats, Atrox and all other vampires in the Forest of the Dead. General Undead: Corrupted Knights, Resurrected Knights, Corrupted Royal Guards, Resurrected Royal Guards, Slaughter Executioners, Guillotine's Ghosts, Resurrected Guards, Ghosts of Guillotine, Ghosts of Rebel Soldiers, Ghosts of Rebel Leaders

steps.title: Return to the Mysterious Wizard
steps.description: You've collected 200 vampire hearts. Return to the Mysterious Wizard to receive your reward. Continue collecting undead brains if you like it! Collect more vampire hearts for more rewards.\n

633.description: The Forgotten Village inside the Forest of the Dead. The people here are constantly harassed by undead and Dark Mages. Help them!

steps.title: Dark Mage Hunting
steps.description:
Mina asks you to do two things for her. Kill Dark Mages and hunt the undead. Do her this favor.

Monster to Hunt - 
Magus of Dark Arts: Bone Snatcher, Bone Maker, Bone Collector, Bone Animator, Bone Slayer, Bone Sweeper, Bone Grinder, Bone Caster, Bone Puppeteer, Bone Scavenger, Bone Shaper, Skull Collector, Skull Animator,
Undead Monster: Trampled Men, Sacrificed Men, Behemoth Zombie, Requiem Lord, Requiem Priest, Requiem Behemoth

steps.title: Return to Mina
steps.description: You've collected 200 ribs. Return to Mina to receive your reward. Continue collecting livers of undead if you like. After settling accounts for rib bones, you can start hunting Magus again.\n

634.description: You need a Dimensional Fragment in order to temporarily stay within the Dimensional Rift. Get as many Dimensional Fragments as possible.

steps.title: In Search of Fragments of Dimension
steps.description:
You must obtain a Dimensional Fragment if you intend to fight within the Dimensional Rift.

Monsters to Hunt - Necropolis, Catacombs: monsters whose name contains Lookout, Watcher, Guard, Monk, Overlord, Shaman, Consul, Inquisitor, Guardian, Elder, Court Guard and Preacher, excluding Nephilim, Lilim, Gigant and Lilith.

635.description: Destroy all of the monsters within the Dimensional Rift.  The number of teleports are limited, so you must work quickly!

steps.title: Defending the Dimensional Rift
steps.description: Defeat the devils within the Dimensional Rift.\n

636.description: The Priest Eliyah in the Rune Township knows how to get into the Temple of the Pagans.

steps.title: Go to Flauron
steps.description: T

637.description: The Priest Flauron seems like he has something to ask the person who bears the Faded Visitor's Mark.

steps.title: Hearts of the Necromancers
steps.description:
The Priest Flauron tells you to bring back 10 Necromancer Hearts from the Forest of the Dead. 

Monsters to Hunt: Bone Animators, Bone Slayers, Skull Animators

steps.title: Return to Flauron
steps.description: You've collected all the Necromancer Hearts the Priest Flauron asked for. Return to Flauron.\n

638.description: High Priest Innocentin of the Rune Township is trying to prevent the pagans from capturing the Grail of Splendor.

steps.title: Slay the Pagans
steps.description:
High Priest Innocentin is trying to prevent the pagans from capturing the Grail of Splendor. Innocentin will reward you if you defeat the monsters in the Temple of the Pagans and collect more than 2000 pagan totems. 

Monsters to Hunt: All the monsters in the Temple of the Pagans

639.description: Priest Dominic of the Rune Township is trying to obtain something hidden in the Monastery of Silence.

steps.title: Slay the Monk
steps.description:
Priest Dominic is trying to obtain something hidden in the Monastery of Silence. He will reward you if you can bring the Monk Scriptures to him.
In addition, he asks you to help Gremory if you meet him in the Monestary.

Monsters to Hunt: All the monsters in the Monestary of Silence

steps.title: Look Over the Grail
steps.description: Gremory has snuck into the Monastery of Silence and is looking for the Grail of Splendor. He asks you to examine the Grail in the Room of Splendor.\n

steps.title: Return to Gremory
steps.description: You have finished looking over the Grail in the Room of Splendor as Gremory asked. Return to Gremory.\n

steps.title: Collect the Monk Scriptures
steps.description:
Since you examined the Grail for him, Gremory will exchange 4000 Monk's Scriptures for an Enchant Weapon Scroll (S-Grade) and 400 Monk's Scriptures for an Enchant Armor Scroll (S-Grade ).
Therefore, you can be rewarded by both Dominic and Gremory if you collect the Monk Scriptures.

Monsters to Hunt: All the monsters in the Monastery of Silence

640.description: The Mercenary Captain Pierce located the Stakato Nest and commited all his troops there in order to finish the arduous battle.

steps.title: Kill the Stakatos!
steps.description:
The Mercenary Kahman asks you to kill Stakatos in the nest and bring back their fangs as proof.  

Monsters to Hunt: Spiked Stakatos, Spiked Stakato Workers, Spiked Stakato Guards, Male Spiked Stakatos, Female Spiked Stakatos, Spiked Stakato Sorcerers, Canibalistic Stakato Leader, Spiked Stakato Soldiers, Spiked Stakato Drones, Spiked Stakato Captain, Spiked Stakato Nurse, Spiked Stakato Shamans.

641.description: At the Elroki chief's camp on Primeval Isle, Asamah asks you to help save the Elroki tribe from an impending danger. To do so, you must defeat Sailren, a fearsome dinosaur of incredible power.

steps.title: Collect the Fragments of Gazkh
steps.description:
Shilen's Stone Statue tells you that you can obtain Gazkh Fragments by hunting the predatory Velociraptor and Pterosaur dinosaurs. You must obtain 30 Gazkh Fragments and bring them back to Shilen's Stone Statue. 

 Monsters to Hunt: Velociraptor, Pterosaur.

steps.title: Return to Shilen's Stone Statue
steps.description: You have collected all 30 Gazkh fragments. Return with them to Shilen's Stone Statue. \n

642.description: The discovery of powerful primitive creatures on the Primeval Isle has sparked interest from the magicians, who are curious about the creatures' origin, and from the blacksmiths, who are interested in what items can be crafted from the creatures. Both groups are eager to find adventurers willing to brave the dangers of Primeval Isle to bring back the research ingredients they need.

steps.title: Collect Dinosaur Tissue and Eggs
steps.description:
The discovery of powerful primitive creatures on the Primeval Isle has sparked the interest of magicians curious about the creatures' origin and blacksmiths eager to learn what items can be crafted from the creatures' hides, bones and claws. Dinn asks that you scavenge the carcasses of Dinosaurs you kill for any useful remains. He also offers a reward to anyone who brings him 1 Dinosaur Egg and 150 Dinosaur Tissues. 

 Monsters to Hunt: Velociraptor, Pterosaur, Ornithomimus, Deinonychus, Dinosaur Egg.

643.description: Powerful primitive creatures called dinosaurs abound on Primeval Isle. The magicians want dinosaur bones for their research, while the native Elrokians need dinosaur bones to help restore the tribe to its former glory. Both groups need an adventurer willing to defeat the dinosaurs and return with the needed bones.

steps.title: Ingredients for Magical Research
steps.description:
The Magician Karakawei, who is researching ancient creatures, needs dinosaur bones as research ingredients. The Primeval Isle's native shaman also needs dinosaur bones for some ritual. 

 Monsters to Hunt: Pachycephalosaurus, Wild Striders

644.description: Karuda says that the vengeful spirits are increasing because of the grave robbers' activities and asks you to eliminate the grave robbers.

steps.title: Defeat the Grave Robber
steps.description:
The number of vengeful spirits among the graves of the tribe of the betrayers is growing because of increased grave robber activity. Defeat the grave robbers and take back 120 stolen grave items. 

Monsters to Hunt: Grave Robber Scouts, Grave Robber Lookouts, Grave Robber Rangers, Grave Robber Guards,Grave Robber Fighters

steps.title: Return to Karuda
steps.description: You have taken back all 120 stolen grave items Karuda asked for. Return to Karuda. \n

645.description: The vengeful spirits are increasing because of the grave robbers' activities, and Karuda needs help preventing something evil from happening.

steps.title: Defeat the Spiteful Soul
steps.description:
Karuda says that the number of vengeful spirits is increasing so quickly that they may soon be able to enter the Immortal Plateau. He asks you to help them depart from this world in peace.  

Monsters to Hunt: Ghost of a Soldier, Ghost of a Loyal Vassal, Ghost of a General, Ghost of a Batur Chief, Ghost of a Morek Chief, Ghost of a Turka Chief

steps.title: Go to Karuda
steps.description: You have collected all the grave items. Give them to Karuda. \n

646.description: Torrant says that the Ragna Orcs are preparing to revolt and asks you to undermine their fighting power before the troops arrive.

steps.title: Collect Cursed Dolls
steps.description:
The Beacon Tower Manager Torrant asks you to snatch 180 Cursed Dolls--the medium that controls the evil creatures--to weaken the fighting power of the Ragna Orcs, who are planning a revolt. 

Monsters to Hunt: Ragna Orcs, Ragna Orc Shaman, Ragna Orc Archer, Ragna Orc Warrior, Ragna Orc Mage, Ragna Orc Healer, Ragna Orc Hero, Ragna Orc Commander, Ragna Orc Sniper, Ragna Orc Sorcerer, Dark Corpse, Guardian of the Ghost Town, Varangka's Succubus

steps.title: Go torrant
steps.description: You have snatched the Cursed Dolls Torrant asked for. Take them to him. \n

647.description: The Collector Gutenhagen wants to clear the Pavel Ruins of Golems in order to research them.

steps.title: Hunt the Horrifying Golem Army
steps.description:
Collector Gutenhagen has asked you to hunt Golems at the Pavel Ruins. 

Monsters to Hunt: Probe Golem Prodigy IV, Menacing Jackhammer Golem, Horrifying Cannon Golem I, Horrifying Cannon Golem IV, Cruel Vice Golem, Probe Golem Champion I, Horrifying Excavator Golem III, Bloodthirsty Ginzu Golem VII, Bloodthirsty Ginzu Golem II, Ginzu Golem Prodigy X, Horrifying Jackhammer Golem, Horrifying Cannon Golem, Horrifying Cannon Golem III, Deadly Ginzu Golem V, Horrifying Ginzu Golem V, Horrifying Cannon Golem VI, Epic Cannon Golem, Epic Cannon Golem Adjunct, Horrifying Ginzu Golem VIII, Deadly Ginzu Golem VIII

steps.title: Return to Gutenhagen
steps.description: You've collected 500 fragments by hunting down the Golems in the Pavel Ruins. Return to Collector Gutenhagen in the Dwarven barracks.\n

648.description: Rafforty is collecting crystals of ice for his guild.

steps.title: Rafforty's Request
steps.description:
Rafforty asks you to find a Silver Ice Crystal. They are guarded by creatures in the Frozen Labyrinth. 

Monsters to Hunt: Massive Maze Bandersnatch, Lost Watcher, Elder Lost Watcher, Panthera, Lost Gargoyle, Lost Gargoyle Youngling, Pronghorn, Pronghorn Spirit, Ice Tarantula, Frost Tarantula, Frost Iron Golem, Frost Buffalo, Lost Baffalo, Ursus, Lost Yeti, Frost Yeti

steps.title: Save the Silver Hemocytes
steps.description:
Rafforty thanks you and tells you to save any Silver Hemocytes you may acquire for future needs. He also says that if you return with a Black Ice Crystal, he will give you a reward as a small token of appreciation for all your help. 
You can make a Black Ice Crystal from the Ice Shelf. 

Monsters to Hunt: Massive Maze Bandersnatch, Lost Watcher, Elder Lost Watcher, Panthera, Lost Gargoyle, Lost Gargoyle Youngling, Pronghorn, Pronghorn Spirit, Ice Tarantula, Frost Tarantula, Frost Iron Golem, Frost Buffalo, Lost Buffalo, Ursus, Lost Yeti, Frost Yeti

649.description: Railroad Worker Obi in the Plunderous Plains is plagued by incessant bandit attacks. Help him!

steps.title: Sweeping Bandit
steps.description: Railroad Worker Obi asked you to defeat the Rayito bandits and bring back 200 stolen items.\nMonsters to Hunt: Bandit Sweeper, Bandit Hound, Bandit Watchman, Bandit Undertaker, Bandit Assassin, Bandit Warrior, Bandit Inspector, Bandit Captain\n

steps.title: Return to Obi
steps.description: You've collected 200 items stolen by the Rayito bandits. Return to Railroad Worker Obi.\n

650.description: The Dwarves of the Sky Wagon Relic eventually went mad. Can they be saved?

steps.title: The Remnants of Dreams
steps.description:
The Dwarves who became ghosts and whose dreams were thwarted now wander the Sky Wagon Relic. Pay them your respects.

Monsters to Hunt: Forgotten Crewman, Vagabonds of the Ruins

651.description: When you meet a Fisherman's son who ran away because he didn't want to be part of the family business, convince him to return home.

steps.title: Did the Runaway Return Home?
steps.description: You have encountered Ivan, a disturbed youth who ran away from the Fishermen's Guild. You gave him a Scroll of Escape because he regretted what he'd done and wanted to return home. Go and meet with Ivan's father, Batidae, the Fishing Guild Member of the Town of Schuttgart to make sure Ivan is learning his craft well (and that he won't go on anymore adventures.)\n

652.description: The aged ex-adventurer left home for some excitement and found serious trouble. If you encounter him during the adventure, help him out.

steps.title: Did the Old Adventurer Return Home?
steps.description: You met an aged ex-adventurer. The old man had run out of Soulshots in a dangerous hunting ground, and could not travel freely.  You shared your Soulshots with him, allowing him to return home. Go to the Town of Oren and meet with Sara, his daughter-in-law, to find out if the old man made it home safely.\n

653.description: If you meet Suki, who ran away because she fell in love with a vagabond, convince her to go back home.

steps.title: Did Suki Return Home Safely?
steps.description: You helped a young woman who had run off with a vagabond. When they broke up, she was lost. Go meet with her father to find out if she made it home safely.

654.description: The Nameless Spirit at the entrance to the 4th Sepulcher needs somebody to put its double to sleep.

steps.title: The Spirit's Story
steps.description: The Nameless Spirit informs you that only through the use of a magic scroll can the force field be dispersed.  He then informs you that is was created by his "double." Keep listening to the story.\n

steps.title: Skin of the Antelope
steps.description:
